episodes.summary: Tamra decides to give herself some space from Gretchen; Emily and Shane are more in sync after receiving a diagnosis for Luke; Jenn expresses her concerns as Dawson preps to leave for the Marines.

episodes.name: Hoedown Throwdown
episodes.summary: Tamra meets with Katie in hopes of uncovering the truth; Shannon and Jenn's friendship continues to blossom when they engage their dogs with a pet psychic; Heather hosts an event for the Trevor Project.

episodes.name: Going Dutch
episodes.summary: Shannon hosts a bridal lunch for Jenn; Heather opens up about her relationship with her father; Gina and Travis celebrate their family being back together; Tamra and Eddie prep to be empty nesters; the ladies head to Amsterdam.

episodes.name: Tulip Service
episodes.summary: As the Amsterdam trip continues, the ladies visit the famous tulip fields where Jenn and Shannon´s friendship is called into question. Emily tries one last time to broker peace between Tamra and Gretchen.

episodes.name: A Source of Discontent
episodes.summary: The ladies enjoy several local activities in Amsterdam; Emily receives a distressing call from Shane; Heather finds comfort in visiting her parents' former home before spreading her father's ashes; Gina struggles with a scandalous rumor.

episodes.name: Loose Lips Sink Trips
episodes.summary: After dinner in Temecula, Tamra tries to turn the trip around for the ladies; Heather, Emily and Gretchen's wild night out in West Hollywood ends with Gretchen revealing tea about Tamra; Tamra's efforts to win Shannon's favor are thwarted.

episodes.name: Reunion Part 2
episodes.summary: The ladies question Tamra about Jenn's photo, Gina discusses Heather's career comments. Jenn gets Ryan's call with Katie revelations. Matt Ginella joins for a dramatic he said, she said game.

episodes.name: Reunion Part 3
episodes.summary: Tamra and Gretchen clash over Amsterdam dinner details. Emily and Tamra question their friendship. Season finale footage sparks intense reactions, putting Tamra's honesty under scrutiny.

episodes.name: Defense Is the Best Offense
episodes.summary: The women return from two tense trips with most feeling the planned bonding failed to take hold. Tamra joins Sophia on a music-school tour. Jenn realizes her upcoming wedding is having a greater emotional impact on her kids than she anticipated. Everyone reunites when Gretchen hosts a tactical training event. The ladies learn self-defense, but a shocking rumor about Tamra leads to an explosive confrontation.

episodes.name: Four Shots
episodes.summary: In North Charleston, South Carolina, detectives track down the killer of a man asleep in a trailer next to an armed robbery scene where shots were fired.

episodes.name: Betrayed
episodes.summary: A woman is ambushed and shot dead on her doorstep, setting off a chain of events Tulsa Detectives could never have predicted.

episodes.name: A Lonely Place to Die
episodes.summary: In Tulsa, Oklahoma, a father of six is found shot to death in a homeless encampment, and detectives have to turn to that community for help.

episodes.name: The Cool Mom
episodes.summary: After a North Charleston mother of four is found beaten to death in the bushes, a rookie detective battles it out in the interview room with her suspected killer.

episodes.name: Unfriendly Fire
episodes.summary: A college student is gunned down in a doorway; Tulsa Homicide detectives explore whether a feud between friends escalated to murder.

episodes.name: R is for Random
episodes.summary: When a young father is executed in broad daylight, Gwinnett County detectives race against the clock to figure out if one man was passing innocently through the neighborhood or if he's the killer.

episodes.name: Murder in the Bud Room/A Mother Taken
episodes.summary: Tulsa detectives investigate the homicide of a father of six at a marijuana dispensary. In Gwinnett County Georgia, detectives investigate the abduction of a mother, hoping to find her before it's too late.

episodes.name: Circle of Friends/Rearview Murder
episodes.summary: Tulsa detectives investigate a homicide at a homeless encampment. Mobile detectives unravel a possible road rage homicide.

episodes.name: Blood Brothers
episodes.summary: Tulsa detectives work the murder of an innocent man found inside a house after gunfire erupts from outside.

episodes.name: Birthday Party Nightmare
episodes.summary: Tulsa detectives investigate the murder of a man trying to protect his daughter after a fight breaks out at a family birthday party.

episodes.name: In Blood
episodes.summary: Gwinnett County detectives pursue new leads in a case of a man stabbed in his home five years ago.

episodes.name: Mystery Man
episodes.summary: Gwinnett County detectives investigate after a man is found shot and strangled in his truck.

episodes.name: A Troubled Mind
episodes.summary: Tulsa detectives investigate after a father finds his son brutally stabbed to death.

episodes.name: A House Divided
episodes.summary: Tulsa detectives investigate the homicide of a man shot outside his baby mother's house.

episodes.name: The Devil's Hands/Steel Coffin
episodes.summary: In Gwinnett County, detectives investigate the murder of a woman who was brutally stabbed to death. In Mobile, detectives investigate a double homicide at a busy intersection.

episodes.name: Drive Into Darkness
episodes.summary: Tulsa detectives investigate after an ambush shooting leaves two teens dead and two critically injured.

episodes.name: Blind Fire
episodes.summary: Tulsa detectives investigate after a teen is shot in the head by someone who blindly shot into a bedroom window.

episodes.name: Fatally Misinformed
episodes.summary: Gwinnett County detectives investigate the homicide of a man who was shot in the chest at a hotel.

episodes.name: Unforgotten: Rob
episodes.summary: North Charleston detectives continue investigating the unsolved homicide of a musician shot in his apartment.

episodes.name: Escaping Armageddon
episodes.summary: In the razor's-edge theater of global brinkmanship, the world has come closer to annihilation than most ever knew.

episodes.name: Top Secret Sites
episodes.summary: Step inside the hidden areas where history was steered in secret. From Churchill's wartime bunker - complete with a direct line to FDR concealed inside his private bathroom - to a Soviet weapons base in the desert.

episodes.name: Buried Secrets
episodes.summary: David Duchovny exposes a clandestine nuclear blast set off deep below Mississippi soil, and secret experiments conducted on citizens in the New York subway system.

episodes.name: Black Ops
episodes.summary: A French Resistance operative hides explosives in baguettes to cripple a Nazi factory, an American soldier parachutes behind enemy lines to destroy critical supply routes, and Ukrainian forces deploy AI-guided drones to strike a Russian bomber fleet.

episodes.name: Bizarre Weapons
episodes.summary: From a British scheme to launch airborne balloons against Nazi Germany, to American bats fitted with incendiary devices, to a covert effort to manipulate monsoon rains in Vietnam.

episodes.name: Cracking the Code
episodes.summary: A stranded American pilot in Vietnam is rescued through a code built around familiar golf courses, while Navajo Code Talkers transmit messages that help turn the tide in the Pacific during WWII.

episodes.name: Secret Units
episodes.summary: Behind official policy often stands unofficial actors. Discover the audacious operations of Red Cell.

episodes.name: Extraordinary Experiments
episodes.summary: The secretive flights of Project Argus sent nuclear warheads into space to test whether radiation could cripple Soviet weapons, while Operation LAC covertly released chemical agents over American communities to simulate biological warfare.

episodes.name: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.summary: David Duchovny takes us into the long-spun elaborate tales governments have employed to blanket their boldest missions, showing us how the illusion works - or until it doesn't.

episodes.name: Extreme Extractions
episodes.summary: In Operation Halyard, villagers and resistance fighters built an airstrip by hand to spirit stranded airmen out of Nazi territory, while Operation Mount Hope saw American forces steal a Soviet helicopter from the African desert.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Skies
episodes.summary: From a near-nuclear disaster in North Carolina to a covered-up UFO incident at a missile base and Israel's audacious fighter jet theft, explore how nations compete for supremacy in the skies beyond moon and stars.

episodes.name: Black Sites
episodes.summary: David Duchovny explores hidden government facilities and their secret operations, from a Soviet poison lab to a nuclear site under Greenland's ice and a US doomsday bunker inside a mountain.

episodes.name: Extreme Missions
episodes.summary: From deep-sea divers tapping Soviet cables to Special Ops teams deploying A-bombs in enemy territory, declassified records show elite forces' extreme missions in hostile zones.

episodes.name: Strange Weapons
episodes.summary: From atomic tests 1500x stronger than Hiroshima to CIA poison guns and plots to feminize Hitler, declassified files reveal bizarre military weapons programs that balanced between apocalyptic and absurd.

episodes.name: Mind Games
episodes.summary: Government mind control programs weren't just fiction - from CIA truth serum tests to Army PsyOps in Vietnam, nations have tried controlling minds of enemies and citizens through deceptive experiments.

episodes.name: Deep Cover
episodes.summary: Undercover agents endured severe psychological strain while living double lives infiltrating dangerous worlds. Secret ops like The Pond, Mossad's Red Sea resort, and UK's Moscow rescue showcased their sacrifices.

episodes.name: Dark Science
episodes.summary: During the Cold War, secret government labs conducted disturbing experiments. From Stalin's hybrid soldier program to East Germany's odd scent collection and Soviet bioweapons, these declassified records reveal science's darkest chapter.

episodes.name: Deep Space
episodes.summary: Declassified files reveal NASA's secret moon nuke plan, USSR's covered-up space tragedy, and US spy satellite projects that led to space stations-all part of a classified space race.

episodes.name: Spy Tech
episodes.summary: Spies rely on unexpected gadgets. From modified toys saving informants to hair-based disguises to spy balloons mistaken for UFOs, government's secret tech succeeds by defying expectations.

episodes.name: Unholy Alliances
episodes.summary: When governments strike dark deals with cults, mobs, and even sworn enemies, frosty relationships and mounting tensions are tested head-on.

episodes.name: The Great Unknown
episodes.summary: Burning Man evolves from Larry Harvey's 1980s anti-establishment group into a multi-million-dollar event backed by tech billionaires.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Shit Show
episodes.summary: Burning Man is canceled again. Renegade Burners hold their own desert event, which feels like a return to the festival's roots and reveals complex leadership tensions.

episodes.name: Waking Dreams
episodes.summary: Burning Man returns with musicians and artists creating spectacular installations. Growing unease among creatives who fear social media influencers and tech money threaten Burning Man's original community spirit and philosophy.

episodes.name: Mud Burn
episodes.summary: Burning Man is threatened by days of rain and chaos. Many attendees flee the muddy terrain as the government steps in to ensure attendees stay safe.

episodes.name: Pigskin Classic
episodes.summary: Three football superfans compete.

episodes.name: Feels So Good in the Showwah
episodes.summary: Host Elizabeth Banks has a sneaking suspicion the WHAMMY is going to turn up the heat as contestants try to snag big bucks and prizes.

episodes.name: Big Bass, No Whammies!
episodes.summary: Three contestants compete against one another and answer questions to earn spins on the Big Board. Then, they use their spins to win cash and prizes while trying to avoid the WHAMMY, who could take all of their winnings.

episodes.name: I Intend to Win
episodes.summary: Host Elizabeth Banks' head is spinning as contestants snag prizes and dodge the dreaded WHAMMY.

episodes.name: Hot 4 Teacher
episodes.summary: Contestants use their skills as educators to compete;

episodes.name: Frickin' Brisbane
episodes.summary: Contestants try to snag big bucks and prizes;

episodes.name: Halls Balls!!!
episodes.summary: Contestants try to avoid the whammy and bring home the million dollar prize

episodes.name: Deadpool and Wolverine Whammy Takeover
episodes.summary: A game of wits, strategy and even high stakes as contestants try to avoid the iconic and devilish Whammy for a chance a life changing, cash and prizes.

episodes.name: Press Your Luck-Mania!
episodes.summary: Three contestants compete against one another and answer questions to earn spins on the Big Board.

episodes.name: Halloween Spooktacular
episodes.summary: Three players go trick or treating for big bucks, but they'll have to avoid ghosts, goblins and the Whammy.

episodes.name: Press Your Luck's Holiday Extravaganza III
episodes.summary: Celebrate the holiday season with big bucks and festive prizes.

episodes.name: Salute to Service
episodes.summary: Celebrating members of the military who are ready to win some big bucks and amazing prizes.

episodes.name: Redemption 2: Insanity!
episodes.summary: Three losers from previous episodes return for a second shot at Big Bucks.

episodes.name: The Hot and the Holy
episodes.summary: A special education teacher, a kindergarten teacher and a pastor compete for big bucks and try to avoid the Whammy.

episodes.name: 22 for Season 22
episodes.summary: Heidi Klum hosts twenty-two designers competing for fashion's top prize. A shocking twist intensifies the competition as designers battle to secure their spot by showcasing a signature look to the judges.

episodes.name: Ready, Set, Redemption!
episodes.summary: The designers have a second chance at a first impression as they are challenged to create a look that reflects their personal design style. In addition to the judges, the designers' fate will also be decided by some familiar faces.

episodes.name: In It to Win It
episodes.summary: Designers split into four fashion houses must create runway looks inspired by NFL teams. Balancing collaboration with individual creativity proves challenging as emotions run high and relationships are tested.

episodes.name: Catwalk on the Wild Side
episodes.summary: In a series of head-to-head fashion battles, the designers create bold looks inspired by wild animals. Special guest models from Hulu's Get Real lineup bring the contestants' creations to life on the runway.

episodes.name: Viva la Fashion
episodes.summary: Creativity is put to the test when the designers must transform paper towels into high-fashion runway looks. The competition becomes personal when the designers must name who they believe is the weakest designer amongst them.

episodes.name: The Devil's in the Details
episodes.summary: The designers compete for a coveted opportunity: creating a red-carpet look for Heidi Klum to wear at the premiere of The Devil Wears Prada 2. Glamour, elegance and high expectations collide.

episodes.name: Battle of the Seasons
episodes.summary: The season 22 designers join forces to take on returning competitors from season 21 in the classic unconventional materials challenge. Familiar faces and unexpected materials create a high-stakes showdown.

episodes.name: Designing with the Stars
episodes.summary: Partnering with Dancing With the Stars, the designers create performance-ready fashions for some of the show's favorite professional dancers. Style and movement must work together seamlessly.

episodes.name: Put a Ring on it
episodes.summary: In their final challenge before the finale, the designers create two wedding-day looks for a fashion-forward bride. The assignment demands versatility, elegance and a clear design vision.

episodes.name: The Finale
episodes.summary: The finalists present original capsule collections in a spectacular runway event. After a season of intense competition, one designer will earn fashion's biggest prize.

episodes.name: New House / New Rules
episodes.summary: Heidi Klum hosts as 12 new designers split into two fashion houses compete to create Disney princess and villain-inspired looks.

episodes.name: Feel the Burn
episodes.summary: After teams are reorganized, designers must create versatile athleisure wear combining style and practicality.

episodes.name: Boring to Brilliant
episodes.summary: As rivalry intensifies, designers must tap their creativity to turn plain fabric into stunning fashion pieces.

episodes.name: Sew Elementary
episodes.summary: The designers head back to school where they must create fashionable looks using unconventional materials before facing a shocking twist at the elimination.

episodes.name: Complementary Couture
episodes.summary: After tough elimination, designers must make matching pieces for their previous unconventional materials designs.

episodes.name: Hit the Streets
episodes.summary: The designers must step up their game as they are asked to create a streetwear look that speaks to their individual brand.

episodes.name: Threads of Confidence
episodes.summary: The designers create jaw dropping looks for a night out as they work with real clients.

episodes.name: Something Wicked
episodes.summary: As friendships begin to unfold, the designers are tasked with creating a look worthy of Oz.

episodes.name: See You on the Runway
episodes.summary: The last three designers make capsule collections to determine who deserves to be crowned champion.

episodes.name: Meal, Interrupted
episodes.summary: Sal, Q, and Murr kick off the season by flagging down a Good Samaritan for help from a broken-down car, then impersonating corpses in a funeral home with Adam Ray. But one Joker can't sit at the table, and will have to clear it too soon.

episodes.name: Lean, Mean, Time Machine
episodes.summary: Sal, Q, and Murr cause havoc by pretending to be terrible office receptionists, then try to convince strangers to join the line for a wacky pop-up event. But one Joker fails his mission and must travel through time to save the future.

episodes.name: Celebrity Crushed
episodes.summary: The Jokers make mischief by wildly overreacting when a new focus group friend suffers a very minor injustice, then try to impress using the cringiest pick-up lines possible. The loser comes face-to-face with his childhood celebrity crush.

episodes.name: Valet Villain
episodes.summary: The guys win the world's worst dad awards by surprising their kid with a trip before cruelly taking it away, then get caught taking crazy notes in a focus group. The loser takes the wheel in a punishment that leaves no happy customers.

episodes.name: Last Action Zero
episodes.summary: The guys put in shifts getting trained to work at Playa Bowls, then hand out bizarre business cards to people they think could use their services. But one Joker can't complete the task and goes on the defense for his wacky punishment.

episodes.name: A Ruff Day at the Park
episodes.summary: The Jokers are causing a scene on the street by throwing their ex's stuff out the window, until they mistakenly throw out something that belongs to them. Then, they'll have to keep a straight face during a snack taste test.

episodes.name: The Endless Esophagus
episodes.summary: Sal, Q and Murr kick off another season of antics by getting themselves stuck in a vent system and confusing customers at a bagel shop. Then, our losing Joker will face humiliation in a punishment that's tough to swallow.

episodes.name: Call of the Wild
episodes.summary: The Jokers are back working as dry cleaners and TV producers, but one of them can't keep it together and must endure concertgoers who have escaped their enclosures.

episodes.name: Facial Awareness
episodes.summary: The Jokers face off by recording voiceover for a fake video game and playing the concerned parent writing to their kid's school. But one Joker burns out with a punishment that's gotta sting.

episodes.name: Customer Disservice
episodes.summary: Joey Fatone interviews the Jokers for a fake documentary, then the guys react to an overly emotional phone call for an underwhelming reason. One Joker checks out and is forced into being the world's worst grocery store employee.

episodes.name: Rage Baiter
episodes.summary: The Jokers hit the grocery store aisles dressed in absurd disguises, then train someone in using aggressive phone tactics for charity donations. The losing Joker must subject themselves to scientific probing into their hidden emotions.

episodes.name: Mind, Body, Swole
episodes.summary: The Jokers can't contain the laughs as they answer survey questions for a new snack food and present the world's worst pharmaceutical ads. Then, tonight's loser will work up a sweat in a punishment that's all pain, no gain.

episodes.name: Meat Cute
episodes.summary: Attention shoppers. The Jokers make mischief by taking unflattering pictures of grocery store patrons, then posing as horrible employees at the Yeti store. But tonight's loser must "meat" his fate in a jaw-dropping punishment.

episodes.name: Dopamine Denier
episodes.summary: And...ACTION. The Jokers play unprofessional actors in a fake commercial, then make wild assumptions about other mallgoers. But one Joker breaks and is tasked with becoming the strictest security guard imaginable in his punishment.

episodes.name: Behind Closed Doors
episodes.summary: The Jokers are locked in a supply closet and must decide who's endured the worst punishments to escape. As they argue over physical, embarrassing, and personal punishments, old clips resurface, and tensions rise.

episodes.name: Revenge of the Joker
episodes.summary: The Jokers play lawyers trying to convince an unsuspecting focus group to sign off on ridiculous terms and conditions. Then they put their family businesses to the test by asking strangers if their radio ad is good to stay on the air.

episodes.name: Vac Attack
episodes.summary: The Jokers are hitting the floor as restaurant owners of a New York pizzeria, forced to say and do whatever the other guys tell them. Later, they're back at Tompkins Square bagels trying to hunt down a customer that left a scathing review.

episodes.name: Subscribe to Survive
episodes.summary: The Jokers are back as wacky inventors pitching a new line of AI-themed gadgets. Then, they fill out incident reports with unsuspecting deli customers. The loser will be forced to demonstrate mentally absurd and physically grueling "apps."

episodes.name: Cold Hard FAQs
episodes.summary: Sal, Q, and Murr are sick of hearing the same frequently asked questions about Impractical Jokers, so tonight they're sitting down and answering them once and for all, alongside never-before-seen clips and untold stories.

episodes.name: Me, My Selfie and Eye
episodes.summary: The Jokers pretend to be bellhops and need to do and say what they're told while assisting unsuspecting guests to their rooms. Then, the guys need to give away tickets to an absurd made-up show they can no longer see.

episodes.name: The Founding Joker
episodes.summary: The Jokers are back at Colonial Diner, offering some new bizarre specials to unsuspecting patrons. Then, they take a ride through the park. But after a nasty fall, the Joker must get park goers to help them out from underneath their bike.

episodes.name: A Tight Spot
episodes.summary: Look out. The Jokers hatch horrible revenge schemes on their office bullies, then put one poor contractor through the ringer as they attempt home improvement projects. Later, tonight's loser will be gifted the world's finest douchemobile.

episodes.name: Leftovers
episodes.summary: Murr's got all of this leftover food that needs eating, and even more important, a whole bunch of leftover clips from this season that didn't make the cut. Sal and Q help to polish them off, reminiscing on favorite moments from Season 12.

episodes.name: Let's Get Crackin'
episodes.summary: The Jokers are unsympathetic store managers, forced to throw out a disruptive customer before dealing with the wrath and disdain of fellow patrons. Then, they must get a bystander to take their side in an argument with their fake spouses.

episodes.name: Happily Never After
episodes.summary: The Jokers are asking strangers to send an important text to their loved ones, and hunting for their missing kid using crazy descriptions. Then, tonight's loser will say "I do" to facing one of their toughest punishments yet.

episodes.name: Skulls of the Gods
episodes.summary: Archaeologists worldwide have discovered strange, elongated skulls. Did ancestors reshape their skulls to mimic extraterrestrials? Could some skulls be otherworldly?

episodes.name: Egypt's Lost Pyramid
episodes.summary: High above the Giza Plateau stands Egypt's most mysterious ancient site: the Lost Pyramid of Abu Rawash.

episodes.name: Islands of the Gods
episodes.summary: Pacific Ocean is a vast area known as Oceania that is home to the world's most remote and mysterious islands. They are known for massive stone structures, statuary strange figures, and countless legends of otherworldly visitors.

episodes.name: Extraterrestrial Engineering
episodes.summary: From the precisely cut stone blocks at Puma Punku, to the gigantic temples of Malta, and the megalithic city of Nan Madol, could these mysterious sites contain evidence of extraterrestrial contact in the distant past?

episodes.name: UFO Hot Spots
episodes.summary: Found along the California coast to New York's Hudson Valley, and Northern England to Southern Chile, could these mysterious locations provide evidence of an extraterrestrial presence on Earth?

episodes.name: Mysterious Monuments
episodes.summary: From a stone circle in Turkey that challenges the timeline of human history to gigantic stone spheres in Bosnia and Egypt's most unusual tombs, could these monuments provide proof of extraterrestrial visitation?

episodes.name: Underwater Alien Bases
episodes.summary: Earth's oceans remain deeply mysterious. Ancient legends describe powerful water-dwelling beings, and these areas now see frequent UFO activity. Could otherworldly entities inhabit our planet's deepest ocean trenches?

episodes.name: Secrets of the Vedas
episodes.summary: Ancient Hindu Vedas, thousands of years old, describe gods who traveled in flying machines and wielded extraordinary technology on Earth.

episodes.name: Wars of the Gods
episodes.summary: Ancient legends describe a war in heaven that was fought by otherworldly beings with extraordinary weapons. Is it possible that our planet still bears the scars of battles fought by extraterrestrials?

episodes.name: UFO Sightings
episodes.summary: From footage of extraordinary aircraft taken by fighter pilots to mysterious glowing orbs that are reported all over the world, are these remarkable sightings evidence of extraterrestrial visitation?

episodes.name: Alien A.I.
episodes.summary: The rapid development of artificial intelligence has made it a powerful tool for historians and archaeologists. But might it also reveal evidence of an extraterrestrial presence on Earth?

episodes.name: Hidden Messages
episodes.summary: From colossal figures that can only be seen from the sky to complex crop circles that mimic sound frequencies, and mathematical messages encoded on opposite sides of the planet, could these sites hold clues about alien visitation?

episodes.name: Secrets of the Amazon
episodes.summary: The Amazon rainforest remains largely unexplored, but thanks to new technology, researchers are now finding that this dense jungle was once home to a vast network of cities.

episodes.name: Alien Investigators
episodes.summary: Giorgio Tsoukalos revisits the series archives to honor Alien Investigators who dared to ask if we're alone in the universe. Did they find evidence of aliens on Earth?

episodes.name: Africa's Extraterrestrial Contact
episodes.summary: The origins of humanity can be traced back to Africa, and some of the oldest religious traditions across the continent describe mysterious beings who descended from the sky in thunderous vehicles.

episodes.name: Spy Gadgets
episodes.summary: Sometimes the most dangerous weapon in the room is the one nobody realizes is there.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Extraordinary Discoveries
episodes.summary: Ten extraordinary archaeological finds challenge our understanding of human origins, including mysterious spheres, an Andean lost city, and a submerged metropolis with possible links to otherworldly visitors.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Mysterious Monoliths
episodes.summary: Ancient Aliens is counting down the world's top ten most mysterious monoliths, from a 500-ton stone believed to represent an ancient UFO, to giant statues said to have been created with advanced technology, and ornate pillars that depict otherworldly visitors. Could these extraordinary standing stones provide evidence of extraterrestrial visitation?

episodes.name: The Top Ten UFO Crashes
episodes.summary: Ancient Aliens is counting down ten of the most compelling UFO crashes that have been reported across the globe. From an acorn-shaped object that crashed in the woods of rural Pennsylvania, to a mysterious craft that washed ashore in Japan, and an earth-shaking impact in Britain that defies explanation, are these mysterious events proof that our planet has been visited by extraterrestrials?

episodes.name: The Top Ten Unexplained Technologies
episodes.summary: Ancient Aliens is counting down ten of the most astonishing - and unexplainable - technologies in history. From mysterious golden orbs discovered in Mexico, to a sacred wooden box that could communicate with the heavens, and an ancient tomb that is said to depict an astronaut, might these sensational artifacts be evidence of otherworldly contact?

episodes.name: The Top Ten Secret Projects
episodes.summary: Ancient Aliens is counting down ten of history's most compelling - and covert - projects that study the UFO phenomenon. From clandestine government organizations to agents that silence UFO witnesses and secret programs to reverse engineer alien technology, are these mysterious projects evidence of contact with extraterrestrials?

episodes.name: The Top Ten Mysterious Mountains
episodes.summary: Ten enigmatic mountains worldwide harbor unexplained phenomena and UFO activity. From Sri Lanka's mystical portal to Washington's volcanic encounter, these peaks spark questions about possible alien connections.

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Aztecs
episodes.summary: Ancient astronaut theorists explore connections between Aztec deities and possible alien contact, examining the empire's mysterious rise and fall through the lens of their cosmic mythology and religious practices.

episodes.name: The Glowing Orb Phenomenon
episodes.summary: Strange luminous spheres appear worldwide, moving in impossible ways and showing up near sensitive military sites. Their origin and purpose remain unknown, raising questions about potential extraterrestrial contact.

episodes.name: The Legacy of J. Allen Hynek
episodes.summary: Dr. J. Allen Hynek is best known as the notorious government UFO debunker who became one of the founding fathers of ufology. Was Dr. Hynek right when he ultimately concluded that there is a non-human intelligence on Earth?

episodes.name: The Birdman Mystery
episodes.summary: Throughout the ancient world, there are depictions of mysterious figures that appear to be half human and half bird. In many cultures, they are revered as divine and have magical abilities.

episodes.name: The Giants
episodes.summary: Examining how thousands of years ago, people all over the world described encounters with enormous, human-like beings; exploring how some archaeologists claim to have found skeletons of extraordinary size; is it possible the giants actually existed?

episodes.name: Aliens in Our Midst
episodes.summary: In the age of smartphones and social media, more evidence of otherworldly activity has come to light than ever before. From a giant "shadow monster" witnessed outside a Miami mall to reports of ET encounters in Las Vegas.

episodes.name: Britain's UFO Files
episodes.summary: From Stonehenge to crop circles and UFO sightings, Britain holds many mysteries. Has this island been a destination for alien visitors throughout history?

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Norse Gods
episodes.summary: The ancient legends of the Norse read like modern science-fiction, with powerful gods wielding incredible weapons and high technology. Could it be that these mythological tales are based on real encounters with extraterrestrial beings?

episodes.name: Secrets of Japan
episodes.summary: Japan is a land rich with ancient mysteries, and recently, it has also become known as a UFO hotspot. Could it be, as Ancient Astronaut Theorists suggest, that this island nation has a long history of extraterrestrial activity?

episodes.name: The Abduction Files
episodes.summary: All over the world, there are people who claim they have been abducted by aliens. Since the 1970s, a growing number of researchers have dedicated their lives to uncovering what is behind this disturbing phenomenon.

episodes.name: Enchanted Gardening/Gem Scouting
episodes.summary: The Campers are Planting Seeds. Finding the Hidden Gems.

episodes.name: A Different Kind of Cloud/Magi-Sneezies
episodes.summary: The Magicampers chase a mysterious cloud. Loomis sniffs some weird flowers which makes him constantly sneeze and shoot magic bolts, causing anyone he strikes to lose control of their powers or abilities.

episodes.name: King Loomis/Double Dracoon
episodes.summary: Loomis has a hard time making decisions. A magic mistake creates two Dracoons.

episodes.name: Flight of the Chiffen/Harper's Power
episodes.summary: Loomis tries to help Chiffen fly. Harper sets off to discover her magical power.

episodes.name: Snomes Galore/Tricky Tune
episodes.summary: Strange new critters start appearing all over Magicamp. Harper's harp causes magical problems.

episodes.name: Darly's Messy Magical Map/Pixsqueaks
episodes.summary: Loomis makes a mess of Darly's map. Pixsqueaks invade the picnic party.

episodes.name: Bake Off and Away/Fierce or Fabulous
episodes.summary: Loomis accidentally adds too much of some magic powder into his muffin batter, causing whoever eats his product to float away in the air. Dracoon and Fifi argue on how to decorate the car they and their friends built.

episodes.name: How Dracoon Lost His Fire/Rules Out
episodes.summary: Loomis accidentally casts a spell on Dracoon, causing the green Magicamper to breathe out bubbles instead of fire. Chiffen and Harper hide Merritt's rule book, thinking its absence would free Magicamp Island of policies.

episodes.name: Bodhi Rocks/Pixsqueak Ball
episodes.summary: When Bodhi takes a gemstone from a mystical field as a gift for Fifi, he and his friends are confronted by a monster made of rocks. Loomis and Darly get trapped in the Pixsqueaks' abode when their size-changing ball blocks the entrance.

episodes.name: Mystery in Magicamp/Pixsqueaky Clean
episodes.summary: Hours before a hoof ball game starts, belongings of the Magicampers suddenly go missing. The Magicampers have to tidy up the camp before a group singing activity.

episodes.name: Babaya Berry Blizzard/Hats Off to Fifi
episodes.summary: Loomis accidentally sends a Babaya berry bush into a cloud, resulting in millions of Babaya berries raining over Magicamp Island. Thinking about doing something new for the talent show, Fifi dons a magic hat that gets bigger and bigger.

episodes.name: Chick and Chiffen/All For Little Gruffypants
episodes.summary: Chiffen comes across an egg on the ground, and goes on a quest to find its owner. Dracoon is fixated on his plush Little Gruffypants that it causes problems when he and his friends go on a trip to the summit.

episodes.name: Truffaloves/The Donkeycorn Prince
episodes.summary: When Darly leads her friends to gather Dazzle berries, she finds Truffaloves, and decides to get both, which results in her being separated from the group. Loomis dislikes the role Fifi gives him for the play, but he is afraid to tell her.

episodes.name: The Trollamander and the Purple Pumpkins/Critter Spotting
episodes.summary: When they go to get purple pumpkins for Halloween, Dracoon tells his friends about a fearsome reptilian rumored to be lurking in the woods during the holiday. The Magicampers must find a critter, and each of them must draw a picture of it.

episodes.name: Follow That Froglin/Go With the Slow
episodes.summary: The Magicampers think Bodhi has been transformed into a Froglin after Loomis' spell goes awry. Loomis, Darly, Dracoon, and Fifi board their cars to go on an island safari, but get caught up in racing each other.

episodes.name: The Little Magicool Pool/Darly's Extra Wowzy Surprise
episodes.summary: Merritt stumbles into a mystical pond which makes her very young at heart, and very rambunctious. Darly leads the Magicampers in an attempt to put up a surprise birthday party for Loomis.

episodes.name: Zippity Snap/Chiffen Tells a Tale
episodes.summary: A magical mistake by Loomis gives his power to Dracoon, but at the cost of his friend's powers. Chiffen pretends he can understand critters' speech like Loomis so that other Magicampers would see him as super-duper.

episodes.name: My Friend Cloudimus/The Magicamp Treasure Hunt
episodes.summary: Loomis and Fifi get into a tussle over who gets to play with Cloudimus. The Magicampers go on a search for pieces of a medallion scattered across the island.

episodes.name: A Sandy Situation/Big Bubble Trouble
episodes.summary: When the Magicampers build sand castles as their project, Loomis is fixated on an unseen yet legendary critter. Loomis uses his spell in an attempt to heal Chiffen who has a bruised paw, but, as a mistake, traps his buddy in a bubble.

episodes.name: The Pugness Monster/Butterflairy Friends
episodes.summary: Is the ever-elusive Pugness Monster finally showing itself? Darly and Fifi rival each other over who could better escort a Butterflairy on its way to its hibernation home.

episodes.name: The Nerds/The SquarePants Method
episodes.summary: Squidward's comic book becomes a Bikini Bottom hit. Mr. Krabs rents the Krusty Krab for a blockbuster film, excited about free publicity, and a famous actor arrives to play SpongeBob.

episodes.name: Kiss of the Nematode/Brainless Brawn
episodes.summary: When SpongeBob unknowingly breaks a witch's curse, its victim insists on being cursed again; Larry begins to emulate Patrick when he finds out about his secret super strength.

episodes.name: Home Away from Home/SpongeBob SpareParts
episodes.summary: The homes on Conch Street spring to life and embark on a quest to rescue Patrick's rock.

episodes.name: Lady in the Lighthouse/Bitter Groans and Gardens
episodes.summary: Squidward plays detective after a stranger vandalizes Mrs. Puff's Boating School. Later, he competes in a gardening contest but can't match SpongeBob's green thumb.

episodes.name: The Fry Cook and the Elves/It's About Mime
episodes.summary: Squidward tries to prove anyone can create a comic book and gains devoted fans. Meanwhile, an actor follows SpongeBob around to prepare for an upcoming movie role.

episodes.name: Plankton's Squeeze Play/How the West Was Dumb
episodes.summary: To get closer to the secret formula, Plankton swaps bodies with Squidward and must learn to adapt to his new lanky form; Sandy teaches SpongeBob cowboy skills while panning for bubbles, unaware Mr. Krabs is trailing them for treasure.

episodes.name: My Tighty Whiteys/What Ever Happened to Baby Prunes?
episodes.summary: SpongeBob goes on a desperate search after his favorite pair of underwear goes missing; Baby Prunes shares the story of her days as a child star to explain why she despises chocolate.

episodes.name: Night School Knuckleheads/Painfully Employed
episodes.summary: At night school, SpongeBob and Patrick dive into a series of classes on wildly different subjects; Plankton hires Bubble Bass at the Chum Bucket and realizes he can utilize him to get his hands on a Krabby Patty.

episodes.name: Duct Tape Dystopia/Farmer's Market Feud
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs repairs the Krusty Krab with duct tape, but quick fixes lead to a big headache. When he rents his parking lot for a farmer's market, the Planktons and Narwhals set up competing booths and reignite their family feud.

episodes.name: Clicking with a Clique/Rock Bottom Games
SpongeBob and Patrick's Timeline Twist-Up
episodes.summary: When Patrick's time closet goes on the fritz, SpongeBob's history is re-written by time traveling interlopers.

episodes.name: Laundro-Madness/ Hog Huntin'
episodes.summary: Squidward spends a day at the laundromat with his fellow Bikini Bottomites; SpongeBob and Patrick must track down Old Man Jenkins' prized worm hog.

episodes.name: SpongeBob TrashPants/ Krusty Kafeteria
episodes.summary: SpongeBob cleans up Bikini Bottom while the Krusty Krab crew takes over lunch duty at Pearl's school.

episodes.name: The Haunted Bucket/Go Fetch
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick have a spirited Halloween night at the Chum Bucket; Gary's favorite ball falls into monster-filled trench.

episodes.name: Heart of Garbage/ Near-Mint Plankton
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick must search for Squidward after the inside of his home turns into a vast garbage jungle; in his latest secret formula scheme, Plankton disguises himself as a collectible figurine and winds up trapped in.

episodes.name: Pardon My Wand / Stupor-stition
episodes.summary: Using a magic wand, SpongeBob creates magical mayhem in Bikini Bottom. Meanwhile, on Friday the 13th, Mr. Krabs' intense superstitions drive everyone around him crazy.

episodes.name: Pigskin Pearl
episodes.summary: Pearl becomes a star player after joining her high school football team.

episodes.name: The Green Tentacle/Happy Krabby Birthday
episodes.summary: Sandy asks Squidward to help heal her sick tree, but his alternative methods give her a headache. SpongeBob and Squidward search for the perfect birthday gift for Mr. Krabs.

episodes.name: Bizarro Bottom/Squidward's Tough Break
episodes.summary: SpongeBob falls asleep on the bus and ends up in a strange town full of Bikini Bottom doppelgangers. After Squidward loses his memory, he adopts a new tough guy persona.

episodes.name: Curse of the WereDoodle/Gorilla Suit Day
episodes.summary: DoodleBob bites SpongeBob, transforming him into a WereDoodle; SpongeBob dresses up for Gorilla Suit Day and mistaken for a real gorilla.

episodes.name: Exchange Student Driver / The Kreepy Krab
episodes.summary: Mrs. Puff sends SpongeBob far away to a driving school in Klopnod. / Slappy brings his macabre sensibilities to the Krusty Krab when he's hired there as a server.

episodes.name: Retreat!/Sidekick Search
episodes.summary: Patrick is mistaken for a corporate retreat leader; Patrick and Squidina hold auditions for a Patrick Show sidekick.

episodes.name: Make Yourself Pat Home/Accidentally in Love
The Barbarian Next Door/Runaway Patrick
episodes.summary: Pat the Hapless is banished to another dimension; Patrick leaves his old life behind and ends up accidentally adopting a new family.

episodes.name: Witless for the Prosecution/Time for the News
The Squid and the Square/The Over-Under
Patrick Alone... At Home/Seagull Scout Adventures
Sitcom Stars/The Show Must Go Yawn
episodes.summary: The Star family get trapped in a sitcom, where Cecil must keep his two bosses away from each other/Patrick struggles to keep his show going when Squidina gets injured.

episodes.name: The Dated Game/Ice Cream Headache
episodes.summary: When Granny Tentacles and Grandpat break up, Patrick and Squidina try to get them back together through a dating show/A savage beast is rampaging through Bikini Bottom eating all the ice cream

episodes.name: A Tinkle in Time/TV or Not TV
episodes.summary: Tinkle gets stuck in a time traveling adventure, traveling from one time period to another/Bunny and Cecil try spending "Spend Time with One of Your Kids Day" but Patrick and Squidina only want to watch TV.

episodes.name: Two Pests in a Teapot/Partial Recall
episodes.summary: As part of his neighborly duties, Patrick house sits for Granny Tentacles but everything goes wrong when he accidentally lets a pest loose/Plankton gets amnesia and gets adopted by the Dartfish family.

episodes.name: The Haunting of Flim-Flam House/Rube Tube
episodes.summary: The Flim-Flam Brothers are being haunted so Patrick and Squdina try to help them catch the mysterious ghost/ Squidina directs Rube's Show, causing Patrick to get jealous.

episodes.name: Terror on Tape
episodes.summary: The Stars rent haunted video tapes.

episodes.name: Visiting Vikings/It's Too Late... With Plankton
episodes.summary: Spongebob and Patrick travel to Viking times; Plankton hosts a talk show at the Chum Bucket.

episodes.name: In a Space Pickle/Stare Wars
episodes.summary: Captain Quasar uses Patrick to communicate with Aliens/ Grandpat and Patrick have a stare off

episodes.name: Sea Haw/Li'l Past-Cals
episodes.summary: The Patrick Show is countrified/The Kelpbed Kids travel to the future to retrieve their kicking can, but are met with one obstacle; themselves.

episodes.name: Slumber Party Stars/Doctor Patrick
episodes.summary: After accidentally putting on doctor's clothes, Patrick believes he's a medical professional/After Pearl can no longer have a sleepover with Squidina, the Stars throw Squidina a slumber party on their own

episodes.name: Zoo U/A Remembrance of Grand-Past
episodes.summary: The Stars visit the zoo; GrandPat spoils every movie.

episodes.name: Pat-tathlon/Upturn's Downturn
episodes.summary: The Patricks battle for control of the TV/Lady Upturn is given a court order to stay with the Star family for a week after a hit and run.

episodes.name: SmackDown Moves to 3 Hours
episodes.summary: Solo Sikoa defeated Jey Uso, Sami Zayn, and Jimmy Uso. Tiffany Stratton won the WWE Women's Championship from Nia Jax. Cody Rhodes fought Kevin Owens. #DIY's match against Motor City Machine Guns ended in chaos.

episodes.name: Table Tumble
episodes.summary: Bloodline v Cody Rhodes and Jimmy Uso; Women's title #1 contender match: Bayley v Bianca Belair v Naomi v Nia Jax; Women's US title: Chelsea Green vs Michin. U.S. title: Shinsuke Nakamura vs L.A. Knight.

episodes.name: Just Getting Started
episodes.summary: WWE Womens title: Tiffany Stratton vs Bayley; Jimmy Uso vs Carmelo Hayes. Motor City Machine Guns vs Los Garza; Solo Sikoa returns.

episodes.name: The Short Straw
episodes.summary: LA Knight vs Tama Tonga. Motor City Machine Guns vs Pretty Deadly. We hear from WWE Champion Cody Rhodes and Tiffany Stratton.

episodes.name: Destiny's Door
episodes.summary: 8-Man Tag: Motor City Machine Guns, Los Garza vs DIY, Pretty Deadly. U.S. Women's title: Chelsea Green vs Michin. Jimmy Uso vs Carmelo Hayes. Liv Morgan vs Naomi.

episodes.name: Royal Rumble 2025 Fallout
episodes.summary: Jimmy Uso vs LA Knight vs Drew McIntyre. Bianca Belair vs Piper Niven. Alexa Bliss vs Candice LeRae. Appearances by Royal Rumble winners Jey Uso and Charlotte Flair.

episodes.name: Happy Saint Valentine's Day 2025!
episodes.summary: WWE Womens title: Tiffany Stratton vs Nia Jax. Chelsea Green vs Naomi. Braun Strowman vs Damian Priest vs Jacob Fatu. Solo Sikoa returns.

episodes.name: I Want Your Soul
episodes.summary: The Rock returns. Tiffany Stratton vs Candice LeRae. Jimmy Uso vs Drew McIntyre. WWE Tag titles: DIY vs Pretty Deadly.

episodes.name: The Final Boss Entices Rhodes
episodes.summary: Tensions rise as wrestlers battle for gold. A heated face-off between The Rock and Rhodes sets the tone, while LA Knight seizes his moment. Chamber match looms large, and a friendship crumbles into bitter conflict.

episodes.name: Elimination Chamber 2025 Fallout
episodes.summary: In a night of intense matches, LA Knight claims the US title from Nakamura, while Rhodes confronts Cena's actions. Naomi reveals a shocking truth, Strowman and Sikoa's clash remains unresolved, and Green retains her title against Michin.

episodes.name: SmackDown in Barcelona
episodes.summary: For the first time ever, SmackDown came to Barcelona, Spain. WWE Tag titles: DIY vs Street Profits. MizTV with Cody Rhodes. B-Fab vs Charlotte Flair. Randy Orton vs Carmelo Hayes.

episodes.name: A Three-Way Collision
episodes.summary: SmackDown Live from Bologna, Italy. Face off between Punk, Reigns and Rollins. Liv Morgan vs Jade Cargill. Braun Strowman vs Jacob Fatu. Piper Niven vs Zelina Vega. Damian Priest vs Drew McIntyre.

episodes.name: You Deserve It
episodes.summary: Contract Signing: CM Punk, Roman Reigns, Seth Rollins. Street Profits vs Pretty Deadly. Alba Fyre, Piper Niven vs Katana Chance, Kayden Carter. U.S. title: L.A. Knight vs Braun Strowman.

episodes.name: Rise
episodes.summary: Last Man Standing: Braun Strowman vs Jacob Fatu. Rey Fenix Debut. DIY vs Motor City Machine Guns. Kevin Owens makes an announcement. CM Punk and Roman Reigns face-to-face.

episodes.name: Mania Ignites
episodes.summary: Cody Rhodes returns to SmackDown. Superstars face off in a Gauntlet Match to compete for the Women's Tag Team Championship at WrestleMania.

episodes.name: WrestleMania SmackDown
episodes.summary: Cody Rhodes hit Cross Rhodes on John Cena after their war of words on SmackDown's WrestleMania preview. Carmelo Hayes won Andre Battle Royal, Seth Rollins gave a pipe bomb promo.

episodes.name: WrestleMania 41 Fallout
episodes.summary: WWE Tag titles (Triple Threat TLC): DIY vs Street Profits vs MCMG. Randy Orton explains why he attacked John Cena. WrestleMania 41 fallout.

episodes.name: Caution
episodes.summary: Naomi attacked Stratton and Cargill after losing a tag match with Jax. Fatu assaulted Priest and Knight, while Black beat Miz with Black Mass.

episodes.name: Night Before One Last Time
episodes.summary: Randy Orton RKO'd John Cena before Backlash title match. Drew McIntyre Claymored Jacob Fatu in tag action. Nia Jax won #1 contender's match vs Jade Cargill. Alexa Bliss aided Zelina Vega against Green and Niven.

episodes.name: Backlash 2025 Fallout
episodes.summary: A thrilling SmackDown features Stratton retaining her title vs Jax, Mateo's debut win, McIntyre agreeing to a cage match, Cena vs Truth set for Saturday, and Sikoa and Bliss earning MITB spots through triple threat victories.

episodes.name: The Wyatt Sicks Return
episodes.summary: After a chaotic WWE Tag Team title match and brawl, The Wyatt Sicks attacked all teams. Giulia and LA Knight earned Money in the Bank spots via Triple Threat wins.

episodes.name: Words clash, brawls ignite
episodes.summary: Bianca Belair returns to her hometown. Money In The Bank qualifying matches continue. Cody Rhodes, John Cena meet face-to-face for the first time since WrestleMania.

episodes.name: Final Stop on the Road to Riches
episodes.summary: Cena and Paul ambushed Rhodes and Uso before Money in the Bank. Rollins, Breakker and Reed confronted MITB opponents. Women's MITB participants competed in six-woman tag match.

episodes.name: Money in the Bank 2025 Fallout
episodes.summary: King of the Ring Tournament: Randy Orton vs Carmelo vs Aleister Black vs LA Knight. Priest vs Rhodes vs Andrade vs Nakamura. Queen of the Ring Tournament: Nia Jax vs Michin vs Cargill vs Niven. Chelsea Green vs Flair vs Bliss vs LeRea

episodes.name: The Last Pipebomb
episodes.summary: John Cena vs R-Truth. Asuka vs Alexa Bliss. Randy Orton vs Sami Zayn. LA Knight vs Bronson Reed. Charlotte Flair vs Chelsea Green.

episodes.name: Punk Life
episodes.summary: On SmackDown, CM Punk channeled vintage John Cena with a rap diss. Tiffany Stratton defended her WWE Women's title, Giulia claimed the US Championship, while Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton had a cordial confrontation.

episodes.name: Night of Champions 2025 Fallout
episodes.summary: Tiffany Stratton chooses her next challenger. We see what's next for King and Queen of the Ring, Cody Rhodes and Jade Cargill.

episodes.name: Don't Be Jelly
episodes.summary: LA Knight kicks off the show. R-Truth vs Aleister Black. Tiffany Stratton, Trish Stratus facet-to-face. Fatal 4-Way: Sol Ruca vs Roxanne Perez vs Kairi vs Alexa Bliss. WWE Tag titles: Street Profits vs Wyatt Sicks.

episodes.name: Under One Roof
episodes.summary: Cody Rhodes, John Cena SummerSlam contract signing. Raquel Rodriguez vs Charlotte Flair. Fatal 4-Way tag. Stephanie Vaquer vs Alba Fyre. Jacob Fatu returns.

episodes.name: In Memory of Hulk Hogan
episodes.summary: WWE paying tribute to late great Hulk Hogan. WWE Tag titles: Wyatt Sicks vs Andrade, Rey Fenix. Roxanne Perez vs Alexa Bliss. Also featuring Randy Orton, Jelly Roll, and Drew McIntyre

episodes.name: Countdown to the Biggest Party of Summer
episodes.summary: Cody Rhodes, John Cena face-to-face. U.S. title: Zelina Vega vs Giulia. AAA Tag title match. Damian Priest vs Aleister Black. Talla Tonga vs Jimmy Uso.

episodes.name: SummerSlam 2025 Fallout
episodes.summary: SummerSlam Fallout. John Cena, Cody Rhodes vs Logan Paul, McIntyre. Chelsea Green vs Charlotte Flair.

episodes.name: Joined forces
episodes.summary: Jimmy Uso and Jacob Fatu get help against MFTS; McIntyre speaks about Rhodes attack; Street Profits and #DIY resolve issues; Miz returns to team with Hayes in Melo Don't Miss reunion.

episodes.name: Dublin Drama
episodes.summary: Stratton, Jade Cargill vs Becky, Nia Jax. Miz, Melo vs Motor City Machine Guns. John Cena appears. Street Profits vs JC Mateo, Tonga Loa.Charlotte Flair vs Piper Niven. Aleister Black vs R-Truth.

episodes.name: And New...
episodes.summary: Sami Zayn became the new United States Champion by dethroning Solo Sikoa in a thrilling match. Plus, John Cena tore into Logan Paul verbally, Drew McIntyre and Randy Orton got into a wild brawl and much more.

episodes.name: Nashville Nightmare
episodes.summary: Seth Rollins interfered in Rhodes/Orton vs Breakker/Reed match, helping the latter win. Cody hit Rollins with Cross Rhodes. Priest assisted Zayn in victory over Black.

episodes.name: Australian Anarchy
episodes.summary: Black wins Last Man Standing vs Priest. Zayn defends US title vs Nakamura. Wyatt Sicks defend tag titles vs Street Profits. Champions Stratton and Vaquer face Giulia and James.

episodes.name: Crown Jewel 2025 Fallout
episodes.summary: Cody Rhodes faced Drew McIntyre after Jacob Fatu was attacked backstage. McIntyre won by DQ. Ilja Dragunov defeated Sami Zayn for the US Championship, among other events.

episodes.name: Storm of Deceit
episodes.summary: After defeating Jimmy Uso in a No Disqualification Match, Drew McIntyre launched an assault on his opponent before also taking out Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes. Plus, Damian Priest helped Ilja Dragunov retain his championship against Aleister Black in a United States Title Open Challenge, and Jade Cargill unleashed a surprise attack on WWE Women's Champion Tiffany Stratton.

episodes.name: Signed, Sealed, Smashed
episodes.summary: Drew McIntyre put Cody Rhodes through a table after adding match stipulations. Dragunov kept US Title vs Frazer. Stratton and Cargill had intense confrontation. More events occurred.

episodes.name: The Scottish Exile
episodes.summary: Drew McIntyre was suspended from SmackDown after kicking a referee. Chelsea Green won the US Women's title from Giulia. Lash Legend appeared to join forces with Nia Jax.

episodes.name: Vision of Vengeance
episodes.summary: Drew McIntyre aided Breakker, Paul and Reed vs Rhodes and Usos at WarGames. Dragunov retained US Title against Axiom, Jey Uso beat Miz, Knight defeated Ryder in Last Time Tournament.

episodes.name: WarGames Wildcard
episodes.summary: AJ Lee and Becky Lynch join women's WarGame teams. Drew McIntyre massacres Cody Rhodes in vicious tour bus attack. Carmelo Hayes and Penta advances in The Last Time is Now Tournament and many more.

episodes.name: Final Countdown to War
episodes.summary: Solo Sikoa survived 5-on-5 match, then Wyatt attacked MFT's leader. Jey Uso and LA Knight won tournament matches. Charlotte Flair beat Asuka for WarGames advantage.

episodes.name: Survivor Series 2025 Fallout
episodes.summary: Gunther took down LA Knight in The Last Time is Now Tournament Final, earning his right to face John Cena in Cena's final match. Plus, Ilja Dragunov retained his United States Title against Carmelo Hayes, Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes demanded Drew McIntyre to be reinstated and much more.

episodes.name: Terror of Terror Twins
episodes.summary: Just 24 hours before his final match at Saturday Night's Main Event, we will take a special look at the career of John Cena. Plus The Terror Twins reunited in a major way as Damian Priest and Rhea Ripley defeated Aleister Black and Zelina in Mixed Tag Team action. Oba Femi confronted Cody Rhodes. United States Champion Ilja Dragunov def. Tommaso Ciampa. And many more.

episodes.name: New Year's Revolution
episodes.summary: Randy Orton, AJ Styles, and LA Knight battle for an opportunity to challenge Roman Reigns. ~Peacock episode description

episodes.summary: Bianca Belair vs Bayley. Cameron Grimes vs Grayson Waller. Angel Garza, Humberto vs LWO.

episodes.summary: LA Knight, AJ Styles, Randy Orton, Roman Reigns sign their Fatal 4-Way contract. Garza, Humberto, Escobar vs LWO. Women's Tag titles: Katana Chance, Kayden Carter vs Alba Fyre, Isle Dawn. Tyler Bate, Pete Dunn vs Pretty Deadly.

episodes.name: Ready To Rumble
episodes.summary: Womens Tag titles: Kayden, Katana vs Asuka, Kairi. Carmelo Hayes vs Austin Theory. Final Testament face to face with the Street Profits. Carlito vs Santos Escobar.

episodes.name: WWE Royal Rumble 2024 Fallout: The Decision
episodes.summary: With the Royal Rumble in the rearview, Cody Rhodes and Bayley choose their WrestleMania opponent.

episodes.name: Different Roads, Same Destination
episodes.summary: Triple H addresses the fallout from the WrestleMania press conference. Gargano, Tommaso vs Pete Dunn, Tyler Bate. Bianca Belair vs Michin. Bayley talks Damage CTRL.

episodes.name: Bloodline Cooks
episodes.summary: The Rock and Roman Reigns look for an explanation. Kevin Owens vs Dominik. The Miz vs Logan Paul. Zelina Vega vs Tiffany Stratton. Alba Fyre vs Naomi.

episodes.name: Heading Into Perth
episodes.summary: LA Knight vs Drew McIntyre. Bron Breakker makes his Smackdown in-ring debut. Tyler Bate, Pete Dunne vs Dominik, JD McDonagh. Street Profits vs Authors of Pain.

episodes.name: Elimination Chamber 2024 Fallout
episodes.summary: The Rock responded to Cody Rhodes with a counter challenge for a high-stakes tag team match on Wrestle Mania Saturday. Plus, Randy Orton got a hand from Kevin Owens against Austin Theory and so much more.

episodes.name: The Answer
episodes.summary: Randy Orton, Kevin Owens vs Austin Theory, Grayson Waller. Cody Rhodes, Seth Rollins answer The Bloodlines challenge. Bobby Lashley vs Karrion Kross.

episodes.name: Home of the Blues
episodes.summary: Dakota Kai vs Bayley. Randy Orton vs Grayson Waller. LWO vs Legado Del Fantasma. Pretty Deadly vs Catch Republic. Rey Mysterio returns.

episodes.name: Once Again
episodes.summary: Roman Reigns, Cody Rhodes come face-to-face. Iyo Sky vs Naomi. Rey Mysterio vs Santos Escobar. Street Profits vs AOP. Grayson Waller, Austin Theory vs The OC.

episodes.name: The Arrival
episodes.summary: Bianca Belair vs Dakota Kai. Randy Orton, Kevin Owens vs Pretty Deadly. Tag Team Championship Qualifying matches. Jade Cargill makes an appearance.

episodes.name: WrestleMania SmackDown
episodes.summary: Jey Uso vs Solo Sikoa. Andre The Giant Battle Royal. KO Show with Randy Orton. Zelina Vega vs Elektra Lopez. New Catch Republic vs Waller, Theory.

episodes.name: WrestleMania XL Fallout/Motor City Celebration
episodes.summary: WrestleMania 40 Fallout. Triple Threat: Rey Mysterio vs Kevin Owens vs AJ Styles. Triple Threat: LA Knight vs Bobby Lashley vs Santos Escobar.

episodes.name: On a Mission
episodes.summary: Smackdown Women's title: Bayley vs Naomi. AJ Styles vs LA Knight. Fatal 4-Way Tag: Authors of Pain vs Street Profits vs Pete Dunne, Tyler Bate vs Umberto, Garza.

episodes.name: 2024 WWE Draft: Night 1
episodes.summary: Cody Rhodes, AJ Styles sign their Backlash contract. Rey Mysterio, Dragon Lee vs Humberto, Garza. Night 1 of the 2024 Draft.

episodes.name: Friday in France
episodes.summary: Kevin Owens, Randy Orton present The RKO Show. Cody Rhodes, AJ Styles come face to face. WWE Tag titles: A-Town Down Under vs Street Profits. Authors of Pain vs New Catch Republic.

episodes.name: King and Queen of the Ring Continues
episodes.summary: Randy Orton vs AJ Styles. Bianca Belair vs Candice LeRae. Jade Cargill vs Piper Niven. Carmelo Hayes vs Baron Corbin.

episodes.name: King and Queen of the Ring Quarterfinals
episodes.summary: Randy Orton vs Carmelo Hayes. Bianca Belair vs Tiffany Stratton. LA Knight vs Tama Tonga. Jade Cargill vs Nia Jax.

episodes.name: King and Queen of the Ring Semifinals

episodes.name: Impossible Ancient Structures
episodes.summary: Ancient structures worldwide are so massive, precise, and mysterious they seem impossible even today. How did ancient civilizations accomplish engineering feats that still puzzle modern experts?

episodes.name: Nightmares and Dreams
episodes.summary: Dreams have inspired humanity for thousands of years, and in all this time, we have yet to answer one fundamental question: What is the purpose of dreams?

episodes.name: Unnatural Disasters
episodes.summary: Throughout history, catastrophic disasters have reshaped civilizations - yet some events defy all scientific expectations. Are some of Earth's deadliest catastrophes truly natural - or - unnatural?

episodes.name: Mysteries of Africa
episodes.summary: Africa is the birthplace of humanity and remains one of the most mysterious continents on Earth. What secrets lie hidden throughout Africa's vast and unexplored ancient landscape?

episodes.name: Mind Over Matter
episodes.summary: The human mind is home to all our thoughts, hopes, dreams, and memories. But are there people who are "wired" differently than most of us? Can unique circumstances permit some to tap into extra-sensory abilities that defy nature?

episodes.name: Mighty Kingdoms Unearthed
episodes.summary: Throughout civilization there are many kingdoms and mighty empires that have risen, only to one day fall. What can we discover from clues left behind by these once great empires?

episodes.name: Dangerous Places
episodes.summary: Every year, people risk their lives to enter places the world has marked off-limits. What is it about the world's most dangerous places that makes them impossible to resist?

episodes.name: Satan's Army
episodes.summary: Throughout history, terrifying tales describe supernatural forces threatening humanity—from demonic possessions and haunted houses to ghostly soldiers and age-old deals with the Devil.

episodes.name: Top Secret Projects
episodes.summary: Governments have historically conducted classified projects beyond imagination—from experimental aircraft and staged deceptions to covert experiments violating ethical standards.

episodes.name: Mystery of the Dinosaurs
episodes.summary: Dinosaurs have fascinated scientists for nearly two centuries, and in all that time, we have yet to answer even the most basic questions about how these animals lived, how they died, and what became of them.

episodes.name: The Lost World of the Aztecs
episodes.summary: Five centuries after the fall of the Aztec Empire, new discoveries are revealing that this lost civilization may have been far more sophisticated—and far stranger—than history has long suggested.

episodes.name: Objects of Power
episodes.summary: Throughout history, certain objects have been believed to possess extraordinary powers—healing the sick, legitimizing rulers, and influencing the destiny of entire nations.

episodes.name: Unnerving Nature
episodes.summary: Around the world are places where nature behaves mysteriously. Forests where travelers get lost, deserts with communication issues, caves with dangerous air, and mountains that remain unclimbed due to extreme conditions.

episodes.name: Deadly Ancient Curses
episodes.summary: Throughout history, people have believed that ancient curses can bring misfortune, madness, and death to those who disturb them.

episodes.name: Alien Close Encounters
episodes.summary: An exploration of strange and inexplicable mysteries. Contributions from scientists, historians and witnesses as they seek to shed light on how the impossible can happen.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Pyramids
episodes.summary: Why did so many ancient people, separated by oceans and centuries, return to the same monumental shape? Were pyramids simply the most practical way to build toward the sky--or could they reveal a deeper pattern of sacred knowledge?

episodes.name: The Golden Age of Pirates
episodes.summary: The exploits of pirates during the Golden Age of Piracy as they become infamous legends through heists and buried treasures still unfound.

episodes.name: Impossible Ancient Inventions
episodes.summary: Ancient technologies seemingly too advanced for their eras are examined, questioning if modern innovations merely reinvented long-lost creations and where those inventions disappeared.

episodes.name: The Lost
episodes.summary: People disappear mysteriously, from iconic figures like Amelia Earhart to entire groups. These strange disappearances, lacking definitive explanations, have fueled numerous theories over time, captivating global attention.

episodes.name: Alien Contagion
episodes.summary: Invisible microorganisms threaten Earth as potential pathogens travel through space. Humanity faces risk of extraterrestrial pandemics despite modern science's progress against earthly diseases.

episodes.name: Ancient Bible Relics
episodes.summary: Bible relics are investigated to verify if they provide physical evidence for biblical events and miracles. Experts examine artifacts claimed to be from the Bible, assessing their authenticity and potential divine power.

episodes.name: Islands of the Damned
episodes.summary: There are islands around the world, despite their scenic and tranquil beauty, evoke nothing but fear and dread. Islands riddled with dark histories, tragedy, and the belief that they are cursed. Islands of the Damned?

episodes.name: Tales From Antarctica
episodes.summary: Isolated along the southernmost part of the planet, Antarctica is best known as the frozen continent. Yet, this untouched land has captivated brave explorers for centuries.

episodes.name: Robot Revolution
episodes.summary: For thousands of years, mankind has been fascinated by the idea of creating mechanical servants to make our lives easier. Today, those dreams of the past are increasingly becoming our reality.

episodes.name: Secret Societies
episodes.summary: Secret societies like the Mafia, Skull and Bones, and Freemasons have long been thought to control global events from the shadows, meeting privately and guarding dangerous secrets.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Spies
episodes.summary: Throughout history, powerful nations around the world have enlisted spies to serve as unique tools of warfare. These secret agents are often tasked with infiltrating organizations and even performing the act of assassination.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Civil War
episodes.summary: From rumors of lost treasure and haunted battlefields, to mysterious premonitions and secret societies, could these intriguing tales shed new light on America's darkest days?

episodes.name: Mysterious Urban Legends
episodes.summary: Urban legends are modern folklore rooted in mystery where chilling tales merge fact and fiction and blur the line between myth and reality.

episodes.name: Mad Scientists
episodes.summary: Throughout history, there have been men of science who pushed the boundaries of experimentation to the edge of madness. What led these mad scientists down a strange, dark path in their pursuit of knowledge?

episodes.name: Strange Tales from the American Frontier
episodes.summary: From the 17th to the early 20th century, America saw an unprecedented era of rapid western expansion. Millions moved west to lay claim to find their fortunes in gold and land for the taking in search of the American Dream.

episodes.name: Terrors of the Deep
episodes.summary: Could these terrifying creatures prove that some of our most horrifying myths and legends about monsters of the deep - are real?

episodes.name: Unlocking the Sixth Sense
episodes.summary: Across cultures and centuries, there have been people who claim to have been gifted with mysterious powers of the mind. Can scientists find the secret to unlocking these remarkable gifts?

episodes.name: The World's Deadliest Assassins
episodes.summary: Throughout history, assassins have killed leaders and sparked global conflicts with single strikes. Have these killers merely played minor roles, or have they actually shaped humanity's course?

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Underground
episodes.summary: Beneath our feet lie hidden ancient tunnels, sacred caves, and shadowy passages into a world of darkness shaped by nature, carved by man, and steeped in myth. Are these underground realms mere remnants of the past?

episodes.name: Episode #4.47

episodes.name: Stay for A-Wild
episodes.summary: Jack McBrayer explores unique American homes, visiting a shoe-shaped house, an eco-friendly off-grid dwelling, and a famous music producer's retreat.

episodes.name: Where the Trolls Live
episodes.summary: Jack explores remarkable homes, a packed mansion with a 25-seat theater, a mine shaft-inspired house on 300 acres of land, and a mountain retreat featuring jungle themes and hidden rooms.

episodes.name: The Good, the Bad, the Wild
episodes.summary: Jack is back on the hunt for the wildest homes, starting with a recently purchased homestead that puts the wild in Wild West. He also visits a quirky, whimsical house, a sailor's dream dwelling that is ready for new owners.

episodes.name: We Need to Steal a Chair
episodes.summary: Jack explores a mansion with French countryside architectural elements and decorative flourishes.

episodes.name: Episode #2.5
episodes.summary: Jack continues his trip across the US and explores a grandiose castle, a re-imagined church, and a sprawling ranch; an open house welcomes potential buyers, but only one can be crowned the wildest of the bunch.

episodes.name: Episode #2.6
episodes.summary: Jack's search for wild homes continues with more houses for sale: an artist's Technicolor high-rise and a serene angelic retreat; he visits a newly bought round home that has no flat walls or angles.

episodes.name: Episode #2.7
episodes.summary: Jack's adventure leads him to more unique homes: a former mobster's compound, a sprawling manor created by a beer mogul and an engineer's techy dream; an open house where one adventurous buyer could snatch up their new property.

episodes.name: Episode #2.9
episodes.summary: Triple Domes, Marble Mansion, and a Real Arizona Ghost Town

episodes.name: Episode #2.10
episodes.summary: Jack finds a home for sale inspired by sci-fi movies, plus another in Taos, New Mexico, known as the Adobe Castle that doubles as an art museum; he also visits an earth home bought by a woman who drove 14 hours to make an offer on it.

episodes.name: Ándale
episodes.summary: A few years after high school, Rue's debts finally catch up with her. Hoping to finance her dream wedding, Cassie tries to become internet famous - to the disapproval of Nate, who's juggling the demands of running Cal's business.

episodes.name: America My Dream
episodes.summary: Rue takes up work at Alamo's strip club. Cassie looks for help from Maddy.

episodes.name: The Ballad of Paladin
episodes.summary: Cassie and Nate have an emotionally charged and chaotic wedding, while Rue deepens her involvement in a dangerous criminal business. Jules navigates her relationship with a wealthy benefactor, and Nate confronts his father.

episodes.name: Kitty Likes to Dance
episodes.summary: Rue is offered a risky deal that draws her deeper into Alamo's world. While Nate battles the city council, Maddy gives Cassie a mission that could skyrocket her new career. Lexi enlists Jules to create an original painting for LA Nights.

episodes.name: This Little Piggy
episodes.summary: She would never say it out loud, but Nate going broke finally granted Cassie permission to follow her dreams.

episodes.name: Stand Still and See
episodes.summary: Rue makes a deal with the devil in the form of a promise to Alamo...and gives a word of warning to Maddy. Later, Cassie gets her first real taste of stardom on the set of LA Nights, and Rue paints Jules a picture of her ideal future.

episodes.name: Rain or Shine
episodes.summary: Under intense financial pressure, Maddy schemes to get Cassie back in the spotlight. Meanwhile, Rue obsesses over the sign God gave her.

episodes.name: In God We Trust
episodes.summary: Fate has arrived. Rue reckons with her actions, which forces her to look back on not just her regrets, but the memories that saved her along the way.

episodes.name: Trying to Get to Heaven Before They Close the Door
episodes.summary: Rue and Jules cross paths for the first time since Christmas as East Highland rings in the new year.

episodes.name: Out of Touch
episodes.summary: As the semester kicks off, Jules questions Rue and Elliot's new friendship. The lines between fantasy and reality begin to blur as Kat considers her relationship.

episodes.name: Ruminations: Big and Little Bullys
episodes.summary: Maddy considers getting back together with Nate, Rue pursues a new business venture as she helps to form a friendship between Jules and Elliot.

episodes.name: You Who Cannot See, Think of Those Who Can
episodes.summary: At Maddy's birthday party, relationships are celebrated and questioned. Jules turns to Elliot for advice. Cal takes a trip down memory lane.

episodes.name: Stand Still Like the Hummingbird
episodes.summary: Fate has a way of catching up with those who try to outrun it.

episodes.name: A Thousand Little Trees of Blood
episodes.summary: As relationships with mothers are tested, Rue tries to recover. Nate enjoys his newfound freedom.

episodes.name: The Theater and Its Double
episodes.summary: Art imitates life as the East Highland crew watches their complicated dynamics reflected in Lexi's long-awaited play.

episodes.name: All My Life, My Heart Has Yearned for a Thing I Cannot Name
episodes.summary: Snippets of memory collide with the present and future.
