With major structural issues plaguing them, can they still afford to give this flip the high-end transformation it needs?

episodes.name: Tampa: Leila
episodes.summary: Dolmar and the team can't believe their luck when they get a lead on a home in the desirable and family friendly South Tampa neighborhood. This growth infested, four-bedroom, roofless zombie is right up the team's alley. But, when Dolmar runs afoul of the local permit office, he begins to wonder if his luck's run out.

episodes.name: Tampa: Golden
episodes.summary: Dolmar has found a Zombie house with an interior that looks more like a rotten avocado than a home. With black growth, weak framing, and a garage conversion that would give an architect heartburn, the Zombie team faces one of their toughest challenges yet. Can they transform this eyesore into a dream home?

episodes.name: Tampa: Knollwood
episodes.summary: When Dolmar's contractor friend Jay offers him the chance to partner on a deal that "can't fail", Dolmar doesn't hesitate to agree to cover all the renovation costs. This three bedroom, two bath house in the Rivergrove area is just the sort of zombie Dolmar and his team dream of. But, when the renovation costs keep growing, and their problems keep multiplying, Dolmar begins to feel less and less "friendly" about his arrangement.

episodes.name: Tampa: Conniewood
episodes.summary: Dolmar and the team get a lead on a large single family home in the Tampa suburb of New Port Richey. This nearly 3000 square foot house needs a new roof and a lot of updates. Dolmar can't believe the price is so low, while Amanda and Keisha believe that means the risk for disaster is high. Can they turn this house into the pride of Port Richey? Or will it be a total bust?

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Mini Marvels
episodes.summary: Two small zombies seem like they are the perfect choices for easy flips and some quick cash. Unfortunately, these decrepit zombies have more problems than first thought, testing the team's ability to stay on budget and time.

episodes.name: Back to the Flip_ Clash of the Builders
Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Keith-ing it Real
episodes.summary: Keith puts it all on the line when he takes the lead on two projects that might have him in over his head.

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Makeover Mayhem
episodes.summary: The team faces a zombie with an mysterious odor, a pool turned swamp, and building materials that are impossible to find. Next, a dilapidated zombie overwhelms the team with emergencies, testing their ability to remain cool under pressure.

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Rocket Rehabs
episodes.summary: The team finds a "granny home". But another individual claims to be the rightful buyer. Then a zombie becomes available that has the makings of a sweet party pad. But the flip hits a snag when a torn down wall proves to be structural.

episodes.name: Dallas: Arcadia
episodes.summary: Derek and Chauncey take on a zombie house that was abandoned by previous flippers. Left with holes in the roof, termite damage and a dilapidated porch this nightmare house pushes their skills, and budget, to the limit.

episodes.name: Dallas: Lake Cliff
episodes.summary: Derek sees big profit potential when he buys a crumbling old house in a nice neighborhood. Chauncey is skeptical of the half-finished work and the small square footage. With possible high reno costs, hardwood hardships, and missing air conditioning, was this all a big mistake to take on this zombie?

episodes.name: Dallas: Stillwater
episodes.summary: Derek takes Chauncey to see a house in the super desirable North Dallas neighborhood. Even though this smaller home has foundation issues, Derek feels it's too much of a deal to pass on. But when Chauncey gets her heart set on panoramic doors, will the extra cost tip the scale on an already tight renovation budget?

episodes.name: Orlando: Harding
episodes.summary: Duke stumbles upon a potential diamond in the rough estate sale that piques the interest of Keith and Alynne. The team ventures out to discover the zombie house that sits on an overgrown jungle of a yard, where a detached unit in the back is hidden among the weeds. Despite its rough appearance, they soon see the potential for a lucrative flip. But as they begin tearing the walls apart, they quickly realize their initial excitement was misplaced. As the flip spirals out of control, Keith and Alynne face mounting financial pressures and a timeline that is way over budget.

episodes.name: Tampa: Wall Street
episodes.summary: An overextended Dolmar and his team take on a botched flip in South Tampa. But when delays plague the timeline, he recruits his wife Keisha to help manage the project and sees dollar signs as local house prices soar. But when the team is faced with bathroom nightmares, termite terrors, and permit issues, will they build back better or will they crumble?

episodes.name: Tampa: Water Oak
episodes.summary: Dolmar's got a steal of a deal in Port Richey. But after they pull up to this 90s Era Time capsule, they discover that vandals, roaches, and water damage have had their way with the interior. Dolmar decides to recruit his wife Keisha to help out with this Zombie. But will she be enough to help him turn this Port Richey Pad into a Palace?

episodes.name: Dallas: Glenhill
episodes.summary: In an ideal Dallas neighborhood, a ramshackle bungalow with some vandalism and a faulty foundation falls in Derek and Chauncey's laps. A friend of theirs needs help with a flip and only has two weeks to complete this job. If they can't get this done quickly they may lose 40k and a friendship.

episodes.name: Tampa: Pinehurst
episodes.summary: Dolmar buys a zombie sight unseen, shocking his business partner Sam, especially having known there may be a sinkhole under the property, threatening the profitability of this flip. With this sinkhole and other stresses getting Dolmar worried, he brings his wife Keisha aboard to act as the renovation's project manager, hoping she'll be able to keep this renovation moving forward, on time and on budget.

episodes.name: Tampa: Waikiki
episodes.summary: Dolmar receives a tip on a hot home in the desirable Palm River neighborhood, so he and Amanda head over to scope it out. Even though the home has several suspect additions and termite damage, Dolmar feels the deal is too good to pass on. But, while converting a back office room into a new bedroom, Dolmar and his team run into a series of electrical and bad DIY jobs that could put the team's chance for any profit into jeopardy.

episodes.name: Dallas: Carriage
episodes.summary: Looks can be deceiving. This Derek special is set in a posh neighborhood on a tree-lined street and from the outside it doesn't look like your typical Zombie. But once Derek and Chauncey step inside, this 2,800-square-foot ranch home quickly becomes a house of hidden horrors. Will the foundation, leaky pipes, and backyard pool torpedo their budget and sink their profits?

episodes.name: Tampa: Brookway
episodes.summary: A zombie in an upscale neighborhood appears welcoming from the outside, but years of water damage, black growth, and a battered roof, will really put Dolmar, Keisha and Amanda to the test. Will this be their most challenging flip?

episodes.name: Tampa: North 17th
episodes.summary: Keisha is apprehensive about the team's next zombie since it isn't in the best of neighborhoods--which may hurt the potential resale. Add to that a bad foundation and the discovery of live termites, and this potential flip seems more like a potential flop.

episodes.name: Tampa: Clearbrook
episodes.summary: Dolmar thinks he hit a home run purchasing a zombie in a desirable community outside Tampa. But as the team starts to renovate, it's quickly discovered that this house is going to need a ton of work. Like a new roof, new windows, new flooring, new fencing, and an industrial clean out of the in-ground pool.

episodes.name: Tampa: 58th Avenue
episodes.summary: The zombie team has their work cut out for them when they discover a 3bed/2bath might be missing a bedroom. Termites, collapsing ceilings and some surprises might just be a budget-buster.

episodes.name: Dallas: Whittenburg
episodes.summary: Chauncey and Derek team up with Project Manager, Albert on a Zombie in the desirable North Dallas neighborhood. But with giant holes in the floor, roaches, and all sorts of unspeakable muck, the budget and timeline quickly balloon. Will the team be able to get this house done on time to stay on their budget? Or will they get stuck holding onto a shell of a cockroach infested zombie?

episodes.name: Tampa: Peppertree
episodes.summary: When Dolmar and the team get a deal on a 4 bedroom two bath from one of Dolmar's lender contacts in the suburb of Port Richey, it seems too good to be true. And when the market shifts, it is causing Dolmar and his team to have to make a hard decision.

episodes.name: Tampa: Takomah
episodes.summary: An exciting former rental property dream house turns into a nightmare when everything that can go wrong, does. From rotted roof trusses, damaged water heaters and countertops, and an exploding budget, the team will really have to think out of the box to solve this property puzzle.

episodes.name: Tampa: River Grove
episodes.summary: Dolmar found a steal of a deal with a house that backs onto the Hillsboro River and has a ton of potential. But the team quickly realizes that this mid-century home hasn't been updated since the Cold War. With termite damage and a potential mold issue, the Zombie team has to scramble to keep this riverfront property from sinking their bottom line.

episodes.name: Tampa: Linden
episodes.summary: When Dolmar and the crew decide to take on this next zombie, little did they realize the challenges they would meet: foundation concerns, delivery delays, flooding and even an injury to a teammate all jeopardize the potential of flipping this house in the allotted 45 days.

episodes.name: Tampa: Wesson Circle
episodes.summary: Dolmar and his team are flipping their first townhouse in the Greater Carrollwood suburb of Tampa. With challenges such as cracked walls, sinking floors, and outdated features, they face an uphill battle to transform the property. Will they flip this townhome on budget? Or will their bottom line sink with the foundation?

episodes.name: Tampa: Roxboro
episodes.summary: Dolmar and his team stumble upon a potentially great investment opportunity in Hudson, Florida. It seems like a great deal until they see the fire damaged garage. With terrible smells and melted garage doors, the Zombie team wonders if this investment will go up in smoke.

episodes.name: Tampa: SW 66th Place
episodes.summary: Dolmar's frequent collaborator Anthony was able to buy a house at land value in Bushnell Florida. Dolmar jumps at the opportunity, but when the team checks the Zombie out, it's a shell of a house. The roof is rotted, the walls are gone. It's all block walls, 2x4 studs, and rusted pipes. Is the team biting off more than they can chew in this dilapidated shoebox?

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Big Money Flips
episodes.summary: Will the Team lose their profits and their minds when the homeowner (and Duke's friend) meddles in all of their decisions? And then, can the Team keep a hi-tech buyer happy long enough to make a huge profit?

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Ancient Revivals
episodes.summary: Will adhering to the historic district's strict ordinances force this flip over budget because of the high cost of the historical materials? And then, can a property with 100 years of problems be fixed on time and budget?

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Biohazard Rehabs
episodes.summary: The first zombie is so bad the only salvageable parts are the exterior walls and roof, which means a huge budget that keeps going up. Then a house so disgusting the team returns with hazmat suits. Can they rehabilitate the uncleanable?

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Risky Ren-Oh!
episodes.summary: Duke finds a home that was botched and abandoned mid-flip. He runs the project, but at what cost? Then, a home with a prime spot and a horrible layout. Ashlee's big designs threaten to blow the budget wide open.

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Commission Impossible
episodes.summary: The Orlando team tackles two of the toughest flips they have ever encountered, contending with time, weather, and even monsters.

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Haunted Havens
episodes.summary: The Team tackles two haunted flips that are sure to make the crew abandon ship due to the creepy occurrences they run into. Will this cause the team to finally put a halt to flipping their Zombies now that they have to deal with Ghosts?

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Un-Real Estate
episodes.summary: The Team explores what looks like a castle, but building codes and permitting woes could derail everything. Then, the team finds something buried in a yard, will it bring treasure or trouble?

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Massive Makeovers
episodes.summary: The Zombie team has two colossal projects, with issues so severe they threaten to tear the team and their profits apart. Will the stream of problems lead to disaster, or will they defy the odds, unveiling makeovers of massive proportions?

episodes.name: Zombie House Flipping Back to the Flip: Ashlee Takes the Lead
episodes.summary: Ashlee is in charge, putting aside her Realtor role and stepping into one of lead designer and builder on these Zombies. Will all her grand ideas and improvements bring a pretty profit, or break the bank?

episodes.name: Bots, Bioengineering and Bacteria
episodes.summary: Join a high school robotics team as they participate in a robotics competition. A Bioengineer uses titration to find out how much Vitamin C is in three different juices. Find out why foxes scream. Nabeel goes cave diving to find new microbes.

episodes.name: Blacksmithing, Bone Histology and Better Diagnostics
episodes.summary: Erica discovers the science behind blacksmithing. Learn how climate change is impacting our oceans. A Paleontologist teaches us about bone histology. Nabeel meets a woman creating a diagnostic lab - in a suitcase.

episodes.name: Touching, Talking & Taking Care of Giraffes
episodes.summary: A computer scientist making virtual reality you can feel. Dr. Brain explains how your mind uses language. A cosmetic chemist makes us cream blush. Fig discovers how to care for the world's tallest land mammal, the giraffe.

episodes.name: Mentorship, Music, and Methods of Observation
episodes.summary: Discover how valuable mentorship in STEM can be. Learn how musical instruments use science to make noise. Protect your teeth from demineralization. Fig goes kayaking to find out more about observational research.

episodes.name: Delta Waves, Deodorant, and Dazzling Metal Work
Cheese, Creating Porus Scaffolds and Clean Water
Sports Injuries, Solving Biases and Skunks
Flavors, Fossils and Finding Cures
episodes.summary: Nabeel meets a flavor chemist who uses chemistry to create tasty treats. We get an up close look at an ancient bird-like dinosaur - the Archaeopteryx. Discover the neuroscience behind why you're afraid of failure. And a pediatric cardiologist shows us how a hologram of a patient's heart can help her perform surgery.

episodes.name: Cats, Chemistry, and Climate Change
episodes.summary: Nabeel discovers how desert cats survive in harsh environments. A bioengineer uses chemistry to find how much vitamin c is in her juice. Discover how climate change is impacting our oceans, and find out about environmental dangers hiding in your city.

episodes.name: Dating, Dinos, and Dinner of the Future
episodes.summary: Join a high school robotics team as they participate in a robotics competition. Discover how animals "date" in the wild kingdom. The "Punk Rock Paleontologist" teaches us about bone histology. A Graduate researcher shows how to use insects to reduce meat consumption.

episodes.name: Skincare Routine, Self-Identity and Singing Robots
episodes.summary: Erica discovers the technology that's changing the future of cosmetic clinical trials. Discover the neuroscience behind how you see yourself. We build robots that play us a little song. And Fig visits an astrophysicist to learn about telescopes.

episodes.name: Science of Cheesemaking, Soft Circuits and Soccer
episodes.summary: Erica heads to Wisconsin to meet a scientist who specializes in cheese making. Dr. Brain busts common myths about our minds. Computer engineer Christina Ernst explains the magic of e-textiles, or "soft" circuits. And we meet three women saving professional soccer stars from ACL injuries.

episodes.name: Noggins, Nucleotides, and Nuclear Fusion
episodes.summary: Discover how engineers crash test sports gear like helmets. Discover the neuroscience behind your assumptions. Meet a bioengineer who shows us how PCR tests work. And Erica meets a woman making nuclear fusion a reality.

episodes.name: Putting, Paleontology, and Perfecting Code
episodes.summary: Erica hits the green to learn how understanding math can make you better at golf. Our favorite Punk Rock Paleontologist shows us the tech that helps her study fossils. How can we use our brain to help control our emotions? And Nabeel meets a woman encouraging young girls to get creative with computer coding.

episodes.name: Changing Bacteria, Color Theory, and Cute Opossums
episodes.summary: Meet a woman editing bacteria DNA with CRISPR technology. Our favorite dental duo shines a light on the chemistry of teeth whitening. Meet North America's only native marsupial. And Fig meets sports medicine physician Dr. Monica Rho.

episodes.name: Surgeries, Scaffolds, and Short Games
episodes.summary: Nabeel meets a veterinary neurologist who shows him how she repairs spinal fractures. Discover the neuroscience behind why you're afraid of failure. A bioengineer teaches us about the future of medicine with porous scaffolding. And Erica discovers how math can help her short game in golf.

episodes.name: Chemistry of Neon, Concussions and Computer Engineering
episodes.summary: Erica discovers the science behind creating neon signs with chemist Danielle Bonnet. Learn about the tools you need to do paleontology fieldwork. Dr. Brain explains how your brain reacts to pain. Nabeel meets a computer engineer working with AI.

episodes.name: Conserving Artwork, Catalase Enzymes, and Counting Seconds
episodes.summary: Science in art conservation. Liver enzymes and bioengineering. Our perception of time. A mobile science lab.

episodes.name: Faces, Foxes, and Finding Your Voice
episodes.summary: Technology in Cosmetic Chemistry. What are foxes saying? The neuroscience of stress. A vocologist helps performers find their voice.

episodes.name: Bright Bacteria, Bird Fossils, and Building a Better Future in Tech
episodes.summary: Nabeel meets a woman editing bacteria with CRISPR gene technology. Our Punk Rock Paleontologist shows us one of the world's oldest birds - the Archeopteryx. Astro Athena shares her tips on how to make the most of your stargazing. Learn how an organization is making tech more inclusive.

episodes.name: Creating Catastrophes, Creeping Rocks, and Cute Snakes
Bugs, Brain Food, and Brilliant Gemstones
episodes.summary: Nabeel meets an entomologist studying how environments affect our insect neighbors. Discover instruments engineered to mimic the sounds of nature. Dr. Brain explains how food fuels our brains. Learn how a gemologist uses chemistry, physics, and math to determine if gemstones are real or imposters.

episodes.name: Studying Music, Seeing Skunks, and Smashing Helmets
episodes.summary: Discover how studying music in school helped one woman find her way towards a career in STEM. Say hello to Jam Jar the skunk as we learn about aposematism - or warning colorations on animals. Our favorite dental duo shows us the science behind keeping our teeth strong. Discover how engineers crash test sports gear like helmets.

episodes.name: Catching Neutrinos, Climate Science, and Chile Life Development
episodes.summary: Nabeel goes deep underground to search for tiny particles known as neutrinos. Our resident wildlife expert shows us the smarter side of raccoons. Atmospheric Scientist Maiya May shares how climate change is warming our oceans. Discover how Child Life Specialists help sick kids in hospitals feel better through the power of play.

episodes.name: Preparing for Disasters, Paleontology, and Preserving Paintings
episodes.summary: Nabeel discovers how creating disasters can help save lives. Code robots to play Chopsticks. Learn about the tools in a paleontology field kit. Mina Porell and Dr. Rosie Grayburn teach Nabeel about all the science and technology that is used to Analyze and conserve paintings.

episodes.name: Spinal Surgery, Singing, and Searching the Ocean
episodes.summary: Nabeel meets a veterinary neurologist who shows him how she repairs spinal fractures, then we discover the math behind music. Dr. Brain busts common myths about our minds, and Fig finds out how one expert explores the ocean's depths.

episodes.name: MOdeling, Mobility, and Mining
episodes.summary: A computer scientist shows us how our perception of something can vary from reality, and an engineer shows us how she's building the next generation of self-driving wheelchairs. Jackie Means makes an egg that can bounce, then we learn about the explosive science behind limestone mining.

episodes.name: Lizards, Lovelace, and Living Underwater
episodes.summary: A herpetologist helps us lasso lizards - for research. And, meet the woman who helped make computers a reality. Then, Chef Claire uses science to help us bake, even when our pantry isn't fully stocked. And we discover the technology that keeps scuba divers safe underwater.

episodes.name: Pikas, Planets, and Panic Attacks
episodes.summary: An ecologist introduces us to an adorable animal called the Pika. Dr. Moiya McTier teaches us about exoplanets. Dr. Brain give us tricks to calm our anxiety. And two Tribologists explain the sticky science of friction.

episodes.name: Coasters, Crystals, and Chemical Engineering
episodes.summary: Discover the physics that make roller coasters a fun ride. Then, Michelle Barboza makes us bismuth crystals. We meet an engineer who's used to making machinery more reliable, and discover a chemical engineer who wants to put human tissue on a microchip.

episodes.name: Filtering Water, Frog Babies, and Firefighting
episodes.summary: Civil engineer demonstrates water purification process for cities. Explores how animals transport newborns. Miranda discusses Jupiter's Europa moon. Erica visits Colorado firefighting team.

episodes.name: Conserving Cats, Creating Faces, and Crafting Robots
episodes.summary: An animal care curator shows us how she's helping to conserve small desert cat populations. Dr. Brain reveals why you sometimes see faces in inanimate objects. Then, we get crafty - building morse code robots. And, we meet a textile engineer who's making the sustainable fabric of the future.

episodes.name: Skydiving, Secreting Poison, and Skyscrapers
episodes.summary: Nabeel faces his fears and learns the physics behind indoor skydiving. Miranda spills the STEM tea on why Honey is such a magical food. We take a Nature Side Quest to discover the weird ways animals use poison and venom in the wild kingdom, and Erica visits a construction site to see how STEM helps build skyscrapers.

episodes.name: Protecting Infrastructure, Programming Your Brain, & Pop Music
episodes.summary: Meet an engineer who does her work...underwater. Then, learn how to build yourself a robot who brews you tea. And, does your brain need language to think? Dr. Brain can explain. Plus, discover how science helps one woman create hit pop songs.

episodes.name: Hot Peppers, Heating Magnets, & How Animals See
episodes.summary: Nabeel learns how one team grows the spiciest peppers on the planet. Electric Kat shows us how a magnet's power can change with heat. Miranda spills the STEM tea on how animals see the world. And a sports performance coach shows us how she uses science to help athletes stay in good shape.

episodes.name: Aerobatics, Aggression & Articulate Canines Co-piloting, Cute Aggression & Canine Speech
episodes.summary: Nabeel takes a hair-raising ride with an aerobatic pilot. Dr. Brain tells us why we might feel aggression when we see something cute. Your friendly neighborhood cosmetic chemist shows you the chemistry behind under eye gels. And Fig meets a woman studying how dogs understand human language.

episodes.name: Terminal Velocity, Transporting Babies, & Translating Morse Code
episodes.summary: Nabeel faces his fears and learns the physics behind indoor skydiving, and we get crafty - building morse code robots. Take a Nature Side Quest to discover how animals transport their newly born babies, then meet an engineer who does her work...underwater.

episodes.name: Prosthetics, Probscises, & Particle Physics
episodes.summary: Meet a woman engineering prosthetic legs for disabled dogs. Miranda spills the STEM Tea on trailblazing volcanologist Katia Krafft. A doctor teaches us about the hidden second nose on our face. Then, discover the physics that makes your eyeshadow shimmer.

episodes.name: Skateboarding, Skincare, and Snakes
episodes.summary: Fig discovers the physics of skateboarding. A cosmetic chemist shows us how she creates cream blush. A software engineer helps us code a robotic holiday decoration. Two conservationists head to the desert in search of rare snakes.

episodes.name: Theater Engineers, Triboluminescene, and Technologists
episodes.summary: Nabeel meets two engineers who make Broadway shows possible. And, join us on a Nature Side Quest to discover some of the animal kingdom's best mimics. Then, Electric Kat shows us the brilliant power hidden in quartz. Plus, a technologist teaches us how gathering better data can improve delivery services.

episodes.name: Unusual Attitudes, Unexpected Faces, and Upgrading Tea Time
episodes.summary: Nabeel takes a hair-raising ride with an aerobatic pilot. Dr. Brain reveals why you sometimes see faces in inanimate objects. A craft loving software engineer helps us build a robot that brews tea. And, we meet a woman engineering prosthetic legs for disabled dogs.

episodes.name: Cheerleading, Cooking & Chemistry
episodes.summary: Fig meets cheerleaders using physics to improve their athletic skills. An eye opening segment on the immune privilege of your eyeballs. We discover the science of making the fluffiest pancakes possible. And Nabeel tests his skills in karate and chemistry.

episodes.name: Scoville Units, Soothing Eyegels, and Skate Sceince
episodes.summary: Nabeel learns how the spiciest peppers on the planet are cultivated. Your friendly neighborhood cosmetic chemist shows you the chemistry behind under eye gels. We take a Nature Side Quest to discover some of the animal kingdom's best mimics. Then, Fig learns the physics of skateboarding.

episodes.name: Crash Testing, Cleansers, and Conserving Kelp
episodes.summary: Fig meets a crash test engineer. Dr. Brain ranks top brains of the animal kingdom. A cosmetic chemist makes facial cleanser. Erica explores kelp as future fuel.

episodes.name: Animatronics, Antiperspirants, and Apiarists
episodes.summary: Nabeel enjoys a behind the scenes look at how animatronic figures are made. Discover the truth about how antiperspirants and deodorants work. Learn how some food combos can help our bodies absorb more nutrients. Then, Fig finds the secret science to raising bees.

episodes.name: Gamma Waves, Gelling Hair & Greeting Sharks
episodes.summary: Meet a woman studying what dancing can teach us about brain waves. Your friendly neighborhood cosmetic chemist whips us up some hair gel. Harini Bhat teaches us about how our bodies ingest medications, and Erica comes face to face with a Frilled Shark.

episodes.name: Pedicures, Pets, and Privacy
episodes.summary: Fig learns about giraffe care. Experts discuss pet-safe lawn maintenance and air fryer science. Erica explores online privacy protection.

episodes.name: Vehicle Safety, Venomous Animals, and Volcanoes
episodes.summary: Fig learns about the technology that makes crash test dummies so smart. Esther Ikoro teaches us about poison and venom in the animal kingdom, Miranda spills the STEM Tea on volcanologist Katia Krafft, and Nabeel discovers the technology used to make drinking water safe.

episodes.name: Creating Animatronics, Cute Aggression, & Composting
episodes.summary: Discover the art and engineering behind making animatronics. Dr. Brain explains why cute things can make us aggressive. Electric Kat shows us "cold light" from quartz. And Fig uncovers the science happening inside a composting bin.

episodes.name: Engineering in Playgrounds, Engaging Brains, and Earth's Rotation
episodes.summary: Visit a STEM playground, how does your brain learn, what would happen if Earth stopped spinning, and fly in Zero-G.

episodes.name: Soft Circuits, Selecting Partners and Spelunking
episodes.summary: Discover the engineering that makes urban greenspaces possible. A software engineer introduces us to the fabulous world of soft circuits. Discover how animals "date" in the wild kingdom. Nabeel goes spelunking to uncover unique microbes.

episodes.name: Blood from the Mummy`s Tomb
episodes.summary: Professor Fuchs discovers the sarcophagus of an Egyptian queen known to have been a sorceress. The queen's spirit possesses Fuchs's daughter who is born at the exact same time. Years later, the evil spirit takes complete control of her.

episodes.name: The Skull
episodes.summary: Author and collector Christopher Maitland comes into possession of the skull of the Marquis de Sade, not believing it is cursed.

episodes.name: Flight 7500
episodes.summary: Passengers board a flight from LAX to Tokyo, Japan. Lance Morrell, a dealer in rare dolls, carries a wooden box containing a doll of a Japanese kami of death, which can be compared to a Grim Reaper. It turns out to be all too real.

episodes.name: King Kong vs Godzilla
episodes.summary: Godzilla awakens from hibernation and heads straight to Japan to stomp Tokyo. A pharmaceutical advertiser decides he wants his own monster. He has King Kong captured on its island and brought to Tokyo to battle with Godzilla.

episodes.name: War of the Colossal Beast
episodes.summary: Glenn Manning returns after his alleged death, now a disfigured, brain-damaged monster.

episodes.name: The Gorgon
episodes.summary: Dr Namaroff tries to keep secret who he suspects is responsible for the unusual deaths taking place at a German village where he has practiced medicine the past seven years. The victims have always been found to have turned to stone.

episodes.name: Dracula w/French DVD Score
episodes.summary: Count Dracula sets sail for Englund in search of redder pastures but runs afoul of vampire expert Professor Van Helsing when he arrives there.

episodes.name: Dinoshark
episodes.summary: A baby prehistoric shark thaws from the ice near the Arctic. Three years later, the now huge adult beast swims down the western coast of North America and begins to terrorize the waters off of Puerto Vallarta, Mexico.

episodes.name: The Mist
episodes.summary: Military experiment goes wrong opening a door to another dimension. A thick white mist pours through enveloping the nearby town. Within this mist are deadly, terrifying and monstrous creatures.

episodes.name: The War of the Worlds
episodes.summary: Creatures from the planet Mars invade the Earth using death ray wielding war machines.

episodes.name: Son of Frankenstein
episodes.summary: Upon the death of his father, Baron Wolf von Frankenstein returns to claim the family estate. Soon after his arrival, he discovers the monster his father created still lives.

episodes.name: Friday the 13th
episodes.summary: A new batch of camp counselors plan to reopen the old Crystal Lake summer camp. However, someone begins killing them one by one.

episodes.name: The Mummy`s Hand
episodes.summary: High priest Andoheb revives the mummy Kharis using tana leaves. He sends the now revived mummy out to kill those who defiled Kharis's tomb

episodes.name: House on Haunted Hill
episodes.summary: Frederick Loren and his wife invite five people to spend 24-hours in an allegedly haunted creepy old house they've rented for a party. If the guests survive those hours in the house, they will each be paid $10,000.

episodes.name: An American Werewolf in London
episodes.summary: David and Jack, two American students on a walking tour of Great Britain, are attacked one stormy night by a wolf. Jack is killed. David ends up in hospital. Jack returns from the dead to warn his friend he will now turn into a werewolf.

episodes.name: The Car
episodes.summary: A mysterious black car terrorizes a small desert town causing multiple deaths.

episodes.name: Parents
episodes.summary: Tonight's House of Svengoolie presents a film about a boy who imagines his parents are using a Soylent Green-style cookbook. Features quirky humor and movie trivia. Viewer discretion advised.

episodes.name: How to Make a Monster
episodes.summary: Insane movie studio make-up artist creates a special make-up which allows him to hypnotize actors and turn them into real monsters.

episodes.name: Frankenstein and the Monster from Hell
episodes.summary: Baron Frankenstein lives in hiding as a surgeon in an insane asylum, using the alias Dr Victor. He holds incriminating evidence on the corrupt and perverted asylum director and uses his position to continue his experiments in creating life

episodes.name: First Men in the Moon
episodes.summary: Inventor Joseph Cavor develops a substance that negates gravity, Cavorite. He builds a spherical diving bell-like ship to make a voyage to the moon. Once there, he and his companions discover a not too friendly race of humanoid insects

episodes.name: Rosemary`s Baby
episodes.summary: After moving into a gothic building of apartments in Manhattan, called the Bramford, a young recently married woman eventually discovers her neighbors belong to a coven of devil-worshippers.

episodes.name: Dr Cyclops
episodes.summary: In a jungle lab, Dr Thorkel invents a machine capable of shrinking living creatures using radium. After inviting 4-scientists and their guide to show off the device, the insane doctor decides to use it to shrink them to the size of dolls.

episodes.name: Earth vs the Spider
episodes.summary: A giant spider is discovered in a large cave. Sprayed with DDT and thought dead, the creature awakens and rampages through the nearby town causing death and destruction.

episodes.name: Curse of the Demon
episodes.summary: American psychologist who doesn't believe in the supernatural comes to England for a conference. He runs afoul of Dr Julien Karswell, master of the occult, who is able to summon a demon to destroy anyone who crosses him.

episodes.name: Idle Hands
episodes.summary: Slacker Anton lives carefree with his parents and friends Mick and Pnub until murders strike their town. On Halloween, he wakes to find his parents killed. Blamed initially, he learns his right hand has a murderous will of its own.

episodes.name: The Time of Their Lives
episodes.summary: During the Revolutionary War, Horatio Prim and Melody Allen try to warn George Washington about Tom Danbury's treason. Soldiers mistakenly shoot them as traitors, throw their bodies in a well and a curse traps their spirits to the estate.

episodes.name: Destroy All Monsters
episodes.summary: All the Earth's monsters have been placed on Monster Island where they can't escape. Aliens take control of the monsters and release them to attack major cities all over the world.

episodes.name: Invisible Agent
episodes.summary: The grandson of Frank Griffin has the formula for invisibility. A Nazi and his sadistic Japanese enforcer try to get Griffin to help the Third Reich. Griffin decides to join the allies and parachutes into Nazi Germany as an invisible spy.

episodes.name: Village of the Giants
episodes.summary: 11-year-old science geek invents a food substance which causes animals to grow larger. Some drug addled teens decide to eat some of it and become 30-foot giants. They also decide to take over the small town and terrorize the locals.

episodes.name: Swamp Thing
episodes.summary: In a secret swamp facility, Dr. Alex Holland experiments with plant and animal DNA. Government agent Alice Cable assists with security.

episodes.name: The Night Stalker
episodes.summary: Reporter Carl Kolchak suspects a real vampire is the cause of numerous deaths in Las Vegas, Nevada.

episodes.name: Captain Kronos Vampire Hunter
episodes.summary: Capt Kronos and his hunch-backed assistant, Prof Grost, hunt down and destroy vampires wherever they find them. They learn of a village where young women are drained of their youth and die as old crones. The two decide to investigate.

episodes.name: Man Made Monster
episodes.summary: After surviving an accidental electrocution, Dan McCormick comes to the attention of Dr Rigas. His idea is to create an army of supermen immune to the effects of electricity to do his bidding. Dan McCormick makes the ideal test subject.

episodes.name: The Land Unknown
episodes.summary: On a naval expedition to Antarctica, three men and a woman reporter crash-land in a crater below sea level. There they find a steamy tropical forest, dinosaurs, carnivorous plants and human footprints.

episodes.name: The Raven
episodes.summary: Dr Vollin is a brilliant but unstable surgeon with a morbid obsession for Edgar Allan Poe. He performs surgery on Jean Thatcher, a beautiful young socialite injured in an automobile accident, becoming equally obsessed with her.

episodes.name: Trilogy of Terror
episodes.summary: Anthology of three tales of terror.

episodes.name: The Wizard of Oz
episodes.summary: A tornado whisks young Dorothy Gale away and deposits her in the magical Land of Oz where she meets new friends and crosses an evil witch.

episodes.name: The Invisible Man Returns
episodes.summary: Frank Griffin's brother, Geoffrey, is wrongly convicted of murder and imprisoned. A doctor injects him with an invisibility serum to help him escape. One side effect of the serum is madness as Griffin attempts to find the real killer.

episodes.name: Munster, Go Home!
episodes.summary: The Munsters travel to England so Herman can collect his inheritance. 60th Anniversary year

episodes.name: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
episodes.summary: A small-town doctor discovers his patients are being replaced by emotionless alien lifeforms. 70th Anniversary year

episodes.name: This Island Earth
episodes.summary: A scientist from Earth is recruited by aliens from a war-torn planet.

episodes.name: Abbott and Costello Meet Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
Dracula's Daughter
episodes.summary: When Countess Marya Zaleska appears in London, mysterious events occur that lead Dr. Von Helsing to believe that the Countess must be a vampire.

episodes.name: 20 Million Miles to Earth
episodes.summary: A wealthy couple joins an expedition to find the supposedly surviving Gill Man. After capturing and accidentally injuring him, they perform surgery enabling him to breathe on land, leading to new conflicts and challenges.

episodes.name: The Curse of the Werewolf
episodes.summary: This British adaptation based on the novel, "The Werewolf of Paris" by Guy Endore, is a brutal cult horror favorite that casts Oliver Reed as a young 18th-century Spaniard who has an adverse reaction to the moon.

episodes.name: Sssssss
episodes.summary: A mad herpetologist develops a drug which can turn a human into a cobra. He continues his experiments with the drug on his unwitting newly hired assistant.

episodes.name: Teenagers from Outer Space
episodes.summary: Aliens from another planet decide to use Earth as a breeding ground for giant monsters called Gargons.

episodes.name: The War of the Gargantuas
episodes.summary: Twin giant monsters cause havoc in Japan. The green water-dwelling one is evil while its brother, the brown mountain-dwelling one, is docile. They spend most of the movie battling each other.

episodes.name: Bram Stoker's Dracula
episodes.summary: When Count Dracula sees a photo of Jonathan Harker's fiancee, he realizes she looks exactly like his long dead lover.

episodes.name: The Lost World
episodes.summary: An explorer leads an expedition seeking living dinosaurs on a mysterious South American plateau. His beliefs are confirmed when the group ventures into an ancient realm where prehistoric creatures still roam.

episodes.name: The Deadly Mantis
episodes.summary: A massive ancient mantis emerges from Arctic ice and attacks US military bases along the DEW Line before heading southward, devouring personnel.

episodes.name: It Came from Outer Space
episodes.summary: In Sand Rock, Arizona, astronomer John Putnam and girlfriend Ellen see something crash nearby. At the impact site, John finds a metallic sphere with a hatch, but an avalanche buries the discovery before he can investigate further.

episodes.name: Munchies
episodes.summary: An archaeologist finds a creature in Peru and brings it to the US. His evil twin kidnaps it, but it turns violent when harmed. His son's attempt to destroy it in a snack machine backfires, creating more creatures attracted to women.

episodes.name: Willard
episodes.summary: A young man, fed up with being controlled by a powerful figure, retaliates by commanding an army of rats. His revenge unfolds through waves of ruthless rodents.

episodes.name: Mysterious Island
episodes.summary: During the Civil War a group of Union soldiers, a Confederate and a civilian escape the stockade using a hot-air balloon and end up on a strange Pacific island.

episodes.name: Kingdom of the Spiders
episodes.summary: In rural Arizona, countless killer tarantulas are migrating through a farm town, killing every living thing in their path. The town's veterinarian will do everything in his power to survive the onslaught.

episodes.name: The Ghost of Frankenstein
episodes.summary: Dr. Frankenstein's plans to replace the brain of his monster are hijacked by his scheming and malevolent assistant Ygor.

episodes.name: The Blair Witch Project
episodes.summary: Three film students vanish after traveling into a Maryland forest to film a documentary on the local Blair Witch legend, leaving only their footage behind.

episodes.name: The Mummy
episodes.summary: In 1895, British archaeologists find and open the tomb of Egyptian Princess Ananka with nefarious consequences. Starring Peter Cushing and Christopher Lee.

episodes.name: The Haunted Strangler

episodes.name: Son of Dracula
episodes.summary: A Southern plantation hosts a party for Count Alucard, who arrives mysteriously late. After the host's mysterious death, his daughter Catherine inherits Dark Oaks mansion and shocks all by marrying the Count.

episodes.name: Village of the Damned
episodes.summary: In the English village of Midwich, the blonde-haired, glowing-eyed children of uncertain paternity prove to have frightening powers.

episodes.name: Day of the Dead
episodes.summary: As the world is overrun by zombies, a group of scientists and military personnel sheltering in an underground bunker in Florida must decide on how they should deal with the undead horde.

episodes.name: Frankenstein Meets the Space Monster
episodes.summary: A Martian princess and a doctor plan to replace the women on Mars, destroyed by atomic war, by raiding Puerto Rico while a shot down android terrorizes all.

episodes.name: The Return of the Vampire
episodes.summary: Scotland Yard's Sir Fredrick reviews 24-year-old notes about a vampire case. Lady Jane must prove she staked a real vampire, not murdered someone. A bombing raid revives the creature, forcing his werewolf servant back into service.

episodes.name: Invaders from Mars
episodes.summary: A boy sees a UFO land in his backyard sandpit. After his father investigates and returns changed, more people exhibit similar cold behavior. The boy teams up with a psychologist and astronomer to uncover an alien threat.

episodes.name: The Black Cat
episodes.summary: Stranded honeymooners follow mad doctor to manor.

episodes.name: Earth Girls Are Easy
episodes.summary: A heartbroken manicurist shelters three furry aliens who crash into her pool. After makeovers help them blend in, romance blooms between her and one alien, but her ex's interference and legal troubles threaten their safety.

episodes.name: The Black Scorpion
episodes.summary: Two geologists investigating earthquake damage in Mexico discover giant scorpions terrorizing a village. Their search for the creatures' lair leads to encounters with locals and a final confrontation in Mexico City.

episodes.name: Werewolf of London
episodes.summary: After botanist Wilfred Glendon travels to Tibet in search of a rare flower, the Mariphasa, he returns to a London haunted by murders that can only be the work of a bloodthirsty werewolf. Henry Hull and Warner Oland.

episodes.name: Horror of Dracula
episodes.summary: When Jonathan Harker rouses the ire of Count Dracula for accepting a job at the vampire's castle under false pretenses, his friend Dr. Van Helsing pursues the predatory villain.

episodes.name: The Curse of Frankenstein
episodes.summary: While awaiting execution for murder, Baron Victor Frankenstein tells the story of a creature he built and brought to life, only for it to behave not as he intended. Starring Peter Cushing and Christopher Lee.

episodes.name: Leprechaun
episodes.summary: An evil, sadistic Leprechaun goes on a killing rampage in search of his beloved pot of gold. Starring Warwick Davis, Jennifer Aniston and Ken Olandt.

episodes.name: Dead of Night
episodes.summary: A man restores a 1926 car and mysteriously travels to the past during his first drive. His brief journey unexpectedly impacts his present-day life.

episodes.name: The Ghost and Mr Chicken
episodes.summary: A bumbling typesetter sees his chance to become a reporter by solving a murder case, leading him to spend a terrifying night in a house reputed to be haunted.

episodes.name: What Ever Happened to Baby Jane?
episodes.summary: A faded child vaudeville performer terrorizes her paralyzed sister, a successful film actress, in their deteriorating Hollywood home while yearning for her return to stardom.

episodes.name: Them!
episodes.summary: Giant mutant ants terrorize New Mexico after atomic testing. Police, FBI, and scientists investigate mysterious deaths and destruction, racing to stop the massive insects before they spread to populated areas.

episodes.name: Officer Down
episodes.summary: When a beloved officer is shot and killed during a routine traffic stop, detectives work hard to bring justice for him. The team races against the clock to find the ruthless killer before he strikes again.

episodes.name: When the Music Stops
episodes.summary: When an aspiring rapper is found dead during a violent shootout at the Metropolitan Studios in Atlanta, detectives must follow a trail of lies, ultimately discovering a cold-blooded betrayal at the heart of the murder.

episodes.name: The Star Recruit
episodes.summary: When a 17-year-old military recruit and homecoming queen is gunned down outside her home, the community is stunned; as detectives look closer into those around her, they uncover a complex web of relationships that may lead to her killer.

episodes.name: Death Outside the Ring
episodes.summary: When world champion boxer Vernon Forrest is gunned down in cold blood, all hands are on deck to bring justice for the fallen Atlanta icon; APD detectives must figure out if this shooting was random or a result of the victim's celebrity status.

episodes.name: Death in Powder Springs
episodes.summary: After a 23-year-old suburban Atlanta mother is shot and left for dead in front of her infant daughter, investigators unravel a complicated scheme involving someone close to the victim, shocking the Powder Springs community.

episodes.name: Voice from the Grave
episodes.summary: A Delta retiree is found fatally stabbed in her suburban Atlanta home. Investigators find a note she wrote before death that points them to her murderer.

episodes.name: A Mother Murdered
episodes.summary: Twin daughters find their mother stabbed to death in their suburban home, the pressure for detectives to deliver justice is on. When the shocking truth behind the murder comes out, the Atlanta community is left stunned and heartbroken.

episodes.name: Homicide on the Ranch
episodes.summary: When an Atlanta-area horse trainer abruptly vanishes from his ranch, police search for the missing father-to-be, ultimately discovering a salacious secret where untamed passions may have led to the victim's untimely demise.

episodes.name: American Nightmare
episodes.summary: When an African immigrant is found tortured and murdered in his West End home, Atlanta detectives uncover a string of violent crimes tied to a terrifying criminal syndicate that the team must take down in order to restore peace to the Big Peach.

episodes.name: Killer in the Community
episodes.summary: An Atlanta civil rights icon is shot dead in his front yard and police must determine if his high-profile stature may have made him a target; as detectives race to find the killer, the pressure is on to bring justice to this fallen hero.

episodes.name: Search for a Monster
episodes.summary: Atlanta's tight-knit Chinatown community is devastated when a beloved mother is discovered brutally murdered in an industrial parking lot; with few leads, the team discovers a cryptic note that leads them to a surprising killer.

episodes.name: House of Horrors
episodes.summary: When a young mother of two disappears just a few weeks before Halloween, detectives scour an upscale Atlanta neighborhood for clues, only to uncover a gruesome crime scene that haunts the community to this day.

episodes.name: Murder Behind the Badge
episodes.summary: When a beloved suburban Atlanta police officer is found shot execution-style in her bed, investigators must probe both her personal life and her role in the community to uncover the shocking identity of her killer.

episodes.name: Murder at the Mall
episodes.summary: After a naval reservist is gunned down in her car outside an Atlanta mall, detectives pour over video footage, phone records and forensic evidence, only to discover that the DNA sample found at the crime scene creates an unforeseen twist in the case.

episodes.name: Caught in the Crossfire
episodes.summary: Two friends are murdered near Atlanta's Blue Flame club. Police uncover a complex plot involving an unexpected shooter and a shocking co-conspirator.

episodes.name: Blood Betrayal
episodes.summary: When a beloved matriarch and businesswoman is found shot to death in her palatial home, investigators uncover a trail of deception and betrayal that leads to a killer whose identity stuns the community and the victim's family alike.

episodes.name: My Deadly Valentine
episodes.summary: A Valentine's Day rendezvous in an Atlanta-area park turns deadly, and investigators race to find the killer of a beloved husband and cub scout leader; when detectives reveal the mastermind behind the brutal slaying, the community is left speechless.

episodes.name: Nightmare at the Racetrack
episodes.summary: Teen Colombian immigrant disappears at Atlanta Motor Speedway car show. After extensive search yields nothing, mysterious tip reveals victim's location and unexpected perpetrator.

episodes.name: Terror in the Suburbs
episodes.summary: When an 11-year-old boy finds his mother brutally slain in their suburban Atlanta condo, detectives begin a desperate search to find the woman's killer, only to discover that this murder is the work of a serial killer.

episodes.name: In Cold Blood
episodes.summary: A young mother is assassinated by a disguised assailant in front of her toddler in a crowded parking lot. When detectives uncover video footage of the killer, an unlikely witness IDs the shooter as someone surprisingly close to the victim.

episodes.name: Twice as Deadly
episodes.summary: A young mother in the quiet Atlanta hamlet of Buford is found shot to death in what detectives deem to be a staged suicide; as investigators search for leads, they uncover an eerily similar death linked to someone with close ties to both victims.

episodes.name: Dead End
episodes.summary: The police discover a body wrapped in duct tape on church grounds in the posh neighborhood of Buckhead, Atlanta; detectives must untangle a web of romance, jealousy and deceit to uncover who killed a beloved father of two.

episodes.summary: Clark and Lois get poundcake. A stranger comes to brunch. Jimmy gets to be right. Hank shakes things up at Lexcorp.

episodes.name: The Death of Clark Kent
episodes.summary: Lois and Jimmy confront Kara and make a plan to rescue Clark. Meanwhile, Brainiac delves into Superman's mind to figure out what makes him tick...and how to tear him apart.

episodes.name: Pierce the Heavens, Superman!
episodes.summary: Jimmy and Kara race back to Metropolis to stop Brainiac's invasion of Earth; Lois tries to free Clark from Brainiac's control, only to lose herself in an alternate reality where Superman never left Krypton.

episodes.name: My Adventures with Supergirl
episodes.summary: Superman, Kara, Lois, and Jimmy team up to fight Brainiac; Superman has to choose between saving Earth and saving the people he loves; it's truth, justice, and a better way clashing with the might of Krypton.

episodes.summary: With financial rumors in the headlines, Pinky feels the pressure rising; A questionable claim has the ladies on edge as Cynthia lines up a girls' getaway; Porsha attempts to keep her dating life fresh; Dennis stays firmly on her plate.

episodes.name: Reunion Part 2

Angela faces off in one final round of unforgettable reads. The tension between Porsha and Shamea proves that some friendships are beyond repair.

episodes.name: Peace, Interrupted

Cynthia hosts her annual Bailey-Que, but this time with a twist.

episodes.name: Reunion Part 3

episodes.name: Music City Mayhem
episodes.summary: Eight food trucks arrive in Music City to compete in culinary challenges inspired by Nashville's music scene. Teams hunt for local ingredients on Broadway while battling for sales supremacy and survival.

episodes.name: The Tennessee Whiskey Trail
episodes.summary: Host Tyler Florence leads seven teams to Franklin, Tennessee. A taste challenge tasks teams with creating a three-item food flight. Truck troubles and stress threaten teams before Tyler reveals tight sales margins.

episodes.name: Knoxville Crowd Crawl
episodes.summary: Tyler Florence brings six teams to Knoxville, TN, for a three-event race. Teams sell to University of Tennessee game day crowds, then serve attendees at the Rossini Opera Festival.

episodes.name: The Great Gatlinburg Smoke Off
episodes.summary: Five food trucks compete in Gatlinburg, TN, in Tyler Florence's smoky challenge. One team member per truck rides a chairlift up a mountain to get a smoked ingredient. Rashad Jones judges the grilling redemption round.

episodes.name: Surviving Savannah
episodes.summary: Host Tyler Florence kicks off an action-packed, eight-city ride, starting in Savannah with nine food trucks and racing up America's Southern Atlantic Coast. Baseball's funnest team, the Savannah Bananas, raise a ruckus, and as the trucks tackle their banana-themed challenge, a clear front-runner emerges. On the final sales day, three teams must fight for their lives to stay in the race. The season's first elimination brings a shocking, never-before-seen surprise.

episodes.name: Crushing Charleston
episodes.summary: Seven food trucks hit Charleston, S.C., and Chef Kardea Brown shows no mercy as she judges their attempts at Gullah Geechee dishes. Then, host Tyler Florence releases the teams to sell on the wild streets of Charleston, revealing who's ready for the hard sell and who falls way short. Finally, facing torrential rains, Chef Rodney Scott brings his signature BBQ to the teams to see who can make a dish worthy of a real pitmaster.

episodes.name: Son of a Myrtle Beach
episodes.summary: Host Tyler Florence unleashes the food trucks onto the boardwalk in Myrtle Beach, S.C., where one team blows past the competition and makes an enemy in the process. Teams that previously led the pack plummet in the rankings while one team skyrockets from the bottom to the top. Then, the real shock comes at elimination when a fan favorite gets the worst possible news.

episodes.name: Wilmington Revenge
episodes.summary: It's payback time as host Tyler Florence brings the trucks to Wilmington, N.C., and two teams with a serious beef attempt to settle the score. Meanwhile, another team gets shut down by county officials, jeopardizing their chances of staying in the race. All the trucks fight to win a breakfast challenge worth $15,000 in reward money, and this week's eliminated team gets served an ice-cold plate of revenge.

episodes.name: Darlington Dash
episodes.summary: Host Tyler Florence gives the food trucks a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to dash around Darlington Raceway in South Carolina and cook for NASCAR's Mamba Smith and Todd Gilliland. One team wins their first challenge but follows it up by making a shocking decision with devastating results. No one is prepared for the shocking outcome of this week's elimination.

episodes.name: Yes, Virginia, There is a Beach
episodes.summary: Host Tyler Florence leads the trucks to Virginia Beach, Va., where one team's past catches up to them despite their best showing in the race yet. The strongest competitors conspire against each other, one of them to great success.

episodes.name: Bad News in Newport News
episodes.summary: The final three teams have no idea that host Tyler Florence is evaluating their food truck workflow in a secret surveillance challenge in Newport News, Va. He shuts the loser down for an hour, but his penalty comes with a silver lining. The top two teams both blow challenges they could have easily won, and one truck sets an all-time sales record.

episodes.name: Norfolk Fork-off
episodes.summary: Host Tyler Florence kicks off the finale with the two winningest teams in Great Food Truck Race history competing in a sales frenzy, feeding the sailors of a Nimitz-class aircraft carrier in port at Naval Station Norfolk in Virginia. After the sailors are fed, the trucks move to town, and one team misses the perfect sell spot by just a few feet, with unforeseen consequences. In the final challenge, one team proves they've truly outperformed the rest, but it all comes down to sales to see who will win $50,000 and the title of Great Food Truck Race champion.

tt3530232.title: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver

episodes.name: ICE
episodes.summary: John Oliver examines ICE's recent atrocities across multiple states and investigates the Department of Homeland Security-its origins, leadership, and how it may be undermining national safety.

episodes.name: Twitter
episodes.summary: John Oliver examines Twitter's decline under Elon Musk's ownership, its ongoing influence on society, and its connection to the 30-40 trillion cells that make up the human body.

episodes.name: Police Body Cameras
episodes.summary: The opening consists of a commentary on the behaviour of the current FBI director, including his trip to the Olympics. The main story relates to police body cameras and their pros and cons and shows examples of how they can be misleading.

episodes.name: Iran, USAID & Soap Operas
episodes.summary: John Oliver covers U.S.-Israel strikes on Iran, Trump Administration cuts to USAID, and his envy of Stephen A. Smith-or rather, Brick.

episodes.name: JD Vance
episodes.summary: John Oliver examines Trump administration's conflicting messages on the Iran war, then investigates VP J.D. Vance's evolving ideologies and the key figures who shaped his current beliefs.

episodes.name: Police Stings
episodes.summary: John Oliver covers the week's Iran war events, the administration's inconsistent narratives, a woman's self-realization, and examines how police stings may generate more crime than they prevent.

episodes.name: Hungary
episodes.summary: Viktor Orbán, who rules Hungary since 2010, provides blueprints for MAGA by controlling all media, banning all references to the LGBTQ+ community, offering cash for more births, jailing political foes, and other autocratic actions.

episodes.name: Prediction Markets
episodes.summary: John Oliver examines prediction markets where people bet on everything from sports to geopolitics. These platforms avoid gambling regulations, and two major sites have the president's son as an advisor.

episodes.name: AI Chatbots
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses the uncertainty of war in Iran and why the FBI director isn't drinking on the job. He then explores how AI chatbots can be hazardous to users and are designed to flirt with them.

episodes.name: Gas Station Drugs
episodes.summary: John Oliver explores the sprawling "gas station drugs" industry – questionable supplements and enhancement pills – which poses public health risks by selling under-regulated substances over the counter.

episodes.name: Shadow Docket
episodes.summary: The shadow docket is examined – a Supreme Court shortcut quickly pushing forward the Trump administration's agenda. Also included: entertaining and surprising turtle facts to add some variety.

episodes.name: Structured Settlements
episodes.summary: Structured settlements are explored – gradual payments intended to support injury or wrongful death victims over extended periods.

episodes.name: Presidential Pardons
episodes.summary: John Oliver covers the Freedom 250 event controversy, Trump's controversial use of presidential pardons in his second term, and praises Ghanaian artists.

episodes.name: New College of Florida
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses an unusual Colorado primary resembling a true crime finale, then examines New College of Florida—the liberal arts school taken over by Governor Ron DeSantis—and why marine biology is unmatched.

episodes.name: UK & Makerfield Election
episodes.summary: John Oliver covers the UK elections, why 76,000 Makerfield voters will decide the Prime Minister, and which party leader looks like he first said "British East India Company."

episodes.name: Feral Hogs
episodes.summary: John Oliver explores feral hogs, one of America's most destructive invasive species. He covers their origins, the damage they cause, and why Discovery Channel should do "Cow Week."

episodes.name: Redistricting
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses how the Supreme Court has paved the way for the redrawing of congressional maps across the country, and what it means for the midterm elections. Plus, an urgent update on Gavin Newsom's summer reading.

episodes.name: Trump & Crypto
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses how the Trump family's cryptocurrency ventures have overshadowed their other businesses, how they've created massive conflicts of interest for the Trump administration, and what it all has to do with Fartcoin.

episodes.name: Police Tools
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses the tools police are using to keep track of civilians - whether or not they're suspected of a crime - and some creative ideas about how to use wigs.

episodes.name: Department of Justice
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses how the Department of Justice has changed since Trump took office for his second term.

episodes.name: Fetal Personhood
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses how some states in the U.S. have given rights to fetuses, where the idea came from, and where things could be headed next.

episodes.name: Trump 2.0
episodes.summary: John Oliver examines Trump's mass deportation promises and explains potential negative effects on supporters' lives and the economy.

episodes.name: Facebook
episodes.summary: A deep dive into online content moderation challenges, focusing on Facebook's policy changes and their relationship to Trump's presidency.

episodes.name: Tipping
episodes.summary: John Oliver analyzes the influence of inexperienced people in the FBI and explores the tipping system, its importance to certain workers and possible improvements that would benefit both employees and consumers.

episodes.name: ICE Detention Facilities
episodes.summary: A deep dive into controversial immigration policies, examining detention center operations, their management, profit structures, and the concerning treatment of individuals in custody.

episodes.name: Sports Betting
episodes.summary: A deep dive into America's booming sports betting industry, exploring its rapid growth, potential risks, and possible solutions, plus a peculiar side story about Mahmoud Khalil's arrest.

episodes.name: Tasers
episodes.summary: John Oliver analyzes the mass deportation crisis under Trump and examines whether Tasers are as safe and effective as the manufacturer claims, or whether they require regulation as a lethal weapon.

episodes.name: Trans Athletes
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses Donald Trump's sweeping new set of tariffs and why trans athletes seem to be at the center of U.S. politics.

episodes.name: Trump & Tariffs
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses the ongoing chaos surrounding Donald Trump and tariffs, why the past week could have lasting repercussions, and why your grandma might be looking to start an OnlyFans.

episodes.name: Health Agency Cuts
episodes.summary: John Oliver examines RFK Jr.'s impact on US public health agencies during Trump's era, discussing department layoffs and their consequences for the public.

episodes.name: Deportations
episodes.summary: John Oliver analyzes deportations under Trump, revealing mistakes and affecting innocent people. He also exposes a curious connection to minor league baseball.

episodes.name: Alliance Defending Freedom
episodes.summary: John Oliver exposes the Alliance Defending Freedom, a legal organization that pushes court cases against LGBTQI+ rights under the guise of freedom and free speech, revealing its strategies to limit personal choices.

episodes.name: Trump & the Press
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses how Donald Trump is becoming an increasing threat to the press, reveals which Minor League Baseball team we've chosen for a rebrand, and explores what it means to "serve kant".

episodes.name: Air Traffic Control
episodes.summary: John Oliver addresses the critical air traffic control situation following recent incidents. He reveals the job stress of controllers, the rigorous selection process and the obsolete equipment they use to keep our skies safe.

episodes.name: Med Spas
episodes.summary: John Oliver returns for Season 12 of this Emmy(R)-winning series that takes a satirical, insightful look at current events.

episodes.name: Child Incarceration
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses the past week's protests against ICE's escalating deportation strategies, how the U.S. is incarcerating kids at a rate that may exceed other nations, and what it looks like to be teargassed in a chill way.

episodes.name: AI Content
episodes.summary: John Oliver examines AI-generated content flooding the internet and its negative impact on daily life, while highlighting major platforms' minimal efforts to address these issues.

episodes.name: Trump's Big Beautiful Bill
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses the race for mayor in New York City and what could happen if Donald Trump's "Big Beautiful Bill" is passed.

episodes.name: Gang Databases
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses Epstein/Trump supporter dynamics, examines problematic state gang databases, and gives a Little League baseball update.

episodes.name: Deferred Prosecution Agreements
episodes.summary: John Oliver examines Israel blocking aid to Gaza civilians, corporations using deferred prosecution to avoid crime consequences, and receiving an extremely non-flirtatious message on Hinge.

episodes.name: Immigration Enforcement
episodes.summary: Oliver exposes deportation tactics, suggests ways to help non-violent immigrants, and discusses Schumer's fictional "Bailey" family influencing his decisions.

episodes.name: Make America Healthy Again
episodes.summary: John Oliver reviews MAHA movement's progress, setbacks, and potential future impact if next steps are handled strategically. Features discussions about two central figures driving the health initiative.

episodes.name: Presidential Libraries
episodes.summary: John Oliver examines presidential libraries' fundraising practices while presidents are in office, highlighting potential corruption risks through power leverage, and discusses Trump's possible impact on these issues.

episodes.name: Paramount Skydance Merger
episodes.summary: John Oliver discusses the Paramount Skydance merger, and how they've named Bari Weiss the new Editor-in-Chief of CBS News.

episodes.name: Medicare Advantage
episodes.summary: John Oliver examines Trump's recent actions lacking due process, then explains Medicare Advantage's similarities to private insurance and its drawbacks compared to standard Medicare.

episodes.name: Benjamin Netanyahu
episodes.summary: Netanyahu's extended power in Israel, his alliances with extreme factions to maintain control, and his approach to influencing US policy are examined through key moments and statements.

episodes.name: Felony Murder
episodes.summary: John Oliver covers Zohran Mamdani's recent NYC mayoral victory despite Islamophobia, then examines an unjust law allowing people to face prison or even execution for murders they didn't commit, and ends with an update on Mayor Eric Adams.

episodes.name: Public Media
episodes.summary: John Oliver highlights public media's crucial role for millions of Americans, especially the poor and marginalized lacking internet access. These outlets provide vital emergency alerts and missing person information.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: As Curtis goes head-to-head with the CIA over a secret tape, he's forced to confront secrets of his own.

episodes.name: Triangle
episodes.summary: After a dead Loch Ness monster washes ashore, Curtis, Banks, and O'Doyle investigate a secret prison within the Bermuda Triangle.

episodes.name: Ex
episodes.summary: Curtis receives an invitation to his ex-wife's inauguration gala. Meanwhile, Banks and O'Doyle must complete a job evaluation at an immersive offsite facility.

episodes.name: Purchase
episodes.summary: Curtis discovers an addendum on the Louisiana Purchase receipt and must outpace old rivals and allies to maintain control of the territory.

episodes.name: David
episodes.summary: Curtis clashes with his Party and faces possible replacement, then heads to Camp David to prove his presidential abilities. Banks deals with camp politics.

episodes.name: Hollow
episodes.summary: When the United States is faced with a national energy crisis, Curtis and his team venture into the Hollow Earth to find a solution.

episodes.name: Quiero que sea mi guardaespaldas
episodes.summary: Businesswoman Sofía Peralta Avitia is rescued from a kidnapping by Franco, a farmer. Both live in failed marriages and a connection emerges. She hires him as an escort, and an attraction is born.

episodes.name: Daría mi vida por ella
episodes.summary: After going to jail, Franco is released by Sofia and agrees to be her bodyguard. Grecia and Uriel plan another attack without knowing that anyone can stop them.

episodes.name: Defendiendo lo indefendible
episodes.summary: Franco risks his life to rescue Sofia from kidnappers. Franco is shot while protecting her, revealing the strong bond that they have developed. When they open up about how they feel together, Franco's wife unexpectedly appears.

episodes.name: Acomodar el corazón
episodes.summary: A fire destroys Franco's house and puts Rex at risk. Sofía rehires him as a bodyguard and her closeness grows. Gina is jealous. Catalina arrives and reveals the mystery of Aramis' third daughter, upsetting everything.

episodes.name: Una mamá no se equivoca
episodes.summary: Barbara almost drowned and Salvador saves her. Gonzalo and Grecia consolidate their clandestine romance, while Uriel covers up his infidelity to Sofia, increasing tension and deception in the family.

episodes.name: El guardián de la orquídea
episodes.summary: Sofia confronts Gonzalo when she finds the perfume from Grecia. Franco confesses his love to her, but she rejects him. Barbara regrets kissing Salvador and Emma discovers that Catalina secretly returned to the mansion.

episodes.name: El destino nos eligió
episodes.summary: Barbi runs to Chava out of confusion, but then she looks for him and he rejects her. Sofía and Franco live an intimate moment. Gonzalo suspects the friendship between Barbi and Grecia, as it doesn't fit into his plans.

episodes.name: Acabaré con el terror que vivimos
Tú eres la llave para vencerlo
Uno no manda en el corazón
episodes.summary: Sofía receives an alert about Gonzalo's infidelity and decides to investigate. He also cuts his bond with Franco. Gina meets with Victorio and Chava meets Inés in the midst of tensions.

episodes.name: Soy una mujer enferma
episodes.summary: Sofía and Gonzalo try to reconcile, but Grecia, Uriel and Franco interrupt. Catalina talks to Aramis and discovers their bond. Barbi discovers that Chava is married and reacts with pain.

episodes.name: Tengo que enfrentarlo
episodes.summary: Barbi, furious, organizes a party with Monik and everything goes out of control. Gina suspects Aramis. He and Catalina have a tense encounter. Sofía discovers another betrayal of Gonzalo and makes decisions.

episodes.name: ¡Lárgate de mi casa!
episodes.summary: Sofia and Barbi face their pain. Grecia discovers that Gina is the daughter of Aramis. Sofia asks for a divorce; Gonzalo attacks Franco. Barbi is suffering from a crisis and Catalina joins Sofia in her fight.

episodes.name: Que este diablo te cuide las espaldas
Yo soy la hija del diablo
Ahora sí puedes ser mi yerno
Si buscan al diablo, les abriré el infierno
No voy a renunciar al amor
Donde más le duele a Sofía
