Hunt for World War II Hellships
episodes.summary: Josh searches for more than 1,000 POWs lost in the Pacific Theater. He dives to find lost Allied soldiers on the Hofuku Maru, a notorious Japanese Hellship. Then, Josh receives access to join a U.S. Department of Defense recovery mission.

episodes.name: Finding World War II's Lost Prisoners
episodes.summary: A deep-water dive leads to the historic discovery of a lost WWII hell ship, where an estimated 1,000 soldiers made the ultimate sacrifice. Josh assists a U.S. Department of Defense mission, recovering potential remains of American POWs.

episodes.name: Death Jars of Laos
episodes.summary: Deep in the jungles of Laos, Josh must detonate unexploded ordnance from the Vietnam War before he can search for a lost culture's burial jars. 3D scanning and facial recognition could finally shed light on this mysterious civilization.

episodes.name: Sunken City of Pirates
episodes.summary: A first-of-its-kind sonar survey reveals a submerged pirate lair located off the coast of Jamaica. Using groundbreaking photogrammetry, Josh dives in to hunt for the $50M stolen treasure of Black Bart, the King of Pirates.

episodes.name: Secrets of Mexico's Underworld
episodes.summary: Josh joins archaeologists as they bushwhack through thick jungle and rappel into vast caves in search of the lost Zoque culture. Deep underground, the team push through flooded sections and find ritual offerings that may solve the mystery.

episodes.name: Inca Treasure Tunnels
episodes.summary: Josh helps discover and explore a labyrinth of lost tunnels. He dodges traffic to assist in a first-ever radar scan below the busy streets of Cuzco, Peru. He joins them as they push into the tunnels and find priceless ancient treasures.

episodes.name: Chasing Civil War Gold
episodes.summary: Josh hunts for millions in missing Confederate gold. Following a new lead, he explores a wagon train robbery site where gold and silver coins vanished. Then, an eyewitness account points to the location of Jefferson Davis's lost war chest.

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Great Pyramid
episodes.summary: With exclusive access to one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, Josh unravels wild conspiracy theories about the pyramid. Crawling through every passage in the pyramid, Josh searches for the lost tomb and treasure of Pharaoh Khufu.

episodes.name: Great Pyramid Secrets Revealed
episodes.summary: To solve the mystery of the pyramid's construction, Josh joins a daring experiment to replicate its ancient build. First time ever 3D scans of a mysterious tunnel system could uncover a labyrinth of secrets buried deep beneath the stone.

episodes.name: The Great Gold Rush Shootout
episodes.summary: Gold Rush's Parker Schnabel joins Josh Gates to investigate an infamous California stagecoach robbery gone bad. Fighting a driving rainstorm, Josh leans on Parker's gold mining expertise to close in on the $10M lost treasure.

episodes.name: The Nazi's Lost Super Sub
episodes.summary: Josh dives the frigid waters of the Baltic Sea in search of a revolutionary Nazi submarine: the V-80. Hitler ordered it scuttled to prevent the Allies from learning its secrets. Now, Josh risks it all to bring the prototype to the surface.

episodes.name: The Real Goonies Treasure
episodes.summary: For the 40th Anniversary of The Goonies, Josh braves the Oregon coast to search for pirate treasure that inspired his all-time favorite movie. On the rocky shores of the Pacific, he finds pieces of a Spanish galleon that wrecked in 1694.

episodes.name: Vanderbilt's Lost Steamship
episodes.summary: Josh braves Nicaragua's croc-infested waters and snake-filled jungle to find the wreckage of the Orus. Chasing Gold Rush-era fortune, Vanderbilt's ship crashed on its maiden attempt to create a new route between the Atlantic and Pacific.

tt27238424.title: The Whole Story with Anderson Cooper

episodes.name: Inside the Raid: Venezuela's Future
episodes.summary: CNN's David Culver reports from the border of Venezuela on the raid that ended in the capture of Nicolas Maduro; examining the country's long history with the U.S., motives behind the raid, the legal case against Maduro and what comes next.

episodes.name: What Happened to Nancy Guthrie?
episodes.summary: Nancy Guthrie was last seen at her home near Tucson on January 31, 2026. CNN's Ed Lavandera reports on the latest in the search for the mother of Today Show host, Savannah Guthrie; examining the timeline of events and key evidence in her disappearance.

episodes.name: War With Iran: The Attack and the Fallout
episodes.summary: One week into the war, CNN's Sara Sidner traces the events of recent years inside Iran and what led to the decision to strike, examining the ripple effect of economic and security impacts to the region and what it all means for America.

episodes.name: The Rise of Christian Nationalism
episodes.summary: CNN's Pamela Brown examines the growing influence of Christian nationalism in American society; exploring how a movement once largely confined to the margins of white evangelical culture has gained new visibility and political power.

episodes.name: Immigration Crackdown: A Year of Enforcement
episodes.summary: CNN's Omar Jimenez reports on the escalation of US Immigration and Customs Enforcement tactics since Donald Trump took office and how federal immigration policies are unfolding on the ground, reshaping communities and affecting migration patterns.

episodes.name: 50 Years of Apple
episodes.summary: Fifty years after its founding, CNN's Bill Weir takes viewers inside Apple, one of the most influential, profitable, and iconic companies ever, tracing its history, most consequential moments, and ongoing cultural impact.

episodes.name: UFC at the White House
episodes.summary: As the UFC prepares for an historic fight at the White House, CNN's Sara Sidner examines its rise from controversy to a powerful political force, offering an inside look at the decades-long relationship between the UFC and President Donald Trump.

episodes.name: Ben Sasse Is Going Home
episodes.summary: CNN's Jake Tapper speaks with former Nebraska Senator Ben Sasse, who is living with a terminal cancer diagnosis at the age of 54. Their decade-long history informs a deeply personal conversation on life, faith, and love in the face of mortality.

episodes.name: The Left Insurgency
episodes.summary: CNN's Donie O'Sullivan examines the growing influence of the Democratic Party's progressive movement, from grassroots activists to digital creators, and whether its rise is the party's greatest strength or greatest risk as the midterms approach.

episodes.name: The End of the World As We Know It
K-Pop: A Star Is Made
episodes.summary: K-Pop bands, popular worldwide, originate from South Korea and are uniquely molded in the music industry. CNN's Kyung Lah explores the intense training of seven aspiring stars, just one week before their audition for a premiere idol group.

episodes.name: LA Burning
episodes.summary: The worst wildfires in the history of Los Angeles are still burning. How did they start? How bad and long-lasting is the damage? And is this the start of a new era of climate disaster that we all need to face? CNN's Anderson Cooper reports.

episodes.name: Operation Panda
episodes.summary: The Smithsonian National Zoo is set to reopen its panda exhibit. CNN's David Culver covers the arrival of the first giant pandas sent from China to the U.S. in 24 years and examines the history of panda diplomacy.

episodes.name: Flight Risk
episodes.summary: The collision between a jetliner and an Army helicopter near Washington DC is the deadliest aviation disaster in the US since 2001. CNN's Anderson Cooper examines the circumstances around the crash and the airline safety issues of recent years.

episodes.name: Bill Gates
episodes.summary: CNN's Anderson Cooper interviews Bill Gates about the moments that shaped him, his career at Microsoft and the future of AI. Gates also discusses meeting with President Trump and Elon Musk's intervening with USAID.

episodes.name: Adaptation Nation: A Climate Crisis Survival Guide
episodes.summary: From the hurricane-afflicted Gulf Coast to the fire-ravaged mountains of California, communities are rebuilding in the face of disaster. CNN's Bill Weir explores the lessons learned and how we can adapt to a changing climate.

episodes.name: Fentanyl in America: A Way Out
episodes.summary: CNN's Kate Bolduan reports on America's opioid overdose epidemic, speaking with EMTs, physicians, and people struggling with addiction. As the crisis enters its "third wave", she examines efforts to find new solutions.

episodes.name: MisinfoNation: Extreme America
episodes.summary: CNN's Donie O'Sullivan marks 30 years since the Oklahoma City bombing by exploring how technology and social media fuel modern far-right extremism. Along the way, he encounters a newly radicalized generation justifying political violence.

episodes.name: 100 Days of Trump
episodes.summary: As President Trump approaches his first 100 days back in office, he has moved with astonishing speed to issue a record number of executive actions. CNN's Abby Phillip takes a closer look at the real-world impact of his decisions on average Americans.

episodes.name: The Wired Rainforest
episodes.summary: CNN's Nick Paton Walsh reports on the impact of the internet being introduced to the Amazon jungle's indigenous Kanamari community for the first time and how its people grapple with a technology that has transformed every part of Western life.

episodes.name: Saving Venice
episodes.summary: CNN's Erica Hill explores the future of Venice, a city threatened by rising sea levels and the more immediate threat of overwhelming tourism; she speaks with locals working to preserve the city's traditions and address climate change.

episodes.name: The Case Against Diddy
episodes.summary: As the public processes the verdicts in the federal trial of Sean "Diddy" Combs, CNN's Laura Coates charts his rise, fall and the key moments in the case against him.

episodes.name: The Idaho Murders
episodes.summary: CNN's John Miller examines the case against Brian Kohlberger who pled guilty to the 2022 murders of four University of Idaho students; how did police identify him and will the motive for his grisly crime ever be revealed?

episodes.name: Change Amplified: Live Music and the Climate Crisis
episodes.summary: CNN's Bill Weir speaks with big stars working to revolutionize the environmental impact of live music; exploring their efforts to reform an industry known for its massive energy use and waste.

episodes.name: Ecuador: The Narco Superhighway
episodes.summary: Ecuador is one of the most environmentally diverse countries in South America, home to rainforests, the Andes Mountains and the Galapagos Islands. It was once considered one of the safest, most peaceful countries in the region with the lowest homicide rate. But that is quickly changing. A rise in drug trafficking has led to a rise in power for the cartels in the region. Around 70 percent of the world's cocaine moves through Ecuador now, and that has plunged the country into a state of chaos and violence. CNN's David Culver takes us inside Ecuador where he'll show you firsthand what the government forces are doing to try to contain the violence and speaks with Ecuadorians, including current gang members, about why so many civilians are getting caught up in this war, either by force or sometimes by choice.

episodes.name: Sports Betting: America's Big Gamble
episodes.summary: CNN's Nick Watt takes us inside the sports betting world with those who make a living out of it and those who've lost everything. He'll also show you how these apps are designed to draw people in and why it can be so hard to quit.

episodes.name: Bad Sports: When Fans Turn Violent
episodes.summary: As violent fan behavior escalates worldwide, CNN's Ed Lavandera speaks with sports fans, officials, and authorities to investigate how the hive mentality of sports fandom, fueled by adrenaline and frustration, can erupt into violent conflict.

episodes.name: The Simril(l)s: A Family in Black and White
episodes.summary: CNN's Sara Snider shares a powerful portrait of a multi-racial Southern family that confronts and explores its painful shared history and comes together in spite of it. United, they consider how they can serve as a blueprint for racial healing.

episodes.name: MisinfoNation: White Genocide
episodes.summary: CNN's Donie O'Sullivan investigates why the narrative of alleged "White Genocide" in South Africa, fueled by fears of demographic change in the U.S., has gained traction among Americans, including Donald Trump; and reveals a more complex reality.

episodes.name: The Exorcists
episodes.summary: CNN's David Culver delves into modern exorcisms in America, revealing how old rituals of religious cleansing are being revived today as a last resort for people seeking relief from trauma and abuse.

episodes.name: Justice Defenders: Change Inside Prison
episodes.summary: CNN's Anderson Cooper travels to Kenya to report on the work of Justice Defenders, a non-profit seeking to help those incarcerated in Africa's overcrowded prisons return to society, and whether their model could work in America's justice system.

episodes.name: Rob Reiner: His Life & Legacy
episodes.summary: CNN's Sara Sidner reports on the latest in the investigation and unanswered questions around the death of Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner and looks at their long legacy in Hollywood and beyond.

episodes.name: No Laughing Matter: Free Speech Under Attack
episodes.summary: CNN's Jake Tapper examines the events leading to Jimmy Kimmel's suspension from ABC and the role of government and business in the decision to take him off the air; exploring issues of freedom of speech and press under different administrations.

episodes.name: Minnie Mouse Clubhouse
episodes.summary: Mickey surprises Minnie with her very own pink Clubhouse.

episodes.name: The Ice Cream Mystery
episodes.summary: Mickey and the Go-Getters solve a mystery on Ice Cream Day. Together with Toodles (with a magnifying glass, a rhinoceros, an ostrich, Molly the mallet, and the Mystery Mousekepal), they need to solve the mystery.

episodes.name: Say Cheese
episodes.summary: Mickey needs to take a picture with his MULTIPLE friends. He and Toodles (with three Mouseketools, aka a giraffe, a beach ball, a tiger, and the Mystery Mousekepal) need to take a picture, very, VERY carefully, as a group photo.

episodes.name: Daisy's Hole in One Mystery
episodes.summary: The gang comes up with a solution to fix woodchuck holes on the golf course.

episodes.name: Mickey and Pluto Go Camping
episodes.summary: Mickey camps with Pluto at Friendship Lake but misses his pals. They miss him too and surprise him by showing up for a fun reunion at the campsite.

episodes.name: Martian Mickey's Clubhouse
episodes.summary: Mickey and pals get a call from Martian Mickey and Minnie. Their Space Clubhouse needs replacing, so Mickey and friends use Mouseketools to build their own clubhouse.

episodes.name: Martian Mishap
episodes.summary: When Martian Mickey's spaceship crashes on Earth, Mickey and the gang must help Martian Mickey fix his spaceship so he can go back to Mars and make his Yum-Blatz pie.

episodes.name: Minnie's Rubber Ducky Doozy
episodes.summary: Minnie hosts a rubber duckie parade at Mickey Lake; when Goofy's duckie goes missing, the Sensational Six dive underwater with Mouseketools to find it.

episodes.name: SPOTS the Beagle-Bot
episodes.summary: Mickey, Pluto and the gang help SPOTS, a robot dog made by Professor Von Drake, learn how to be like a real dog and join in the fun with everyone.

episodes.name: Mickey's Movie Night
episodes.summary: Mickey and pals visit Pete's drive-in movie theatre to help him prepare for a big movie night, making sure everything is ready for a fun evening under the stars.

episodes.name: Clubhouse Carnival
episodes.summary: Donald loses his toy lion, Sparky, at the Clubhouse Carnival. Mickey and pals must find Sparky in time to ride the exciting new Mouseke-slide together.

episodes.name: Tale of the Moo-Maids
episodes.summary: When Daisy's pearl necklace breaks in Mickey Lake, the pals dive underwater to find the missing pearls with help from their new friend, Sea Queen Clarabelle.

episodes.name: Daisylocks and the Three Bears
episodes.summary: When Daisylocks needs help finding her way home, Mickey uses his storybook to guide her. They travel over a golden bridge and under a rainbow back to her cabin.

episodes.name: A Dragon Tale
episodes.summary: Queen Clarabelle's tea party is disrupted by a dragon. The Sensational Six discover it's their friend Farfus and invite him to join the party.

episodes.name: The Late, Late Show
episodes.summary: When Mickey and friends hear about a meteor shower in the night sky, they do everything to stay awake and watch.

episodes.name: Donald's Clubhouse Sleepover
episodes.summary: Donald hosts a sleepover at his new Clubhouse but can't fall asleep. Mickey and friends help him -and themselves- get a good night's rest.

episodes.name: The Candy Cottage
episodes.summary: Mickey, Minnie, and Donald pick blueberries in Fairy Tale Forest. Donald takes a bite out of Wizard Pete's candy cottage. The pals gather candy to fix it.

episodes.name: Mickey's Country Farm
episodes.summary: Mickey and friends use their new farm vehicles to build the Fairest Farm Fair ever — hoping Daisy's cowgirl idol, Lasso Lucy, will stop by for a visit.

episodes.summary: Jonathan Haidt, NYU Stern professor and co-author of "The Amazing Generation," joins for an interview. Panel: Stephanie Ruhle, MS NOW host, and retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, former National Security Advisor.

episodes.summary: Three malignant narcissists walk into a television studio. One tosses easy questions at the other two, who are at a loss to provide coherent answers, and at times sit there mute and dumbstruck, looking extremely uncomfortable.

episodes.summary: This week: a one-on-one with Erin Brockovich, consumer advocate and environmental activist. Panel: Scott Galloway, NYU professor and author of "Notes on Being a Man," and Peter Hamby, Puck correspondent and "Powers That Be" podcast host.

episodes.summary: Interview with Mike Rowe, founder/CEO of mikeroweWORKS Foundation and "The Way I Heard It" host. Panel: Tara Palmeri ("The Red Letter," "The Tara Palmeri Show") and Matt Welch ("The Fifth Column," Reason Magazine editor-at-large).

episodes.summary: Features Ryan Holiday, host of "The Daily Stoic" podcast and bestselling author. Panel includes Andrew Cuomo, former NY Governor, and Kristen Soltis Anderson, CNN contributor and pollster at Echelon Insights.

episodes.summary: Jesse Eisenberg discusses his film "A Real Pain." Panel includes Rep. Ro Khanna (HASC member, "Dignity in Digital Age" author) and ESPN/YouTube host Stephen A. Smith.

episodes.summary: Interview with WSJ columnist Peggy Noonan plus panel with West Point fellow Max Brooks and historian Dan Jones discussing his book on Henry V.

episodes.summary: Interview with meme expert Aiden Walker plus panel with CNN/SiriusXM host Michael Smerconish and SC Rep. Nancy Mace, who serves on Armed Services, Veterans' Affairs and Oversight committees.

episodes.summary: Dan Farah, creator of "The Age of Disclosure" documentary, joins for an interview. Panel guests include Michael Moynihan ("The Fifth Column" and "The Moynihan Report") and Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene (R-GA).

episodes.summary: Kenny Chesney discusses Hall of Fame induction and new book "Heart Life Music." Panel features Rep. Jared Moskowitz (D-FL) and Bill O'Reilly of "No Spin News," author of "Confronting Evil."

episodes.name: Track of the Cat
episodes.summary: Anna questions the official explanation when the death of a fellow ranger unsettles the park.

episodes.name: Hide + Seek
episodes.summary: Anna Pigeon navigates her complex personal life while uncovering a deadly game of hide and seek; she and fellow rangers face a critical choice that will determine a troubled family's fate.

episodes.name: The Preacher
episodes.summary: Anna guides a tense group of campers through the back country. A serial bank robber has brought the FBI to the park.

episodes.name: Hell Is Other People
episodes.summary: Anna guides a tense group of campers through the backcountry as a fierce storm closes in.

episodes.name: Arrest the Midwife
episodes.summary: The arrest of trusted midwives, ignites an unexpected rebellion, as Amish and Mennonite women break from tradition and emerge as fierce political activists, joining the broader fight for reproductive justice.

episodes.name: Union
episodes.summary: UNION chronicles an unlikely group of warehouse workers as they launch a grassroots union campaign at an Amazon fulfillment center in Staten Island, New York. The odds are stacked against them, as they find themselves up against a tech industry giant with unlimited resources, without major support from national unions or politicians, and while navigating internal divisions within their own ranks.

episodes.name: Igualada: Refusing to Know Your Place
episodes.summary: In Colombia's most consequential election, Black activist Francia Marquez rises from rural organizer to presidential candidate, challenging centuries of racial and social exclusion. Filmed over fifteen years, this intimate portrait captures how Marquez transforms a grassroots movement into a powerful force for change, inspiring millions to reimagine their nation's future and their place within it.

episodes.name: Made in Ethiopia
episodes.summary: As Ethiopia's largest Chinese-run industrial park attempts an ambitious expansion, three women find themselves at the heart of a changing nation. A determined Chinese director pushes for 30,000 new jobs, while a local farmer and factory worker face the promise and painful realities of rapid industrialization. Their interwoven stories reveal the complex human dimensions of global development.

episodes.name: The Ride Ahead
episodes.summary: Samuel faces the challenges of living independently at age 21 while dealing with seizures and social barriers. Among disability activists, he seeks his path to autonomy and his dreams, despite society's obstacles and prejudices.

episodes.name: Emergent City
episodes.summary: Residents of Sunset Park, Brooklyn face rising rents, a legacy of environmental racism and the loss of the industrial jobs that once sustained their community. When a global developer purchases a massive industrial complex on the waterfront and lays plans for an "innovation district," a battle erupts over the future of the neighborhood and of New York city itself. Co-produced with ITVS.

episodes.name: A New Kind of Wilderness
episodes.summary: On a small farm in a Norwegian forest, the Paynes live a purposefully isolated life, striving to be wild and free. But when tragedy strikes, their idyllic world is shattered, forcing them to navigate the expectations of modern society. This intimate and soulful documentary explores love, growing up, and how we navigate life after loss.

episodes.name: Black Snow
episodes.summary: In a remote Siberian coal town, homemaker-turned-journalist Natalia Zubkova investigates an abandoned mine fire releasing toxic gas into residential homes. When her reporting goes viral, government officials launch an aggressive cover-up campaign, putting her directly in their crosshairs.

episodes.name: The Only Round That Matters Is the Next One
episodes.summary: After eight years in a Nevada prison, former heavyweight boxing champion Duke Kilroy returns to London, intent on avenging his brother's death.

episodes.name: Brick by Brick
episodes.summary: Duke must improvise to keep his mission on track, but he finds that success comes at a cost.

episodes.name: No Innocents
episodes.summary: Turning up the heat on the Marshalls, Duke is drawn in deeper than he ever imagined.

episodes.name: Protect Yourself at All Times
episodes.summary: London's gangland is pushed to the brink of war, but for Duke, the consequences hit painfully close to home.

episodes.name: I Want This
episodes.summary: A dangerous rescue operation gives Duke a chance at redemption, but an unexpected betrayal reignites his all-consuming thirst for vengeance.

episodes.name: Without Me, There Is No You
And the Burning Heart
episodes.summary: The Librarians travel to an international boarding school to examine a sudden wave of unexplained anger, where they meet a puzzling stranger who says he's the famed sorcerer Merlin.

episodes.name: And the Tethered Wish
episodes.summary: An escaped genie wreaks havoc in Belgrade granting wishes; the Librarians must trap him before his powers spiral out of control, but Vikram's rash wish mystically binds him to Jacob Stone.

episodes.name: And the Vanishing Bankers
episodes.summary: Investigating vanishing bankers in London, the Librarians find a dark Peter Pan recruiting new Lost Boys; when Charlie is captured, the team enters a warped Neverland disguised as storybook characters to save her.

episodes.name: And the Recipe for Disaster
episodes.summary: When Connor is bewitched by a smell spell and becomes a contestant on a cooking competition show, the Librarians must break the enchantment by defeating the show's hosts.

episodes.name: And the Red Rock
episodes.summary: The Librarians discover that the charming scientist Lysa is dating is actually the Red Rock, a superhero battling a crime wave across Belgrade; are his superpowers, and perhaps the crime wave itself, the result of a magical artifact being

episodes.name: And Descartes' Dilemma
episodes.summary: While recovering the missing bracelets of Castor and Pollux, the Librarians accidentally swap bodies. As they race to locate the second bracelet, they discover Merlin has secretly swapped bodies with one of them.

episodes.name: And the Monkey's Paw
episodes.summary: The Librarians hunt for a Monkey's Paw but get trapped in a fog-covered hotel. They must face their past traumas to escape and discover the difference between their wishes and true needs.

episodes.name: And the Last Resort
episodes.summary: The Librarians check out a magical ley line at a historic 200-year-old resort with a famous puppet theater. Their vacation plans fall apart when they discover an evil sentient puppet plotting to destroy the resort.

episodes.name: And the Toy Phone
episodes.summary: While the rest of the team is away on a Library retreat, Charlie receives a call on a mysterious toy phone from a child trapped in a haunted house.

episodes.name: And the Heart of a Librarian
episodes.summary: The Librarians help Vikram's lost love Anya solve a mystery using letters sent through time, stopping magical Victorian-era events from creating dangerous consequences in the future.

episodes.name: And the Deadly Drekavac
episodes.summary: A time-traveling Librarian inadvertently releases magic across the continent and is given a new team to help him clean up the mess he made.

episodes.name: And the Dance of Doom
episodes.summary: The newly assembled Librarians investigate a mysterious dancing sickness, leading them to a showdown with a powerful magical factioneer at a professional ballet company.

episodes.name: And the Ghost Train
episodes.summary: Vikram and Connor find themselves on a ghost train inside a time loop, while Charlie hopes to bond with her new colleagues like Lysa.

episodes.name: And the Thief of Love
episodes.summary: The Librarians investigate Paris robberies where victims are left mysteriously in love.

episodes.name: And the Memory Crystal
episodes.summary: The team investigates memory thefts at a college observatory, tracking someone using Dr. John Dee's Crystal to control the future.

episodes.name: And the House of Cards
episodes.summary: Charlie, Lysa and Connor find themselves in a strange manor with ongoing Christie-style murders. As they work to solve the mystery, Vikram searches for them with help from a tarot reader.

episodes.name: And the Con-Con
episodes.summary: Connor must face people from his past and confront a strengthened former enemy after his time away at the Library.

episodes.name: And the Hangover from Hell
episodes.summary: After a bachelorette party with Lysa's best friend from childhood, the team wakes up in rough shape and with horrible hangovers. They also have no idea how they ended up where they are.

episodes.name: And the Feast of the Vampire
episodes.summary: At a small-town festival, Connor meets the original vampire and races against time to prevent his own transformation.

episodes.name: And Going Medieval
episodes.summary: When Vikram attempts to return to 1847 via a homemade time machine, he inadvertently transports the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and Elaine.

episodes.name: And the Graffiti of the Gods
episodes.summary: When graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl, the team have to work out how these strange events are related to Gregor's Hammer -- and the imminent return of Gregor himself.

episodes.name: And the Unfinished Business
episodes.summary: General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia (remember from the Train episode), gaining control of their nuclear arsenal. The team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

tt33014623.title: In the Eye of the Storm

episodes.name: Nightmare in May
episodes.summary: In mid-May 2025, hundreds of eyewitnesses capture the power of severe weather as supercell thunderstorms unleash dozens of powerful tornadoes, tossing vehicles across highways and destroying neighborhoods and workplaces in eleven states.

episodes.name: That Car's Flying!
episodes.summary: As Hurricane Idalia makes landfall on Florida's Gulf Coast, holdouts face a 12-foot storm surge and 125 mph winds.

episodes.name: Monster in Michigan
episodes.summary: When a rare EF-3 tornado hits northern Michigan, cameras capture the chaos as 150 mph winds disintegrate shopping centers, toss vehicles and carve a path of destruction through a city that never saw it coming.

episodes.name: Houston Hurricane Hell
episodes.summary: When Hurricane Harvey hit Texas with 130 mph winds and record rain, cameras captured catastrophic flooding as neighborhoods vanished, forcing civilians to risk their lives to save others in one of the costliest US disasters.

episodes.name: The Dakota EF5
episodes.summary: Eyewitnesses document extreme weather in the Dakotas as tornadoes ravage homes and farms. A twister near Enderlin, ND, with winds over 200 mph marks the first EF5 tornado in the U.S. in more than 12 years.

episodes.name: Flood of the Century
episodes.summary: A freak storm hits Valencia, Spain, bringing a tornado and a year's rainfall. Witnesses film devastating floods as bridges collapse, cars wash away, and people struggle to survive.

episodes.name: Stranded in St. Louis
episodes.summary: In May 2025, eyewitnesses capture shocking scenes as a mile-wide tornado tears through St. Louis. When warning sirens fail, residents are caught off guard while visitors panic 630 feet above ground inside the Gateway Arch.

episodes.name: Jamaica Category 5
episodes.summary: Category 5 Hurricane Melissa devastates Jamaica with catastrophic winds and flooding. Tourists and residents seek shelter as Montego Bay resorts collapse and Black River floods from heavy rain.

episodes.name: The Texas Flood
episodes.summary: Unrelenting rainfall in central Texas turns July 4th into a fight for survival. As the Guadalupe River surges, first responders launch daring rescues.

episodes.name: Tornado Torrent 2025
episodes.summary: In March 2025, extreme atmospheric volatility unleashes a massive Texas haboob and more than 150 tornadoes across the southern states.

episodes.name: Category 5: Fight to Survive
episodes.summary: As Hurricane Ian slams Florida's Gulf Coast with 150 mph winds, residents who unwisely stay behind battle a storm.

episodes.name: The Mayfield Beast
episodes.summary: A powerful EF-4 tornado devastates Mayfield, Kentucky, leveling the county jail where officers race to rescue trapped inmates while preventing escape.

episodes.name: Escaping the LA Fires
episodes.summary: As wind-driven fires explode across Los Angeles in January 2025, cameras capture chaos and heroism as residents attempt to rescue their loved ones.

episodes.name: Road Warriors
episodes.summary: Road Warriors - During WWII, a struggling automaker and Detroit's industry titan race to build a revolutionary all-purpose military vehicle, then spend decades battling to reinvent their wartime creation into America's most popular type of car: the SUV.

episodes.name: The Game Makers
episodes.summary: Mark Goodson and Merv Griffin compete for three decades to transform TV game shows, launching legendary series featuring spinning wheels, buzzers, and catchphrases that embed themselves in American culture.

episodes.name: Ideas That Stick
episodes.summary: A husband's homemade bandage, a college dropout's breakthrough adhesive, and a factory worker's wartime fix transform simple strips of tape into indispensable American icons — creating a $90 billion industry, one sticky invention at a time.

episodes.name: Racing to the Top
episodes.summary: A down-on-his-luck mechanic transforms outlaw moonshine racing into one of America's biggest spectator sports, overcoming powerful rivals, deadly setbacks, and financial crises to build a billion-dollar sports empire that becomes a Mega-Brand That Built America.

episodes.name: The Underwear Boom
episodes.summary: P.H. Hanes sparks a revolution in American underwear, but rivals answer with breakthrough designs, bold branding, and a wartime windfall—transforming an unmentionable necessity into a $100 billion global industry and one of the Mega-Brands That Built America.

episodes.name: The World in Your Palm
episodes.summary: The biggest names in computers go head-to-head in a race to create the first portable computers; through failures, alliances and the return of an American icon, they'll usher in the first ever handheld device.

episodes.name: The Retail Reckoning
episodes.summary: Three American retail icons are born within months of each other in 1962, sparking a rivalry for the ages.

episodes.name: Rise of the Internet Empires
episodes.summary: An ambitious upstart starts an internet store that becomes a global empire, while a young computer programmer revolutionizes the way we buy and sell online--creating rival multi billion-dollar brands that become household names.

episodes.name: Hardware Warfare
episodes.summary: Family-owned hardware stores become behemoth brands who battle it out taking big risks, ushering in new innovations, and betting it all in a race to become the number one hardware store chain in America.

episodes.name: Rise of the Office Machines
episodes.summary: To simplify tedious office tasks in the mid-20th century, one unknown company introduces the world's first photocopier and becomes a household name.

episodes.name: Photo Bombs
episodes.summary: An underdog breaks the mold by creating instant photography, revolutionizing how we take photos. And it kicks off a war of innovation between two iconic companies battling to be the number one camera brand in the country.

episodes.name: Fight for the Fast Lane
episodes.summary: American cars get a makeover when an engineer creates the first sports car.

episodes.name: Pants on Fire
episodes.summary: Levi Strauss partners with a tailor who makes a groundbreaking discovery during the Gold Rush-sparking a blue jean boom and a fierce rivalry between two iconic companies that spans generations and builds a billion-dollar industry.

episodes.name: Wipe out the Competition
episodes.summary: Before toilet paper, Americans used just about anything--until the Scott brothers turn a mistake into an opportunity and invent the toilet paper roll, giving birth to a new billion-dollar industry.

episodes.name: Reinventing the Wheel
episodes.summary: Harvey Firestone races to innovation against a crosstown rival as they both bet big on bringing car tires to the nation.

episodes.name: The Rift That Keeps on Giving
episodes.summary: After losing Alex, Billie is convinced her powers are too dangerous and thus relinquishes them to keep her family safe.

episodes.name: The Right Stuffie
episodes.summary: Without her powers, Billie is forced to enlist the help of an old foe to break into the most secure wizard facility in the world.

episodes.name: Billie Russo-Penwulf and the Prisoner of Wizcatraz
episodes.summary: Billie and Justin set out to break into Wizcatraz. Back at home, the rest of the family and Winter try to communicate with Alex.

episodes.name: The Last Spell
episodes.summary: Billie aims to save Alex. However, an evil force threatens to destroy the Russo family once and for all.

episodes.name: Spells Like Halloween Spirit
episodes.summary: When Justin forbids Billie from having a haunted house, she takes Justin to Halloween future, present and past in an attempt to help him rediscover his Halloween spirit.

episodes.name: Cruel Detentions
episodes.summary: When Billie gets detention, she trades wands with Milo so his spells will earn her points. But when Milo's spell goes awry, Billie must sneak home to try to save the day.

episodes.name: It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Wizmas
episodes.summary: When Billie discovers that she's on Santa's Nice List for the first time, she sets out to get her rightful spot on the Naughty List back through any means necessary.

episodes.name: Boogie and the Beast
episodes.summary: When bad boy Quentin asks Billie to the eighth-grade dance, she's excited, but a wary Justin is starting to suspect that this mysterious kid may not be exactly what he seems.

episodes.name: The Wizard at the End of the World: Part One
episodes.summary: When Billie's magic wreaks havoc at home, the Russos end up at Alex's apartment for the weekend. Meanwhile, Justin searches for information about the mysterious Lord Morsus.

episodes.name: The Wizard at the End of the World: Part Two
episodes.summary: As Alex, Justin, and Billie try to prevent Lord Morsus from fulfilling the prophecy, a long-kept secret comes to light.

episodes.name: Curse Me Baby One More Time
episodes.summary: When Roman excels at his wizard lessons, Billie feels threatened and uses a Reverse Curse to slow him down, but it accidentally turns him into a baby.

episodes.name: Howdy with a Trance of Gumballs
episodes.summary: When an oracle from the wizard world shows up on Billie's doorstep and predicts that Billie will destroy the big summer carnival, Billie stops at nothing to change the future.

episodes.name: Don't Go Changeling My Heart
episodes.summary: When a new student arrives and takes an unlikely interest in Roman, Billie thinks she must be the Changeling and sets out to prove it.

episodes.name: Training Camp with the Seattle Seahawks - Episode 1
episodes.summary: After getting their championship rings, the Super Bowl-winning Seahawks begin training camp with hopes of a repeat title. Coach Mike Macdonald motivates them by referencing Michael Jordan's Bulls dynasty.

episodes.name: Training Camp with the Seattle Seahawks - Episode 2
episodes.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald sets a standard with real consequences. During practice, linebacker Derick Hall kept getting too close to QB Sam Darnold, and Macdonald, who wants to keep the quarterback safe, was not happy.

episodes.name: Training Camp with the Seattle Seahawks - Episode 3
episodes.summary: John Schneider shapes the defense with CB Terrion Arnold's signing while fringe roster players aim to stand out in the opening preseason game.

episodes.name: Training Camp with the Seattle Seahawks - Episode 4
Training Camp with the Buffalo Bills - Episode 1
episodes.summary: Bills coach McDermott, General Manager Beane, MVP QB Allen, and other players conduct training at St. John Fisher University in Pittsford, NY.

episodes.name: Training Camp with the Buffalo Bills - Episode 2
episodes.summary: A look at undrafted local kid "Buffalo Joe" Andreesen; RB Ray Davis tries kicking; the battle for QB2; Damar Hamlin's inspiring story.

episodes.name: Training Camp with the Buffalo Bills - Episode 3
episodes.summary: James Cook hits the field as his "hold in" ends; defensive tackle Ed Oliver shows his love for horses; the Bills head to Chicago to face the Bears.

episodes.name: Training Camp with the Buffalo Bills - Episode 4
episodes.summary: Josh Allen shows how he has developed into an elite QB with help from a biometrics expert; roster cuts loom as the team heads to Tampa Bay.

episodes.name: 1970s
episodes.summary: As cultural and political movements grow across the United States, their impact on sports is undeniable; women command a larger place on the American sports horizon, while free agency rebalances the dynamic between owners and players.

episodes.name: 1960s
episodes.summary: Television revolutionizes the way Americans enjoy sports, bringing games, especially from the NFL, into tens of millions of homes. Certain stars - Bill Russell, Joe Namath, Muhammed Ali, and Peggy Flemming - seem born for the camera.

episodes.name: 1980s
episodes.summary: As tensions between the USSR and the United States heat up in the 80s, so do sports rivalries; Everett vs. Navratilova and Bird vs. Magic in the NBA dominate their respective sports, while The Great One bursts onto the ice in the NHL.

episodes.name: 1990s
episodes.summary: In the 1990s, athletes' celebrity power transcends the world of sports; sports scandals are increasingly smeared across tabloid headlines, while Michael Jordan wins six titles and becomes one of the most recognized athletes in the world.

episodes.name: 2000s
episodes.summary: National tragedy, historic comebacks and grand slams define the 2000s in sports; Tiger Woods in golf, the Williams sisters in tennis, and a shakeup of one of the greatest baseball rivalries in history prove that sports belong to all Americans.

episodes.name: 2010s
episodes.summary: Huge names emerge in sports in the 2010s, including LeBron James, Simone Biles, and Steph Curry; as social media revolutionizes fan engagement, direct interaction and sports betting changes the way viewers see celebrity athletes forever.

episodes.name: Diamond Duckie/Mystery Monster
episodes.summary: The Kitties and Willa stop Mr. Puppypaws from stealing a special duckie diamond hidden in the Wild Jungle. The SuperKitties and Willa help Zsa-Zsa, who says she saw a monster.

episodes.name: Jungle Rose/Super Special Stone
episodes.summary: Lab Rat causes chaos with a weather machine so that the special Jungle Rose will bloom sooner. When Cat Burglar accidentally steals Papa Bird's egg, the SuperKitties must get it back.

episodes.name: Kittydale Christmas Tree/Skating Buddies
episodes.summary: The Kitties save Kittydale's stolen Christmas tree from the Glamsters. The SuperKitties stop Cat Burglar from stealing the medals from a big ice-skating contest.

episodes.name: The Glamping Glamsters/Trouble in the Jungle
episodes.summary: Things don't go as planned when the Glamsters go glamping and Buddy sleeps over at Willa's Treehouse. The Kitties and Willa stop Mr. Puppypaws from taking over the Wild Jungle.

episodes.name: Tricky Treat Trickster/Jungle Junk Pile
episodes.summary: Lab Rat tricks Wiggles, the robot pig, into taking things and it's up to the SuperKitties to stop them. Cat Burglar and Cousin Sassy make a mess in the jungle.

episodes.name: Clamshell Coaster/Zsa-Zsa Spa Spa
episodes.summary: When Lab Rat steals the Clamshell Coaster for Otto's family the SuperKitties must get it back. The Kitties help the jungle animals when Zsa-Zsa blocks a waterfall to make a spa.

episodes.name: Bubble Bathin' Burbles/Favorite - Favorites
episodes.summary: When Lab Rat's Burbles steal all the bubble bath, the SuperKitties must save bathtime. The Kitties and Willa pounce to the rescue when Cat Burglar swipes stuffies around town.

episodes.name: Fishy Fish Thief/Burgled Backpacks
episodes.summary: Willa helps the SuperKitties stop Mr. Puppypaws from taking a special fish statue. The Kitties must save the first day of school when the Glamsters steal all the backpacks.

episodes.name: Copter Caper/Sneaky Statue
episodes.summary: Someone steals the Kitty Copter. When Cat Burglar and Cousin Sassy hide in a statue to swipe Amara's tiara for Granny, the SuperKitties pounce to stop them.

episodes.name: Purdy Birdy Picnic/Swimmy Zone
episodes.summary: Zsa-Zsa takes her Aunt Lola on a picnic, where she makes all the park animals start to float away. Mr. Puppypaws puts the Zoomie Zone in a giant fishbowl for King Fishyfins.

episodes.name: Super Glamsters/Astro-Hamsters
episodes.summary: The Glamsters make their own super suits. When the Glamsters steal an outer space exhibit for a sick Evie the Kitties must get it back.

episodes.name: Snow Bird/Rock Out Ray
episodes.summary: When Zsa-Zsa doesn't want Aunt Lola to leave Kittydale, she tries turning the Wild Jungle into a wintery mess. The Kitties must stop Lab Rat from making everyone dance.

episodes.name: Fin-tastic Getaway/Boo Boo Bandit
episodes.summary: Mr. Puppypaws sends the SuperKitties on a wild stroller chase through Kittydale. Zsa-Zsa steals the Glamster's ball to shield George from getting another boo-boo.

episodes.name: Elephantastic Elephant/Glam-tastrophe
episodes.summary: When Evie wants to own an elephant, Pamster and Champster take one from the jungle. Mr. Puppypaws makes himself glam with looted props in an attempt to win Miss Poochytail's appreciation after seeing her play with the Glamsters.

episodes.name: The New SuperKitty!
episodes.summary: Willa is invited to become a SuperKitty, but her new skills are put to the test when Cat Burglar and the Glamsters take over Kittydale.

episodes.name: Mega Mouse/Wild Jungle
episodes.summary: The SuperKitties must stop Lab Rat from chasing cats with her mega-mouse. The SuperKitties visit Willa in the Wild Jungle.

episodes.name: Tooth Fairy/Muffin Mess
episodes.summary: Zsa-Zsa disguises herself as the Tooth Fairy so she can steal Bitsy's tooth and get a present. The SuperKitties save Kittydale from Lab Rat's stinky muffins.

episodes.name: Super Sleepover/Unicorn Catchers
episodes.summary: When Zsa-Zsa steals all the pet beds in Kittydale, the SuperKitties and Willa race to get them back. The Glamsters make a glittery mess in the jungle as they look for a unicorn.

episodes.name: Vanishing Veggies/Octo-Gummies
episodes.summary: The SuperKitties must stop the Glamsters from stealing all the veggies in Kittydale. The SuperKitties save Kittydale from Lab Rat's purple Octo-Gummies.

episodes.name: Pinktastrophe/Battle of the Baddies
episodes.summary: The SuperKitties must stop Zsa-Zsa from stealing all the pink items in Kittydale. Mr. Puppypaws and Cat Burglar compete to see who is the best baddie in town.

episodes.name: Howl-o-ween Charm
episodes.summary: When the Howl-o-ween Cat's charm is stolen, a group of Trixters escapes into Kittydale. The SuperKitties must put the Trixters back in the charm before their tricks ruin Howl-o-ween.

episodes.name: Franken-Rat/Pumpkin Parade
episodes.summary: The Kitties must save Kittydale's Halloween candy from Lab Rat's Franken-Rat robot. The Kitties stop Mr. Puppypaws from spoiling Kittydale's Pumpkin Parade.

episodes.name: Jumbo Rat/New Friend Fiasco
episodes.summary: Bitsy's small size saves the day when a giant Lab Rat steals all the jelly in the city. Cat Burglar devises a plan to take every sparkly collar in Kittydale.

episodes.name: Dancing Piggy/Super Helpers
episodes.summary: The SuperKitties must rescue Wiggles, their new dancing robo-piggy, from Zsa-Zsa and Lab rat before the Kittydale dance party. Bitsy cheers on Pickles as he learns something new.

episodes.name: Museum Mayhem/Big Dig
episodes.summary: Lab Rat and Ginny learn what makes their art special. Sparks learns to share his upset feelings.

episodes.name: Copy Hats/Telescope Trouble
episodes.summary: The Superkitties must stop Cat Burglar from stealing all the trendy hats in Kittydale. Buddy doesn't give up on learning how to use a telescope.

episodes.name: Cat's Pajamas/Country Kitty
episodes.summary: Cat Burglar and a mystery thief compete to steal the Kittydale banner. Bitsy shares her cure for homesickness with Cousin Sassy.

episodes.name: Bone Bandit/Cheesy Chase
episodes.summary: To guard a new dinosaur bone, Buddy must learn to pay attention. Sparks relies on his problem-solving skills to stop Cat Burglar and Lab Rat from stealing a giant cheese wheel.

episodes.name: Seed Stealer/Dastardly Dumpster
episodes.summary: The SuperKitties teach Zsa-Zsa that if she takes care of planted seeds, they'll grow into fruits and veggies for everyone to enjoy. Lab Rat and Otto drop trash on Kittydale.

episodes.name: Wacky Weather/Kittydale Racers
episodes.summary: Lab Rat creates wacky weather that threatens to ruin the Pawesome Picnic. When the Kittydale Race gets sabotaged, Bitsy stops racing to help the SuperKitties save the day.

episodes.name: Brand New Bestie/Cat-o-flauge Kitty
episodes.summary: Bitsy worries that she and Ginny can only be besties if they like the same things. Zsa-Zsa freezes everyone of her group selfie, and Ginny figures out how to use the Cat-o-flauge.

episodes.name: Boat Ride Ruckus/Favorite Fishy Cake
episodes.summary: Sparks faces his fear of getting his face wet to stop Zsa-Zsa from ruining the Paddlepaws Express boat ride. Lab Rat steals fishy cake for Otto's birthday, trapping Bitsy.

episodes.name: Super Spooky House/Pumpkin Ball
episodes.summary: The Kitties face their fears and enter the Super Spooky House. When the Pumpkin Ball is stolen, it's up to the SuperKitties to get it back in time for the Halloween Party.

episodes.name: New King in Town/Tiny Trouble
episodes.summary: Mr. Puppypaws steals royal objects from the Museum. When Cat Burglar shrinks Buddy on his way to steal musical instruments, Buddy learns that he doesn't have to be big to be super.

episodes.name: Runaway Sleigh/Hanukkah Rescue
episodes.summary: When Mr. Puppypaws steals Santa's sleigh, the SuperKitties must save Christmas. The SuperKitties learn to celebrate Hanukkah by lightning a menorah with loved ones.

episodes.name: Bossy Birdy/Brightest Night
episodes.summary: When Zsa-Zsa steals other birds' goodies for her Aunt Lola, the SuperKitties must save the Songbird Soiree. Lab Rat lights up Kittydale in the middle of the night.

episodes.name: Mystery Boot Bandit/Slippery Situation
episodes.summary: Pet boots go missing all over Kittydale. When Lab Rat makes Kittydale super slippery, Bitsy must help the SuperKitties stop her.

episodes.name: Quests for Nests/Pretend Piano Player
episodes.summary: Zsa-Zsa steals bird nests from all over Kittydale. When Mr. Puppypaws pretends Poochissimo's piano playing is his own, the SuperKitties set out to reveal the truth.

episodes.name: Never-Ending Rainbow/Lost Leashes
episodes.summary: Zsa-Zsa spreads colorful clouds all over Kittydale to create a never-ending rainbow. Sparks learns to take a break from his new toy to help the team save the city's doggy leashes.

episodes.name: Easter Buddy/Egg-celent Adventure
episodes.summary: Buddy joins the Bunny Brigade and helps the SuperKitties save Easter treats from Zsa-Zsa. Lab Rat steals all the Easter eggs from the Kittydale Easter Egg Hunt.

episodes.name: Flying Piggy/Get the Zoomies
episodes.summary: Wiggles learns how to fly to free the team from Cat Burglar. Mr. Puppypaws' glittery baby dragons battle the SuperKitties as they try to stop him from not sharing the Zoomie Zone.

episodes.name: Colossal Quacksley/Great Pizza Chase
episodes.summary: Lab Rat turns Quacksley into a giant floatie for Otto to play on. The SuperKitties have to save Pizza Night after Cat Burglar steals all of the pizza pies for his new friend.

episodes.name: Purr N Go Rescue/Peanut Butter Problem
episodes.summary: The SuperKitties switch powers with each other. Ginny and Mr. Puppypaws get stuck in the peanut butter factory.

episodes.name: Robo-Friends/Wacky Wiggles
episodes.summary: Wiggles and Roboctopus learn how to make a friend. When a Wiggles update goes wrong, Bitsy and Buddy learn to listen to instructions so they can save Wiggles from Cat Burglar.

episodes.name: Critter Tower Takedown/Kickin' Kitty
episodes.summary: When Cat Burglar steals the Critter Tower, the SuperKitties and their new wildcat friend have to save it, so everyone can play. Lab Rat kicks the moon model with her giant boot.

episodes.name: To Mommy with Lava/Happy Friendship Birthday
episodes.summary: AJ and Marty try to bake the best dessert for Siggi, but their cake turns into a chocolate volcano mess. AJ can't remember why today is so special to Jessie.

episodes.name: Donation Situation/Birthday Bop
episodes.summary: Detective AJ and Jessie chase the cat burglar who took AJ's old jacket. AJ prepares a special song for her mom's birthday party, but must find a way to conquer her fear to sing it.

episodes.name: Come Here Chameleon/The Trouble with Jazz
episodes.summary: AJ is babysitting Jessie's favorite pet chameleon. AJ and Jessie are excited to become friends with the new kid in town, Jazz, and help him unlock the super world of imagination.

episodes.name: The Long Long Ride/Buggin
episodes.summary: On a long ride home, AJ uses her imagination to pass the time until she can fall asleep. Theo gets lost in some thick bushes so AJ and her friends must brave a jungle to find him.

episodes.name: Building Blockers/Bein Neon Cleon
episodes.summary: AJ, Jessie, and Jazz play with blocks, seeing who can build the tallest tower. Marty's long-lost childhood toy goes missing, and Detective AJ has to find the missing toy.

episodes.name: Nothing but the Tooth/Independence Day
episodes.summary: AJ and Jessie are scared of the dentist, but through a super adventure, they learn that dentists are heroes. AJ walks all by herself to Jazz's house for the first time.

episodes.name: By the Numbas/Knot Today
episodes.summary: AJ goes on a space journey to learn that math is out of this world; AJ's hair is in tangles and knots. Marty and AJ brave the jungle to get her hairstyle ready for picture day.

episodes.name: Keep on Truckin/Don't Mess with AJ
episodes.summary: AJ and Marty plan to surprise Siggi with a brand new food truck. AJ uses her imagination to make cleaning a mission fit for her favorite superhero, Captain Durag.

episodes.name: Attic Adventures/Drone Alone
episodes.summary: AJ goes on an adventure with her lost toys to find her missing bowling ball. AJ is excited to play with her new drone, but she and Marty have to build it first.

episodes.name: Parent of the Month/Can You Dig It
episodes.summary: Jessie's mom wins the "Parent of the Month" award at school. At Dino Day in the park, AJ loses her brand new dino bracelet and is determined to find it without any help.

episodes.name: Cloud Jumpers/The Present
episodes.summary: Major FOMO has created the hottest day of the year, and AJ and Jessie try their best to stay cool. Astronaut AJ and Astronaut Siggi go on a mission so AJ has a good night's rest.

episodes.name: Rain Rain You Can Stay/Care And Care Alike
episodes.summary: AJ's BBQ gets rained out, so she decides to create a song to make the sun come out. When Marty hurts his back, both Siggi and Grandma Luanne help in their own special way.

episodes.name: AJ's Big Mess/Rock-King It
episodes.summary: AJ is having so much fun during a rainy day that she wants to live outside forever. Rockstar AJ, Jessie, and Jazz have a "Sword in the Stone" contest to determine who plays the toy guitar first.

episodes.name: It's Not Easy Eating Greens/Hide and Go Sneak
episodes.summary: AJ adventures through the jungle, trying to eat her collard greens so she can have her dessert. Jessie and AJ play hide-and-seek with their neighbor, little Albert.

episodes.name: Make Way For Play/And Stuff Like That
episodes.summary: AJ, Jessie, Marty, and Siggi help Maggie remember how to play again. AJ is excited to play with all her new high-tech toys with Jessie, but the batteries keep dying.

episodes.name: Rollin'/Game Day
episodes.summary: AJ and Jessie try roller-skating for the first time with Siggi and Marty. When Marty is sad to miss his first game day since retirement, superhero AJ rescues him from Major FOMO.

episodes.name: Bunnybusters/Friendly Competition
episodes.summary: AJ hears spooky sounds from the house and must figure out what is making them. When the family gets together for game night, Marty and his dad, Carl, get too competitive.

episodes.name: Tooth Or Dare/Time In A Bottle
episodes.summary: AJ has her first loose tooth and is nervous about taking it out. AJ and friends find some old space toys buried in her yard.

episodes.name: A Little Squirrely/if I Saved the World
episodes.summary: AJ and Marty are excited for bird watching but a hungry squirrel messes with their new feeder. Watching Captain Durag, AJ and Jessie are determined to save the world just like him.

episodes.name: Jester-Rella/Game Recognize Game
episodes.summary: AJ and Marty must find Jessie and return her lost sneaker in order to escort her to the dance. When missing game pieces threaten to ruin game night, Detective AJ goes on the case.

episodes.name: Gettin In Step!/Family Harmony
episodes.summary: When Siggi and Tanisha perform a step routine, AJ and Marty create their own. On the night of her Family Talent Show, AJ finds herself locked in her room with her cousins.

episodes.name: Not The Hiccups/The Captain Durag Effect
episodes.summary: Jazz's uncontrollable hiccups turn him into a hiccup monster in Boptopia. When Jazz feels nervous about his first karate lesson, AJ goes with him to help.

episodes.name: Somebunny's Missing/Follow the Leader
episodes.summary: AJ loses track of Theo and discovers that playing with friends is more fun than gaming. AJ and her friends go camping at the park and attempt to stop a squirrel thief.

episodes.name: Lights Out/AJ and Grandad's Epic Playlist
episodes.summary: Lights go out during bad weather, and AJ and her friends find a way to save the night. When AJ's granddad visits from England, he and AJ put together an epic music playlist.

episodes.name: Halloween
episodes.summary: It's Halloween and AJ can't decide what to wear. She has an amazing imagination, but she doesn't know which of her many personas is the best for the night.

episodes.name: The Crystal World/Magic Octo-Juggle
episodes.summary: Ariel explores the Crystal World to find out where her axolotl buddy wandered off to; when Lucia performs the Octo-Juggle magic trick, she finds out that it's harder than expected.

episodes.name: The Little Fins/The Biggest Land Treasure
episodes.summary: With help from Ariel, the Little Fins learn to make beautiful music; Ariel and friends discover a big land treasure, but their attempts to move the large object lead to mayhem.

episodes.name: Trident Trouble/Cal's Bright Idea
episodes.summary: When Flounder causes Triton's trident to zap magic, it creates chaos before a big royal dinner; Ariel helps Cal overcome his fear of the dark to explore the Bubble Gardens.

episodes.name: Flounder's Wishes/Triton's Trip
episodes.summary: Flounder finds a Magic Wishing Shell that makes wishes come true; Ariel learns that Triton has to leave on a trip, and decides to hide his favorite bathrobe to make him stay.

episodes.name: Tiny Tails/Ariel's Sea Mobile
episodes.summary: Lucia uses magic to shrink Ariel and her friends for tiny fun; when Ariel, Akiko and Axyl visit the Crystal World, they search for a green crystal to power the new Sea Mobile.

episodes.name: Flounder's Boo Boo/The Marvelous Mahi-Mahi Brothers
episodes.summary: When Flounder gets a boo boo on his fin, he does everything he can to avoid getting checked; Ariel learns about a traveling group of performers that Triton loved as a child.

episodes.name: A Crystal Christmas/The New Year Bubble
episodes.summary: Ariel embarks on a Christmas adventure in the Crystal World to see a giant flurry bubble; when Flounder gets sleepy on New Years Eve, he asks for help to stay awake to celebrate.

episodes.name: The Chum-ba-Chum/Catfish Kerfuffle
episodes.summary: Flounder sees a land creature that keeps disappearing, and tries to find it; when Ariel and Ursula magically transform into catfish, they have to figure out how to turn themselves back to their regular selves.

episodes.name: Camping Trip/The Lion Fish
episodes.summary: Sebastian takes Ariel on a camping trip to spend some time in the great outdoors; Fernie discovers a beautiful jellyfish that's hurt, and works to mend its boo-boo.

episodes.name: The Write Pencil for the Job/The Crystal Koto
episodes.summary: When Sebastian's favorite pencil breaks, Ariel tries to give him a new one; when Akiko breaks a crystal string on her favorite instrument, Ariel helps her find a replacement.

episodes.name: Tomtom for Manman/Do the Fernie
episodes.summary: Fernie makes a special birthday meal for his mom, but runs into silly chaos; Ariel creates a new dance called "The Ariel," but Fernie just can't get the dance right.

episodes.name: Captain Bembé/Tumbling Tumblekelp
episodes.summary: Bembé and Ariel find a captain's hat and play "captain" with it; currents blow tumblekelp all over Fernie's family farm. Ariel and friends help clean things up.

episodes.name: Detective Flounder/Bath Time for Ebb and Flo
episodes.summary: Flounder embarks on a silly search to find Ariel's lost doll. When Ariel and friends give Ebb and Flo their bath, they learn that trying to catch and clean the eels is a lot harder.

episodes.name: The Goldfish/Pufferball
episodes.summary: Ariel goes on a fun adventure to help her new goldfish friend search for gold. Ariel meets a new pufferfish friend named Delroy at the park, and helps find a game he can play.

episodes.name: Flounder's Big SurPrize/Lucia's Puppyfish Problem
episodes.summary: Ariel, Fernie, and Lucia really want to win Flounder a prize at the carnival. When Tica has puppyfish, Lucia can't decide which of the five she wants the most.

episodes.name: Crystal Ball Playdate/Ursula's Special Chariot
episodes.summary: Ariel and friends use a Crystal Ball to take Akiko on a playdate adventure. Ariel and friends clean Ursula's chariot to make it the most special, squeaky-clean chariot ever.

episodes.name: Anora the Forgetful Mergician/Freezy Fun
episodes.summary: A magical mergician character from Ursula's favorite childhood book comes to life. Ariel and Gerdie have to figure out how to unfreeze everything before the big royal dinner.

episodes.name: Fadda's Day/The Coral Crab
episodes.summary: Ariel gets her sister Ayanna to help Akiko make a beautiful robe for Father's Day. When a magic crystal brings a Coral Crab statue to life, Fernie and his friends must catch him.

episodes.name: Twinspiration/Family Picnic Games
episodes.summary: Ayanna and Alanna move into separate workspaces. Ariel and her family compete in fun outdoor games at their family picnic.

episodes.name: Sylvia's Voice/The Tooth Fairy Fish
episodes.summary: Ariel and her friends try to help Sylvia get her lost voice back. Ariel and her cousin, Jewels, can't wait for the Tooth Fairy Fish to visit and leave a pearl under her pillow.

episodes.name: A Mysterious Machine/Nature is Magic!
episodes.summary: Ariel discovers a mysterious machine underground. Fernie has to fill in for Lucia to do magic for their friends and thinks outside the box.

episodes.name: Enchanted Dolphin Cove
episodes.summary: Ariel and friends go on an adventure with Delfino to visit his family at Dolphin Cove. But once they arrive, Ariel must help her new dolphin friends with a tricky problem.

episodes.name: Atlantica Day/A Winner's Spirit
episodes.summary: Ariel composes a celebratory song for Atlantica, but her overzealous efforts to assist Flounder in the All-Atlantica Swim Race teach her the value of letting friends progress at their own pace.

episodes.name: Ursula's Magic Camp/Fernie's Notebook
episodes.summary: Lucia earns a badge at Ursula's Magic Camp. Fernie loses his favourite book.

episodes.name: Crystal Cavern Caper/A Banner Moment
episodes.summary: Ariel tries to stop a pesky hermit crab from stealing her land treasures; when Ariel is tasked with being the royal banner carrier for Atlantica's parade, she thinks it's a small job and doesn't take it seriously. Ariel leads a parade.

episodes.name: The Endless Sleepover / Daddy Daughter Dinner
episodes.summary: When Ariel doesn't want to sleep at a sleepover, she asks her Tantie Ursula to use magic to stop time so that bedtime never comes; Ariel learns the importance of family time when she misses a special dinner with King Triton.

episodes.name: Copy Catfish/Happy Crabby Day
episodes.summary: Ariel grows frustrated when her little cousin Jewels visits and won't stop copying her; Jewels copies Ariel. When King Triton declares Happy Crabby Day as a day off for all crabs, Sebastian must try to relax. Sebastian relaxes for a day.

episodes.name: Smoothie Shake-Up/Family Picture Day
episodes.summary: Ariel and her friends volunteer to run Ravi's Juice Stand while he's away, but their lack of communication stirs up a big mess. Ariel preps for picture day and tries to help Ayanna with a hair emergency on their family picture day.

episodes.name: The Cuttlebaby Sitter/Flounder the Leader
episodes.summary: Ariel volunteers to watch cuttlebaby eggs to prove that she's a good babysitter; Flounder is chosen as the team coach for the Royal Family Cricket Game.

episodes.name: The Clean Team/Clamming Up
episodes.summary: Despite King Triton's warning, Ariel uses magic to clean her room; Ariel and her friends befriend a shy clam.

episodes.name: The Singing Dolphin/The Happy Patty Clap
episodes.summary: Ariel makes a friend. Ariel and her friends can't find a role for Delfino the dolphin in their band; when Ayanna is unable to compete in the Clap Game competition, Ariel steps in so that Alanna can still participate. Ariel plays patty clap

episodes.name: Ravi and Navi/Chef Flounder
episodes.summary: A birthday party mishap. Ariel helps Ravi and his best friend Navi clear up a misunderstanding; Flounder is a cook and uses his cooking skills to help other chefs at the Atlantica Food Festival.

episodes.name: The Brave Little Goby/Kid Triton
episodes.summary: Ariel befriends a little Goby fish who wants to go on adventures like her; Triton accidentally drinks Lucia's magical potion, which turns him into a kid.

episodes.name: The Kite Monster Legend/The Spooky Mirror Trick
episodes.summary: When Fernie doesn't believe in the Kite Monster legend like his friends do, he starts to ruin their fun; Flounder uses Ursula's magic mirror to play a trick on his friends.

episodes.name: Fernie's Dra Konfó/Lucia, Lucia, Lucia!
episodes.summary: When Fernie forgets his comfort blanket at home, he puts on a brave face in front of his friends by saying he doesn't need it to fall asleep; Lucia makes two other versions of herself so she can be at three different playdates at once.

episodes.name: The Lost Dogfish/Swim Scouts
episodes.summary: Ariel really wants to keep a lost dogfish that she finds; a visiting mer-boy joins Ariel and friends on a Swim Scouts field trip.

episodes.name: Daddy Daughter Adventure Day/Rainbow Sea Caves
episodes.summary: Ariel and Triton spend Daddy Daughter Adventure Day together; Ariel and her friends explore the Rainbow Sea Caves.

episodes.name: Flounder's Christmas Letter/Holiday Toy Box Trouble
episodes.summary: When Flounder forgets to send his Christmas letter to Santa Mer-Claus, Ariel and her friends go on a holiday adventure to deliver the letter to him; Sebastian accidentally donates the box of toys that Ariel wants to keep.

episodes.name: The Great Big Garden Show/The Sea Sniffles
episodes.summary: Ariel gives her plant magic food to make it grow for the Great Big Garden Show; Flounder fakes being sick.

episodes.name: Razzle Dazzle/Fernie's Float
episodes.summary: When Lucia helps Ursula with a new magic spell, she creates magical mayhem; Ariel and her friends are tasked with building a float for Ravi's latest juice drink.

episodes.name: Jewels the Winner/Abuelita's Shawl
episodes.summary: Jewels brings down the fun; Lucia gifts a new shawl to her Abuelita.

episodes.name: A Magical Achoo!/Are We There Yet?
episodes.summary: Ursula gets sick; Ariel and family take a road trip.

episodes.name: Best in Ebb & Flo/Me, My Shell, and I
episodes.summary: Ebb and Flo compete; Fernie wants to play by himself.

episodes.name: Picture Perfect Father's Day/Tantie's Day
episodes.summary: Ariel struggles with a Father's Day gift idea for Triton; Ariel and her sisters want to celebrate a very special Tantie's Day by doing nice things for Ursula.

episodes.name: Petting Zoo Day/New Squid in Town
episodes.summary: Ariel runs a petting zoo; a new kid won't take turns.

episodes.name: Family Treasure Hunt/Remy's Big Feelings
episodes.summary: Nana Xola leads a family treasure hunt; Remy gets big feelings and learns to deal with them.

episodes.name: Fernie's New Discovery/Grotto of Manners
episodes.summary: Fernie seeks seahorse unicorns; Ursula creates a game for Ariel and friends.

episodes.name: Noodlemania/Super Flounder
episodes.summary: Flounder helps Chef Louis; Flounder becomes Super Flounder.

episodes.name: The Magic Wand/Racin' Remy
episodes.summary: Lucia borrows a special wand from Ursula; Remy does not follow the rules.

episodes.name: La Sirenusca/Substitute Sebastian
episodes.summary: Ariel tracks down a mythological sea creature; Ariel and friends get a substitute teacher in music class.
