episodes.summary: Promotion: Women Of Wrestling Type: Event Location: Los Angeles, California, USA Arena: Los Angeles Convention Center.

episodes.name: Rites of Passage
episodes.summary: Karen has started secondary school but is not settling in as she feels academically inferior, plus she is worried that her missing hamster may be trapped under the floor-boards. Ben on the other hand is over-joyed as he has landed the lead in his school play, a musical version of 'Spartacus' whilst Jake is in disgrace for getting a tattoo which looks like a spider. Sue sends emails to the parents of Karen's school-mates , which does not help but Pete comforts his daughter with a heart to heart.

episodes.name: K for Victory
episodes.summary: Karen indulges her competitive instincts, Ben delves into the mysteries of human psychology and Jake appoints himself as a parenting expert. Meanwhile, Mum falls victim to a dysfunctional printer and Dad is hounded by a vigilant Daily Mail reader.

episodes.name: House of Hormones
episodes.summary: Pete's 21 year old god daughter Stacey from Australia is staying and sets Ben's pulse racing as she walks around the house in only a towel. Pete thinks it time for Ben to have a chat about the facts of life - from Jake but Jake is more interested in persuading his parents to let girlfriend Alex stay over. Everybody except Pete is delighted when Sue agrees to mind a friend's baby - nicknamed the Werewolf - overnight, prompting Karen to ask awkward questions about child-birth and again raise the topic of her lost hamster. Ultimately Jake regrets his decision when other girlfriends get in touch, possibly tipped off by Sue, whilst Pete is happy to give the baby back to his mother and Ben is happy with a final revealing glimpse of Stacey.

episodes.name: Into the Wilderness
episodes.summary: Pete and Ben go on a bonding trip, camping in the woods, while Sue and Stacy don't exactly see eye-to-eye over the empowerment of women.

episodes.name: Communication Skills
episodes.summary: Sue is trying to organize a conference so it falls to Pete to let Karen in after school but he has to go to buy a central heating pump so rings Jake to come home. Jake has lost his Oyster card and has no cash so this requires a call to Ben, only for Pete to find himself speaking to a Chinese tourist who has found Ben's lost phone. Karen is delayed as the headmistress keeps her back to upbraid her for rubbishing the school rules. Nonetheless she still manages to get in ahead of Pete whilst Ben ends up asking the Chinaman and his wife round for tea.

episodes.name: Spartacus the Musical
episodes.summary: Grandad is very ill, bringing Angela back from America, with toy boy Tommy, whom she met at Sunday school. Sue is immediately rattled when Angela makes plans for their father as well as claiming that he recognized her when he failed to recognize Sue. After Tommy and Stacey decide to tour Europe Angela returns to the States and the family goes to see Ben in his school musical, 'Spartacus'. Ben is surprisingly nervous but a pep talk from Karen gives him the confidence to put on a good show. Sue and Pete also learn that, thanks to Jake, Angela has been persuaded to write a huge cheque that will solves all their worries about Grandad.

episodes.name: Christmas Special 2016
episodes.summary: The Brockman family are on a special mission at Christmas time.

episodes.name: The Funeral
episodes.summary: Sandra interrupts a particularly competitive Wii session between Pete,who has rashly resigned his job,and the boys to ask Pete to read the eulogy at his Uncle Bob's funeral. His brief is not to mention Bernard, Bob's gay lover of fourteen years for whom he left his wife. However,flustered by Sue's giggling,Pete pays tribute to Bernard,earning praise from his mother and wife,as well as finding out something about the vicar. Bernard,however,is less pleased.

episodes.name: The Exchange Student
episodes.summary: No sooner has Brick's solicitor served papers on the Brockmans accusing Angela of abducting Misty to bump up her divorce settlement - and them of aiding a felon - than the bell rings again and Ottfried,Jake's German exchange student,whom noone was expecting,turns up. He is understandably perplexed by the whole set-up ,though he does regard Boris Johnson as a wonderful comedian,and offers Sue and Pete advice. Fortunately Angela decides to return to Brick but that still leaves the problem of Jake's nineteen year old pole-dancing girlfriend,who turns out to be only sixteen and therefore an illegal performer...

episodes.name: Christmas Special 2011
episodes.summary: The Brockmans hope to get away for the holiday, but Granddad's sudden illness and trip to the worst hospital ever threatens their plans.

episodes.name: Christmas Special 2012
episodes.summary: The Brockmans throw a Christmas party with jubilee bunting for decorations but Pete is not happy. Of the kids only Ben wants to help whilst Sandra gets drunk, tactless Norris from next door reminds former TV weather-man Ray of his nervous breakdown and Pete gets shut in the bathroom with neurotic, flu-ridden Jane when the door handle falls off. As the evening progresses Norris's wife runs off with her Lesbian lover, Jane takes an accidental over-dose and is rushed to hospital whilst Jake brings the police to the house. This will certainly be one party for everybody to remember.

episodes.name: The Girls' Day Out
episodes.summary: Now a supply teacher Pete gets grief from his daughter and wife for not helping more about the house. Angered by her menfolk's laziness Sue leaves them to do housework and cook Sunday dinner whilst she takes Karen out for a day at the local shopping mall. Here Karen makes short work of a charity campaigner before asking Sue to buy her clothes to keep up with her shallow school contemporaries. Returning home Sue finds that Ben has broken the washing machine and also has a peculiar idea of the ideal Sunday lunch.

episodes.name: The Labrador
episodes.summary: Karen and Jake are both staying the night with friends whilst Ben is at an adventure camp,terrifying his school-mates with ghost stories. Sue and Pete find themselves dog-sitting Archie for friends of friends. He seems cute but nobody warned that he would go after next door's guinea pigs and run up a ninety pound bill. Pete loves having the kids out of the way and muses on a child-free future. Sue cannot wait to have them back again.

episodes.name: The Parents' Evening
episodes.summary: When Ben tells them that a boy called Oliver is selling drugs at school they wonder if they should report him. Their dilemma grows at Ben's parents' evening when Oliver's mother and father tell them about the drugs problem at his last school,which has now stopped. However,given Ben's teachers' reports of his bizarre behaviour and the fact that Karen is found wandering in the school playground,they decide against making a formal complaint and leave an anonymous note - in capitals.

episodes.name: The Cold Caller
episodes.summary: Ben is perfecting his ventriloquist act for the school talent contest and annoying everybody as usual but this is the least of his parents' worries. First they find out that Jake is dating a nineteen-year-old pole dancer who,due to fake I.D., believes he is eighteen. Then Angela arrives,having split acrimoniously from Brick and bringing his daughter Misty - whom she claims Brick mentally abused - with her. She is writing a book on surviving families and Sue does not like the references to herself in the sneak peep she takes. With Brick having invalidated Angela's credit cards,it looks as if the family is stuck with her . . . and then Brick's solicitor rings the doorbell.

episodes.name: The Tesla Terrorizer
episodes.summary: Tizzy hunts down a pipe-wielding road-rager terrorizing drivers throughout LA.

episodes.name: Portsmouth, Ohio
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe discover Ohio State Parks featuring Shawnee State Park, Lake Hope State Park and the haunted Moonville Tunnel.

episodes.name: Tampa, Florida
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe explore the Tampa RV Super show, take a Lithionics factory tour and race at The Motor Enclave.

episodes.name: Ames, Iowa
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe explore Ames, Iowa camping at Ledges State Park, riding the Rail Explorers, touring Reiman Gardens and tailgating at the Iowa State University.

episodes.name: Ponca, Nebraska
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe tour 3 Nebraska State Parks including Ponca State Park, fishing at Danish Alps State Recreation Area and experiencing the living history at Fort Atkinson State Historical Park.

episodes.name: Oregon, Ohio
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe are camping at Maumee Bay State Park on the shores of Lake Erie in Oregon, Ohio and exploring the Marblehead Lighthouse.

episodes.name: Perry, Georgia
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe are attending the 110th International Family RV Association Convention in Perry, Georgia.

episodes.name: Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe are camping at Ocean Lakes Family Campground in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. Enjoying fresh fish from Seven Seas Seafood market and exploring Atalaya Castle in Huntington Beach State Park.

episodes.name: North Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe are camping in North Myrtle Beach at Willowtree RV Resort exploring the historic town of Loris, South Carolina, learning to shag dance, and renting a boat from North Myrtle Beach RV Resort and Dry Dock Marina.

episodes.name: Paris, Tennessee
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe are camping at Buchanan Resort in Henry County, Tennessee and sampling the World's Biggest Fish Fry, visiting the Tennessee Wildlife Refuge and Paris Landing State Park.

episodes.name: Elkhart, Indiana
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe are camping in the RV Capital of the World - Elkhart, Indiana exploring the RV Hall of Fame and the Hall of Heroes Superhero Museum.

episodes.name: Prince William, Virginia
episodes.summary: Patrice and Kevin McCabe discover the history of Prince William County, Virginia camping at Prince William Forest RV Campground, visiting the National Museum of the Marine Corp, the Manassas Battlefield and NOVA LIVE.

episodes.name: Episode #2.1
episodes.summary: Now officially high-powered career women, Farida and Munira find themselves placed on the contract of a big client with even bigger expectations.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Munira buckles under the weight of family duty. Meanwhile, Farida takes matters into her own hands, turning to an unexpected trade partner for help.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Between her strained relationship with Jude and relentless ex-husband calling the shots, Farida finds herself in a dramatic, heated argument with Munira.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Personal and professional lines are blurred when Munira is presented with a surprise proposal. Farida struggles to adapt to a new family dynamic.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The cousins are entrusted with a crucial task that could make or break them, while Farida experiences the growing challenges of co-parenting.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The floor of the exchange heats up as the IPO goes live. Will Munira and Farida's hard work finally rise to the occasion or plummet to new lows?

episodes.name: Bank of Tomorrow
episodes.summary: As the ink dries on her divorce papers, Farida contends with her new reality. A charity auction reignites a friendly rivalry between her and Munira.

episodes.name: It's a Man's World
episodes.summary: On their first days at work and school, Farida seeks an alliance and Jude keeps a low profile. Feeling unheard, Munira takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.name: Thicker than Milk
episodes.summary: As the family meticulously plans for its matriarch's 80th, Munira finds tactical inspiration in an unlikely place. Farida pursues more independence.

episodes.name: Short and Distort
episodes.summary: The duo's success lands them in the limelight, but the bank's secret plan finds them between a rock and a hard place - and snubbed by their loved ones.

episodes.name: The Silent Partner
episodes.summary: After realizing that their presence in an important meeting is merely for show, Farida and Munira forge their own path - despite external distractions.

episodes.name: What Goes Up
episodes.summary: As the 1987 market crash looms, the Exchange braces for a critical all-nighter. Putting their personal lives on hold, Farida and Munira join the storm.

episodes.name: Area 51
episodes.summary: Hidden in the Nevada desert, a top-secret military base remains one of the most heavily restricted sites in the United States; speculation from hiding experimental aircraft to alien technology; Area 51 keeps its mysteries closely guarded.

episodes.name: Hunt for Adolf Eichmann: Case Closed
episodes.summary: At the end of World War II, many Nazi officials were captured and tried for their crimes; but one of the architects of the Holocaust, Adolf Eichmann, slipped through the cracks, repeatedly eluding Nazi hunters from around the globe.

episodes.name: Legend of the Werewolf
episodes.summary: It's one of humanity's oldest nightmares - at the full moon, werewolves that once were men hunt human prey and then feast on their flesh.

episodes.name: The Theft of the Mona Lisa: Case Closed
episodes.summary: The world's most famous painting vanishes in a daring heist, sparking international outrage and a global manhunt. A master detective is called in, who zeroes in on a handful of suspects with the motive and means to pull off the theft.

episodes.name: The Hunt for the Kraken
episodes.summary: It's one of the most legendary monsters said to be lurking in the vast open seas. With stories going back hundreds of years, this elusive creature has terrorized sailors and baffled scientists. Is this predator the stuff of legends ?

episodes.name: The Murder of Sam Giancana
episodes.summary: Explores the unsolved 1975 assassination of the notorious Chicago mob boss, examining theories that link his death to his planned testimony before a Senate committee about mob ties to the CIA and the JFK assassination.

episodes.name: The Unabomber: Case Closed
episodes.summary: A twisted mastermind uses homemade bombs to terrorize the nation. Despite one of the most extensive manhunts in U.S. history, he still manages to stay one step ahead of law enforcement for nearly two decades.

episodes.name: Who is the Boston Strangler
episodes.summary: A series of shocking murders shake the city of Boston to its core.

episodes.name: The Plot to Kill Lincoln
episodes.summary: A shot rings out from the balcony of the Ford's Theater in Washington, D.C., and America's 16th president-Abraham Lincoln-has been killed. It has been long thought that this was the work of one man, but was it?

episodes.name: The Hunt for El Chapo: Case Closed
episodes.summary: El Chapo is an untouchable drug lord who sat atop a criminal empire and became the most wanted man in the world; for fifteen years, the U.S. and Mexico tries to hunt down El Chapo.

episodes.name: What Killed Bruce Lee?
episodes.summary: Bruce was an icon and the closest being to a real-life superhero. His athleticism and drive would change martial arts forever. But when found dead at age 32, many do not believe the coroner's assessment. So, what-or who-killed Bruce Lee?

episodes.name: The Hunt for Viking Treasure
episodes.summary: Known for their seafaring skills and feared for their ferocity, they amassed gold and other riches whilst trading and raiding across Europe. Caches of these treasures have been found across Europe and North America, are any hoards left?

episodes.name: The Lufthansa Heist
episodes.summary: On December 11, 1978, a gang of thieves lifted around $5 million in cash and $800,000 in jewelry from a luxury airline hangar at New York's JFK Airport, marking the largest heist in U.S. history at that time.

episodes.name: Foo Fighters: WWII Edition
episodes.summary: During World War II, a fiery phenomenon terrorizes American airmen in the night skies over Europe; the pilots call these fireballs "Foo Fighters," and swear they move at over 200 mph and defy the laws of physics. But what are they?

episodes.name: The Search for Rommel's Gold
episodes.summary: One of Germany's top military minds during WWII, General Erwin Rommel The Desert Fox, tears through North Africa.

episodes.name: The Shot Heard Round the World
episodes.summary: When the British Red Coats march into Lexington in 1775 prepared for a surprise attack, they are met with a small scrappy militia ready for a fight; it's the battle that kicked off the American Revolution.

episodes.name: The Death of Alexander the Great
Roswell
episodes.summary: It's one of America's most mythic UFO incidents, a 200-yard swath of debris that landed near Roswell, NM. Some believe it was an alien craft, others that it was a secret government experiment. So what really crashed in Roswell in 1947?

episodes.name: The Franklin Expedition
episodes.summary: The search for the illusive Northwest Passage leads to a historic expedition that sets sail into a labyrinth of ice and is never heard from again. What really killed the men of the Franklin Expedition?

episodes.name: The Valentine's Day Massacre
episodes.summary: On Feb.14th,1929, one of the most shocking murders in mob history goes down in Chicago--and becomes known as the Valentine's Day Massacre. The Massacre is considered the most brutal--and the toughest to solve. So who carried it out?

episodes.name: What is the Yeti?
episodes.summary: Sightings of the Yeti, a creature of myth and legend, have been recorded for thousands of years throughout the Himalayas and surrounding regions. Could this seven-foot-tall creature, covered in shaggy gray hair, be hiding in plain sight?

episodes.name: The Final Flight of Amelia Earhart
episodes.summary: In 1937, pioneering aviator Amelia Earhart vanishes during her ambitious round-the-world flight. Her mysterious disappearance near a Pacific island spawns decades of theories and unanswered questions.

episodes.name: The Death and Fortune of Pablo Escobar
episodes.summary: Pablo Escobar, the notorious narco-trafficker who single-handedly supplied most of America's cocaine in the 1980s, had billions of dollars in cash...and hid stacks of it all over the country. Who killed Escobar? And where did his money go?

episodes.name: The Lost Loot of Jesse James
episodes.summary: Cash, jewels, and two million dollars in gold bars. Jesse James and his gang robbed trains, stagecoaches and banks - and buried the spoils. Only a fraction has actually been found. If James and his gang hid a fortune, where could it be?

episodes.name: The Rendlesham Forest Incident
episodes.summary: A surreal event outside a U.S. Air Force base near the Rendlesham Forest in England becomes an international legend, and one of history's strangest unidentified encounters. What were the Rendlesham lights?

episodes.name: The Amazing Events of the Book of Exodus
episodes.summary: It's history's most famous lost city; the island kingdom that's baffled explorers for centuries; some say Atlantis is a myth, while others insist it was a very real place wiped out thousands of years ago.

episodes.name: The Search for Atlantis
episodes.summary: It's history's most famous lost city: the island kingdom that's baffled explorers for centuries; some say Atlantis is a myth, while others insist was a very real place wiped out thousands of years ago.

episodes.name: The Death of Dillenger
episodes.summary: John Dillinger's life consisted of brazen bank robberies across the country, but his death remains shrouded in mystery: what really happened to John Dillinger ?

episodes.name: The Missing Riches of Genghis Khan
episodes.summary: The legendary ancient ruler who amassed a huge fortune--Genghis Khan--hid his riches so well that to this day no one has unearthed them. 800 years later the fate of his treasure remains a mystery. Where are Genghis Khan's buried riches?

episodes.name: The Missing Tesla Papers
episodes.summary: Nicola Tesla had revolutionary ideas, but in the hands of the wrong people, those ideas could be used for evil purposes, when Tesla died, he allegedly had 80 trunks of papers full of ideas, but only 60 have been seen again.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Copper Scroll
episodes.summary: An ancient treasure map, recorded on a rare Copper Scroll, could lead to billions of dollars of buried treasure, hidden away thousands of years ago from Roman invaders. Where is the secret treasure of the Copper Scroll?

episodes.name: The Killing of Bugsy Siegel
episodes.summary: Notorious mobster Bugsy Siegel is gunned down in his Beverly Hills room; Siegel's killing becomes front page news; no arrest is ever made.

episodes.name: Percy Fawcett and the Lost City of Z
episodes.summary: Percy Fawcett becomes obsessed with a lost city deep in the Amazon jungle, a place he names the City of Z. He vanishes trying to locate it despite numerous missions to find him.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Sphinx
episodes.summary: Rising from the sands of the Egyptian desert is one of the world's greatest wonders, the mighty Sphinx.

episodes.name: The Lost Pirate Treasure of Jean Lafitte
episodes.summary: Known as :The Terror of the Gulf"; the whereabouts of Jean Lafitte's treasure remains unknown; the swamps and bayous were his base, and likely also his hiding place; treasure hunters have found very little of Lafitte's stash.

episodes.name: The Secrets of Easter Island
episodes.summary: The gigantic statues of Easter Island have mystified humanity for centuries; how in the world did an ancient civilization, with only primitive tools, carve and then move thousands of these rock monuments around the island, and why?

episodes.name: Lost Places of the Old Testament
episodes.summary: The Tower of Babel, Sodom and Gomorrah, and Mount Sinai have seemingly vanished from the map; where are the Old Testament's legendary lost places, and what might they reveal?

episodes.name: I'm Already Seeing Red
episodes.summary: Virginia Beach police engage in a massive manhunt to find a killer on a murder spree of revenge, who took the lives of 3 people. Once captured, he proclaims that he simply wants to be heard.

episodes.name: Just Don't Want To Go to Jail
episodes.summary: Authorities grow concerned when a 25-year-old woman reports her 50-year-old father and 6-year-old daughter missing. Police discover their dead bodies in their Lakeland, Florida home and uncover the shocking truth.

episodes.name: That Anger Would Rise Again
episodes.summary: For decades, three violent unsolved murder cases haunted Albuquerque police. When a man was brought in on a minor probation violation, the mystery began to unravel in the confines of the interrogation room.

episodes.name: He Went Boom
episodes.summary: Police are called to the Corner Store when a killer guns down a young man in a public execution in a Pensacola, Florida parking lot. They track down their suspect and find a killer without remorse.

episodes.name: I Just Smiled and Laughed
episodes.summary: A vehicle plows down a 75-year-old military veteran on a country road near Aripeka, Florida. When a young man confesses to the crime, detectives quickly learn they've encountered someone with an intense desire to thrill kill.

episodes.name: It's Despicable and Gruesome
episodes.summary: A young mother is reported missing in Saint Paul, Minnesota. Police discover her dismembered body in a stack of bins. Detectives focus on her husband and learn a murderous psychopath lurks within the facade of the suburban dad.

episodes.name: I Love You to Death
episodes.summary: A killer guns down a 46-year-old woman, and detectives discover that a fleeing Kentucky Sheriff's Deputy is the assailant. Less than 48 hours later, they arrest him in Iowa and reveal an unrepentant person.

episodes.name: It's for You Guys to Find
episodes.summary: After the shooting deaths of father, mother, and two adolescent boys in their suburban Baltimore home, investigators realize it's not a robbery gone wrong but rather the callous execution of a loving family.

episodes.name: The Sexual Psychopath
episodes.summary: Experts identify a subset of psychopaths driven by heightened sexual urges and fantasies. This offenders engages not only in physical violence but also in sexual violence against their victims, commonly referred to as "sexual psychopaths."

episodes.name: Chandelier UFO, Archives for the Unexplained, and Roller Coaster Ghost

episodes.name: (Going) Out with a Bang
episodes.summary: At water therapy, the ladies let loose in more ways than one. An astrologer has the group thinking about their best and worst qualities. On their final night, many eligible bachelors--and one pirate--turn out for Dorinda's disco party.

episodes.name: Old Truck, old frame, new game.
episodes.summary: They say that life is all about choices. Stacey rolls in a well-worn 59 Chevy Apache pickup and shows how to approach a project, whether you are keeping it original or planning on modifying it. Then it's on to the frame and the importance of starting with a solid foundation, as Stacey shows why an aftermarket replacement frame might be your best bet, no matter what your plans are with the paint and interior. It's a great introduction to a level 4, frame-off build and something every gear-head should see.

episodes.name: Making the Bed on a Classic Truck
episodes.summary: Everybody loves trucks, especially old trucks. The problem with restoring an old truck is what to do with the rusty, beat-up bed? Do you repair it or replace it? Stacey digs into that question by building a brand-new bed for the '59 Apache right beside the old one. It's a classic comparison between old and new and shows the contrasts between restoring old parts and starting with new reproduction parts. If you are contemplating a restoration project or are in the middle of one, this show is for you.

episodes.name: Long Train Running
episodes.summary: Stacey goes out on the rails to take a look at the restoration of the legendary 576 Steam Locomotive that serviced the Nashville area in the 40's and 50's. Pulled from a 50-year slumber in a local park, the unique journey of 576 is a huge, multi-year restoration project that will take you into the inner workings of a steam locomotive and how a bunch of volunteers are bringing this massive beast back to life. If you love trains or anything mechanical, you're gonna love jumping on board this ride.

episodes.name: Swamp Spryte Axles & Tracks and MacLaren M6GT Chassis Testing
episodes.summary: The Swamp Spryte is back under the knife as Stacey starts working on replacing the axles and tracks on this rare amphibious tracked vehicle. After that, it's off to Retroformance to show some of the testing and development on the Mclaren M6GT replica.

episodes.name: The Dirt Bird
episodes.summary: This time on GEARZ, Stacey digs into film and TV cars and the impact they have on automotive culture. But we're not talking about sophisticated Lamborghinis, beautiful Mustangs, or hot Trans Ams. No, we're talking about the Joe Dirt side of things and how an old, beat-up Daytona made it cool to drive old, rusty junk.

episodes.name: The Face Off
episodes.summary: Do you like 4 headlights or 2 headlights on a classic vehicle? Well, now it's possible to have both as Stacey shows how to change a 4-headlight classic Chevy truck into a 2-headlight classic Chevy truck, just by changing some sheet metal. But, is it really as easy as it looks, or are there some hidden challenges waiting to bite you? Well, the answers are all here as we face off two different looks on the same truck.

episodes.name: Tranny Swapping a Vintage Mustang; Lifting a Cab Off a Frame
episodes.summary: This time on GEARZ, Stacey takes an old beat up '66 Mustang and puts some pep back in its step. Yep, we show you how to get rid of that old boring automatic transmission and replace it with a quick-shifting TREMEC T5 5-speed. After that, we show you some tips and tricks on how to lift an old cab or body off a frame without destroying it.

episodes.name: A Show Truck with a Diesel Twist, The ARCA Box, Capping a Jeep
episodes.summary: What do you get when you take a 4x4 diesel pickup, toss in over 2000hp, and mix it with some serious bling? You get the very definition of show and go. After that, we take a look at a new twist on tool storage and finish it off with one of the best ways to set up your Jeep Gladiator for hunting, fishing, or overlanding.

episodes.name: The Stunt Double
episodes.summary: The Stunt Double is back for its much-anticipated reveal and payoff. Inspired by the legendary FALL GUY truck, the Stunt Double is a ground-up, frame-off build of a classic Chevy truck that pays tribute to the stunt world.

episodes.summary: Bryce, a man trying to repair his five-year relationship after confessing to infidelity, seeks host Tami Roman's help. Bryce questions whether his girlfriend is seeking revenge for his past actions by cheating on him, which is his biggest fear.

episodes.name: Friend in Greed
episodes.summary: A letter, an elaborate setup and poor acting help solve three different murder investigations.

episodes.name: The Sound of Fear
episodes.summary: A daughter frantically calls 911 after gunmen tie her up and shoot her parents at home. Does she know more than she lets on?

episodes.name: The First Suspect
episodes.summary: A woman vanishes, and her husband calls 911. Months later, police find her badly beaten body and make him suspect No. 1.

episodes.name: For Love or Lies
episodes.summary: A husband finds his wife brutally slain and calls 911. Does he know more than he lets on? CCTV exposes secrecy and lies.

episodes.name: Judging Reactions
episodes.summary: A woman calls 911 after she finds her mother with a knife in her chest. Is she a grieving daughter, or is her call part of a coverup?

episodes.name: Death and Denials
episodes.summary: Police find a man's girlfriend murdered, making him the main suspect. A mother and daughter claim they had nothing to do with a grisly murder.

episodes.name: Suspect #1
episodes.summary: Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they're innocent - but for police, the call can reveal so much more than just the facts of the case.

episodes.name: Clues to Murder
episodes.summary: Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they're innocent - but for the police, the call can reveal so much more than just the facts of the case.

episodes.name: Reactions to Murder
episodes.summary: A mother brutally murdered in her home, the husband and his bizarre alter ego are in the frame after calling 911; a woman is found dead in a creek after a road accident, her husband calls 911 in a panic.

episodes.name: Fooled my Murder
episodes.summary: A wife wakes to find her husband dead outside in the snow, she calls 911; when police discover a volatile history, suspicions are aroused; a man calls police after both his parents are shot dead in their home.

episodes.name: Suspect on the Line
episodes.summary: After a man's savage murder at home, his wife is in the frame after calling 911, but the truth is more macabre than anyone dared believe; a husband finds his wife with shots to the head.

episodes.name: Lover or Liar
episodes.summary: A wife is killed while calling 911 and her husband is shot in the leg; he claims it was an intruder, but the police has their doubts.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: 15 years after Alex Forrest's murder, Dan Gallagher is paroled and reaches out to his estranged daughter Ellen. In the past, a crushing career defeat drives him to first connect with Alex.

episodes.name: The Movie in Your Mind
episodes.summary: An intensely passionate connection turns sour when Dan realizes Alex wants more than it first seemed. In the present Dan's loved ones reel from his reappearance in their lives.

episodes.name: The Watchful Heart
episodes.summary: A retelling of Dan and Alex's unsettling affair from Alex's point of view. In the present, Dan painfully reconnects with his now ex- wife as he and a friend look for evidence that might exonerate him.

episodes.name: Beautiful Mosaics
episodes.summary: A retelling of the emotional impact of Dan's betrayal from the perspective of his wife, Beth, who is trying to ignore what her gut is telling her until tragedy strikes and makes that impossible.

episodes.name: Medial Woman
episodes.summary: Dan decides to confess to Beth about his affair with Alex, while Alex's actions against the Gallaghers only get more severe; Dan's fate is already sealed; Ellen bonds with a new friend; Dan meets an old colleague for lunch and information.

episodes.name: The Dillingers
episodes.summary: Alex's past before she met Dan is reflected through her time spent with Emma and Clay two people whose kindness and help she was incapable of accepting. Dan's world crashes down around him when he is arrested for killing Alex.

episodes.name: Best Friends
episodes.summary: In the present, Dan prepares for his new trial, while in 2008, Dan prepares his defense with Cabral. In the more distant past, key moments shape the woman Alex becomes.

episodes.name: Caregiving
episodes.summary: Dan faces the consequences of his actions in the past and present. Despite regrets, he continues at Jorge's firm, discloses a denied appeal to Ellen, and a brunch at Beth and Arthur's unveils surrounding secrets.

episodes.name: Atomic Sharks
episodes.summary: Phil and Heather investigate disturbing reports of aggressive mutant sharks in Micronesia's Marshall Islands. Joined by a team of scientists, they dive in dangerous waters to explore whether the region's terrifying atomic past is to blame.

episodes.name: Robin Hood's Ghosts
episodes.summary: The team travels to Nottingham, home to the legend of Robin Hood. As they investigate whether centuries of bloodshed have left a paranormal legacy of terror, their search leads to Sherwood Forest, and an encounter with the restless dead.

episodes.name: Secrets of Sherwood Forest
episodes.summary: Phil and Heather continue their investigation into the darker side of the legend of Robin Hood in England. Exploring reports of hostile ghosts in a medieval prison and sinister pagan rituals in Sherwood Forest, uncovering shocking answers.

episodes.name: Ghosts of Guam
episodes.summary: Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores. After reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's jungle in search of answers.

episodes.name: Spirits of 1776
episodes.summary: As America marks its 250th birthday, reports of Revolutionary War ghosts draw Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne to historic battlefields in Pennsylvania. Their investigation uncovers unsettling encounters at the nation's most storied sites.

episodes.name: Secrets of Vulture City
episodes.summary: Joined by Jack Osbourne, Heather travels to Arizona and investigates the eerie remains of Vulture City, a ghost town long stalked by Gold Rush-era ghosts. However, they soon discover there may be a darker, more ancient force at work.

episodes.name: Atomic Ape Cat
episodes.summary: In the forests of Washington's Columbia River Gorge, Phil and Heather hunt a monstrous black cat with an ape-like face. Clues lead to a WW2-era nuclear facility that could be to blame, but they must find the creature before it finds them.

episodes.name: Blackbeard's Ghost
episodes.summary: Heather and Phil explore North Carolina's Ocracoke Island, where locals fear the ghost of Blackbeard is lingering. Is the legendary pirate's restless spirit protecting hidden treasure, or seeking vengeance upon the living?

episodes.name: Terror Below Deck
episodes.summary: Phil and Heather board the USS Hornet, a haunted WWII aircraft carrier said to be crawling with spirits, both good and evil. Exploring its decks, they find eerie signs that the ship's sailors may still be guarding it from beyond the grave.

episodes.name: God of the Underworld
episodes.summary: Phil and Heather travel to Predjama Castle, once ruled by a brutal baron feared for his cruelty. Exploring the vast web of caves beneath fortress, they seek clues that an ancient god of the underworld may be haunting the castle instead.

episodes.name: Terrors of Trinidad
episodes.summary: Reports of shadowy figures and malevolent spirits from Caribbean folklore draw Phil and Heather to Trinidad. They explore a notorious plantation and an abandoned island once used as a leper colony, searching for the source of the activity.

episodes.name: Nightmare Island
episodes.summary: In Trinidad, Heather and Phil continue to confront terrifying claims of demonic possession and Obeah curses, tracing the sinister forces that locals say still grip the island.

episodes.name: Thunderbird
episodes.summary: Sightings of a massive bird and reports of missing livestock send Phil and Heather deep into western Pennsylvania. On the hunt for the legendary Thunderbird, they search for proof of the creature that has haunted legends for generations.

episodes.name: The Spanish Boogeyman
episodes.summary: Phil and Heather head to Belmonte Castle in La Mancha, Spain, said to be haunted by the Spanish Boogeyman. Inside the castle, they discover surprising secrets that reveal the truth behind the terrifying legend.

episodes.name: Ghosts of Gettysburg
episodes.summary: The team heads to the site of the bloodiest battle on U.S. soil, where witnesses claim to see phantom soldiers roaming the battlefields at night, and shadow figures haunting historic buildings like the Jennie Wade House and Farnsworth Inn.

episodes.name: Road Rager
episodes.summary: One lady fails to show up for her appointment. Two girls get pulled over for a DUI, and another guy has a PI and burglary charge.

episodes.name: The Great Escape
episodes.summary: One guy gets pulled over with no license and bike has gotten different VIN numbers, another guy is an escape artist, and one lady swallowed some meth and a waiting game to see if she passes it.

episodes.name: Once Bitten, Twice Convicted
episodes.summary: One guy has a dance with a german Shepard (parole violation and stolen goods). Another guy has drugs but no prescription on hand, and Jessica draws a firearm. She was a correctional officer at one time.

episodes.name: Naked Rage
episodes.summary: Linsey shows up for court drunk, Michael tries to run over the police, and a streaker gets caught for a DWI. Just wait until they get sober.

episodes.name: Fugitive Friday Frenzy
episodes.summary: In Flagler, it's Fugitive Friday Bingo where the Flagler Sheriff's Office snags a fugitive on the run for Grand Theft Auto.

episodes.name: DUI Dilemma
episodes.summary: A midnight burglar terrorizes a woman in Mesa County, CO, sparking a manhunt. Meanwhile, a husband arrested for drug possession is desperate to bail out and find his wife.

episodes.name: Motorcycle Lovers
episodes.summary: In Flagler, FL officers detain a person driving under the influence of drugs and an out-of-towner gets brought in for possession with intent to sell after a tense standoff with the police.

episodes.name: Jailhouse Smuggler
episodes.summary: In Mesa County, a man caught smuggling fentanyl into jail faces mounting charges, while a woman arrested for drinking and driving worries about her dogs. In Flagler, a 19-year-old risks prison after stealing $8,000 from his grandfather.

episodes.name: The Real Grand Theft Auto
episodes.summary: Flagler Police track down a young man who didn't know that the car he was driving was stolen.

episodes.name: Fight Night
episodes.summary: In Flagler county, a man is busted for stealing a wallet in a convenience store.

episodes.name: Gloria Green/Daddy Ditty
episodes.summary: Gloria tries to move out of the Greens' house, but wonders if she can handle life on her own again. Gramma, Cricket and Tilly force a country music star to write a song for Bill.

episodes.name: Fitness Test/The Farmies
episodes.summary: Remy excuses himself from the mayoral fitness test and Cricket is turned into a super soldier. Bill competes for the Golden Gourd award while Tilly falls for a Hot Potato.

episodes.name: Metal Heads/Potted Meat
episodes.summary: Bill buys the kids a metal detector. When Gramma complains that Cricket and Tilly are soft, the kids try to prove they can handle the deprivations of Gramma's childhood.

episodes.name: Caging Cricket/Trainer Tilly
episodes.summary: When Bill betrays Cricket's trust, Cricket traps him in a cage and runs to an amusement park. Tilly trains Cricket to be civilized so he can go to a fancy gala at the Remingtons.

episodes.name: Remy Regatta/Green Journalism
episodes.summary: After a fight with his mom, Remy decides to skipper his own ship in the annual regatta. Tilly fears her family is growing distant and starts a newspaper to keep them connected.

episodes.name: Bad Dad/Junk Junkie
episodes.summary: Cricket and Tilly get to know their grandpa while Nancy scrambles to find him a job. Desperate to ensure his family's future security, Bill becomes a hoarder.

episodes.name: Handshaken/Coffee Mates
episodes.summary: After being mocked for his handshake, Cricket trains for a Western-style handshake duel. Gloria combines her work life and social life by hiring her friends as employees.

episodes.name: Iced/Chipped Off
episodes.summary: Gramma butts heads with Nick when he crashes her special family hockey outing. Chip Whistler recounts what happened to him since "Chipocalypse Now."

episodes.name: Internetted/Guiding Gregly
episodes.summary: Tilly goes down an internet rabbit hole to figure out what happened to her favorite ice cream treat. Cricket tries to teach Gregly how to make friends.

episodes.name: Family Tree/Unguarded
episodes.summary: Bill just wants Tilly to come down from a tree. When Remy tells Vasquez he no longer needs his protection, Vasquez speaks with a therapist.

episodes.name: Concrete Jungle/Starter Pack
episodes.summary: A nature documentary portrays Big City as a wild ecosystem. Avid collector Remy struggles to cope after Cricket finds the rarest of all trading cards.

episodes.name: Dollar Sense/True Cawing
episodes.summary: To prove to his parents that he is money-wise, Remy starts his own business. Feeling neglected by his family, Bill befriends a murder of crows.

episodes.name: Fortune Feller/No Escape
episodes.summary: Cricket tries to avoid a fortune teller's ominous prediction that he will get a stinky slap. In an inescapable escape room, Cricket must decide between family and freedom.

episodes.name: Turkey Trouble/Hard Bargain
episodes.summary: Bill begrudgingly joins Cricket to cover up a turkey crime on Thanksgiving. The Greens get into crazy hijinks in a Smalton antique shop.

episodes.name: Dream Tree/Blue Greens
episodes.summary: Bill and Cricket follow clues from Cricket's dream to search the woods for the perfect Christmas tree. Tilly catches ennui, so Cricket tries to cheer her up.

episodes.name: Hullabaloo'd/Jaded
episodes.summary: Gramma needs help with a winter tradition but worries her family won't come through. Feeling overshadowed by Jade, Gloria starts a suggestion box at the cafe to dial Jade back.

episodes.name: Dog Proof/Cricket Control
episodes.summary: Cricket is caught eating dog food by Gloria and must stop her from revealing his secret shame. Bill installs a parenting device to monitor and discipline Cricket for him.

episodes.name: April Fool/Good Grief
episodes.summary: Cricket tries to come up with the perfect prank to play on his girlfriend on April Fools' Day. Bill goes to extremes to prevent Tilly from experiencing grief.

episodes.name: Evil Family/Greens Underground
episodes.summary: Chip Whistler attempts to create an evil family, so he can take down the Greens; the Greens move to the suburbs and live under new identities to hide from Chip.

episodes.name: Freebie Frenzy/TP'd
episodes.summary: The Greens cause trouble during free sample day at the farmers market. Cricket and Nancy toilet paper all of Smalton in a quest for pranking glory.

episodes.name: Chocolate Santa/Meadow Mania
episodes.summary: In summer, Cricket impulsively eats Bill's chocolate Santa and must replace it. When Gramma's serene country retreat is disrupted by an outdoor festival, she resolves to stop it.

episodes.name: Split Decision/Skipped Over
episodes.summary: Cricket gets dumped by his girlfriend, so he tries to change to win her back. Bill becomes hyper-competitive when Cricket starts to be better at things than him.

episodes.name: One Hundred
episodes.summary: The Greens are determined to make their 100th adventure their best, even if that means unleashing monstrous chickens, venturing into the afterlife, and delivering a mysterious box.

episodes.name: Chip's Revenge
episodes.summary: Chip enacts his ultimate revenge plan by framing the Green family for ruining Big City and turning everyone against them, and Cricket and the Greens must come together to clear their name and defeat him once and for all.

episodes.name: Charity Case/Like Father
episodes.summary: When Tilly sees a manipulative ad, she goes to extremes to save all moths. After spending a week with Bill, Cricket fears he's infected with "Billness."

episodes.name: Truck Stopped/Jingled
episodes.summary: Tilly and Cricket wrestle with indecision at a truck stop between Big City and the country. Tilly wants to become a Big City jingle writer and rising through the ranks.

episodes.name: Saxon Saxability/Remy Dillemy
episodes.summary: Tilly gets caught up in the world of make-believe when she sets out to help Saxon find true love. Remy's parents try to build a stronger relationship with their son.

episodes.name: Swashbuckled/Nick Scouts
episodes.summary: Gramma assembles a seaworthy crew to retrieve packages stolen by Big City's porch pirates. Nick creates a fake scouting troop to trick Cricket and Tilly into raising money for him.

episodes.name: Flexed/After Dark
episodes.summary: The Greens get the work out of their life at Big City's new gym. Cricket finds a loophole to his curfew that will let him attend a late-night drone show.

episodes.name: Spinned Off/Broken Karted
episodes.summary: Big Tech unveils its slate of AI-generated TV shows based on the people of Big City. Tilly's belief in positive thinking is tested when she drives Lupita's faulty go kart.

episodes.name: Short Wait/Awful Lawful
episodes.summary: A hungry Cricket finds a way to speed up a restaurant's short wait. Nancy tries to stop Cricket from breaking all of Smalton's weird laws.

episodes.name: Scooped/Mulligan'd
episodes.summary: Tilly tries to inspire others into community improvement by cleaning up dog droppings. Nick suggests Nancy start a U-Pick operation, but Nancy remains suspicious of his intentions.

episodes.name: Stand-Up Bill/Green Trial
episodes.summary: Bill discovers his favorite comedian, Fred the Farmer, may not be who he claims to be. Tilly defends Cricket at a family trial after he is accused of stealing an entire cake.

episodes.name: The Baby in the Yellow Blanket
episodes.summary: Could Sabrina Aisenberg still be alive today? Five month old Sabrina vanished from her crib in Tampa, gaining national attention. The investigation quickly zeroed in on her parents. But could Sabrina have been kidnapped?

episodes.name: Lost in the Night
episodes.summary: A Colorado teen who dreams of being a nurse vanishes in the night; police initially deem Lashaya a runaway, but surveillance videos reveal a secret meeting with an ex and two mysterious figures who vanish into the darkness.

episodes.name: Disappeared in the Desert
episodes.summary: In 2009, 30-year-old devout Mormon Steven Koecher takes mysterious road trips, driving great distances across the desert, eventually abandoning his car in a Nevada cul-de-sac. His last known moments were caught on surveillance cameras.

episodes.name: Fix It Time!
episodes.summary: Everyone's scooters are mysteriously breaking in Botsburg. The Squad tries to uncover the cause and launches a clinic to fix them using math and engineering skills. Back home, Jackie tests her new fixing skills on a broken family heirloom.

episodes.name: Leave the Leaves
episodes.summary: The Cybersquad uses time travel to help Hacker understand why his pet smirble BB loves a healthy park.

episodes.name: Be There or Be Cyber Square
episodes.summary: The CyberSquad and Bernice the Beetle take on Hacker in a Cyber Square game; Inez uses fractions to keep peace with León.

episodes.name: The Power of Patterns
episodes.summary: The CyberSquad races through a fizzy asteroid belt and solves math patterns to get the CyberStar back from Hacker.

episodes.name: Every Flipper Counts
episodes.summary: The penguins must choose a team captain for the Belly Bowl; the CyberSquad introduces voting as a fair way to decide.

episodes.name: If You Can't Stand the Heat
episodes.summary: The CyberSquad tries to keep cool as a heat wave sweeps through the cybersite during the annual Factoria Flower Show.

episodes.name: Cyberdillos in the Outfield
episodes.summary: Something causes chaos at the Dingerville ball field; Inez is forced to share her room with her younger sister.

episodes.name: Hacker's Birthday Bash
episodes.summary: When Buzz's plans the perfect birthday party for Hacker cause too much pollution, Delete brings in the CyberSquad to help.

episodes.name: The Domino Dilemma
episodes.summary: A quiet day at Jackie's house is ruined by a noisy snowblower; loud music in Botsberg spoil two cyberkids' dream of setting a new domino record.

episodes.name: A Berry Special Mother's Day
episodes.summary: Matt gets his mom two adopted alpacas for Mother's Day; the CyberSquad goes on a wild adventure helping Hannah find the ideal spot for growing Mother's Day cyberberries.

episodes.name: A Fungus Among Us
episodes.summary: Hacker steals all the mushrooms from the Southern Frontier to accomplish his mission to glow in the dark, which harms the cybersite's meeting tree.

episodes.name: The Kite Flying Showdown
episodes.summary: Digit takes on Hacker as he competes in an annual kite-flying competition at Big Dune Beach.

episodes.name: The Heat Beneath Your Feet
episodes.summary: Buzz and Delete go to Dancing Water Springs to watch a super geyser erupt and bump into the CyberSquad.

episodes.name: A Prince Is Born
episodes.summary: A shy lion cub born into royalty witnesses a devastating hunt that reveals the harsh realities of savannah life. As he gains courage through experience, a lone journey leads him to confront his pride's deadliest foe.

episodes.name: A Band of Brothers
episodes.summary: After a harrowing escape, 12-week-old Kio struggles to gain acceptance from his older brothers while learning what it takes to become a king. When tragedy strikes, Summer must make a profound choice that will shape Kio's destiny.

episodes.name: The Greatest Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Summer and Kio rejoin their siblings, but survival proves challenging. Their mother struggles to provide for her inexperienced family and must hunt alone. Driven by desperation, she makes a fateful choice that alters Kio's future.

episodes.name: To Be King
episodes.summary: Separated from their pride, Kio and his brothers venture into dangerous territory seeking a new home. When they find a promising marsh with lionesses, they must fight the resident males to establish their own reign.

episodes.name: Knockouts 1 & 2
episodes.summary: The first knockout game features Victoria Groce, Yogesh Raut and Brad Rutter, followed by the second game with Matt Amodio, Roger Craig and Juveria Zaheer.

episodes.name: Knockouts 3 & 4
episodes.summary: Knockout game three features Neilesh Vinjamuri, Isaac Hirsch and Adriana Harmeyer facing off to see who will go up against Yogesh Raut and Roger Craig in game four.

episodes.name: Knockouts 5 & 6
episodes.summary: The fifth knockout game features Victoria Groce, Matt Amodio and Adriana Harmeyer, followed by the sixth game with Neilesh Vinjamuri, Juveria Zaheer and Brad Rutter.

episodes.name: Quarterfinals 1 & 2
episodes.summary: The first quarterfinal game features Yogesh Raut, Victoria Groce and Roger Craig, followed by the second game with Juveria Zaheer, Isaac Hirsch and Matt Amodio.

episodes.name: Quarterfinals 3 & 4
episodes.summary: Quarterfinal games three and four feature Yogesh Raut, Victoria Groce, Roger Craig, Juveria Zaheer, Isaac Hirsch and Matt Amodio.

episodes.name: Quarterfinals 5 & 6
episodes.summary: Quarterfinal games five and six feature Yogesh Raut, Victoria Groce, Roger Craig, Juveria Zaheer, Isaac Hirsch and Matt Amodio.

episodes.name: Semifinals 1 & 2
episodes.summary: Semifinal games one and two feature Yogesh Raut, Victoria Groce, Juveria Zaheer and Isaac Hirsch.

episodes.name: Semifinals 3 & 4
episodes.summary: Semifinal games three and four continue with Yogesh Raut, Victoria Groce, Juveria Zaheer and Isaac Hirsch.

episodes.name: Finals 1 & 2
episodes.summary: Top-ranked contestants compete for the $500,000 grand prize, including Yogesh Raut, Victoria Groce, and Juveria Zaheer.

episodes.name: Titans vs Nini Nguyen
episodes.summary: Bobby Flay faces Titan Ayesha Nurdjaja with Last Bite Hotel winner Chef Nini Nguyen as challenger. Judge Daniel Boulud brings his expert palate to the competition.

episodes.name: Titans vs Martel Stone
episodes.summary: Chef Stone brings West African flavors to Bobby Flay's club, facing the Titans. He aims to settle things with Brooke Williamson for $25,000, with global chef Lorna Maseko judging.

episodes.name: Titans vs Avishar Barua
episodes.summary: Bengali American chef Avishar Barua has already won Beat Bobby Flay, and now he's ready to test his might against Bobby Flay's Titans for a chance at $25,000. New York City chef Leah Cohen decides who will triumph.

episodes.name: Titans vs Adrianne Calvo
episodes.summary: Miami chef Adrianne Calvo won SOBE Food and Wine Festival's Triple Threat competition, but can she take down Bobby Flay's Titans on their home turf to win $25,000? OG restaurateur Rick Bayless amps up the pressure with his judging.

episodes.name: Titans vs Bryan Voltaggio
episodes.summary: Chef Michael Voltaggio faces his brother Bryan in competition. Bryan aims to finally beat Michael and defeat Bobby Flay's Titans for $25,000. Chef Michael Solomonov judges their sibling rivalry.

episodes.name: Titans vs Karen Akunowicz
episodes.summary: For a shot at $25,000, savvy competition veteran Chef Karen Akunowicz lights up Bobby Flay's kitchen with her fiery personality and battles the Titans with her "modern grandma" cuisine. Judge Scott Conant doesn't go easy on anyone with his high standards.

episodes.name: Titans vs Jet Tila
episodes.summary: Chef Jet Tila faces the Titans as Bobby Flay's pick. With Emmy and James Beard nominations plus a Guinness Record, he aims for Triple Threat Champion status. Chef Lorena Garcia will judge.

episodes.name: Titans vs Dale Talde
episodes.summary: Chef Dale Talde brings a chip on his shoulder and challenging round three ingredients in hopes of stumping the Titans to win $25,000. Bobby Flay invites royalty to judge the competition, and "Queen" Giada De Laurentiis expects excellence.

episodes.name: Titans vs Maneet Chauhan
episodes.summary: Maneet Chauhan challenges the Titans. After two Tournament of Champions losses to Maneet, Brooke Williamson defends her turf. Chef Charlie Mitchell delivers stern judgments.

episodes.name: Elie Wiesel: Soul on Fire
episodes.summary: The life and career of Nobel Peace Prize winner and Holocaust survivor Elie Wisel, who authored 57 books, taught as a university professor, and championed human rights over his decades-long career.

episodes.name: Sun Ra: Do The Impossible
episodes.summary: Discover the extraordinary life of poet, philosopher and music visionary Sun Ra. With his ever-evolving collective, the Sun Ra Arkestra, he self-produced more than 200 albums, stretching the boundaries of jazz.

episodes.name: Bella! This Woman's Place Is in the House
episodes.summary: Follow the meteoric rise of firebrand politician and activist Bella Abzug. Considered one of the first feminists to be elected to Congress, her commitment to women's rights and progressive causes upended the status quo in Washington.

episodes.name: W.E.B. Du Bois: Rebel With a Cause
episodes.summary: From his birth, just five years after the Emancipation Proclamation; to his death, on the eve of the March on Washington in 1963, W.E.B. Du Bois's legacy as an activist continues to resonate today.

episodes.name: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
American Pachuco: The Legend of Luis Valdez
The Disappearance of Miss Scott
episodes.summary: Jazz virtuoso and screen superstar Hazel Scott was the first Black American to have their own television show. An early civil rights pioneer, she faced down the Red Scare at the risk of losing her career and was a champion for equality.

episodes.name: LIZA: A Truly Terrific Absolutely True Story
episodes.summary: Take an intimate look into the life of Liza Minnelli, best known for her Oscar-winning role in Cabaret. Following in the footsteps of her mother Judy Garland, Minnelli used her boundless raw talent to build her own legacy in showbiz.

episodes.name: Art Spiegelman: Disaster is My Muse
episodes.summary: The career of cartoonist Art Spiegelman, and the impact of his Pulitzer Prize-winning graphic novel, "Maus: A Survivor's Tale," which he describes as his parents' survival of the Holocaust.

episodes.name: Janis Ian: Breaking Silence
episodes.summary: A journey through the life of singer songwriter Janis Ian and how she rose as a folk icon and gay rights advocate.

episodes.name: Ten Times Better
episodes.summary: The astonishing and heartwarming story of George Lee, a pioneering Asian dancer who originated a featured role in George Balanchine's The Nutcracker 70 years ago as a teenage immigrant from China.

episodes.name: Hannah Arendt: Facing Tyranny
episodes.summary: Hannah Arendt, bold 20th century political thinker, drew from her WWII experiences as prisoner and refugee to develop influential theories on totalitarianism that remain relevant today.

episodes.name: Marcella
episodes.summary: Marcella Hazan revolutionized Italian cooking in America after moving to NY in the '50s, sharing authentic recipes from her heritage through influential cookbooks.

episodes.name: Marlee Matlin: Not Alone Anymore
episodes.summary: Follow the life and career of 4-time Emmy nominee Marlee Matlin as she shares her story in her native American Sign Language. Known for roles in The West Wing and CODA, at 21 years old, Matlin became the first Deaf actor to win an Oscar.

episodes.name: Starring Dick Van Dyke
episodes.summary: A celebration of the life and career of actor Dick Van Dyke on his 100th birthday, featuring never before seen footage, photos, and home movies that detail his legacy in show business.

episodes.name: Mission Slim-possible
episodes.summary: After weight loss surgery, Jaz is now bedbound, causing friction with Nesha. Tensions rise as Nesha seeks income while Jaz worries about her upcoming doctor's visit.

episodes.name: Abs-olutely Not
episodes.summary: Jaz must face reality after learning that she has gained weight... but she decides to delay a painful lecture from Dr. Nouri until after her birthday party and a first date. Meanwhile, Nesha goes to a cult support group and must confront her painful past.

episodes.name: Attack of the Snacks
episodes.summary: California besties, Jaz and Nesha, are not your average roommates. At a combined 1000-lbs, they have big personalities and an even bigger appetite for life, but a sobering talk with a friend makes Jaz realize her life is on the line.

episodes.name: Fries Before Guys
episodes.summary: Jaz and Nesha's days of bonding over the burger are over after Jaz is tasked with losing 130 pounds. Nesha's situationship is a confusing situation.

episodes.name: Kale-ing Me Softly

episodes.name: Emigre
episodes.summary: The New York Philharmonic and an international cast perform this semi-staged oratorio that tells the story of Jewish refugees during World War II. Following 1938's Kristallnacht - also known as The Night of Broken Glass - two brothers are sent halfway around the world to Shanghai to escape the Nazis. Otto cherishes his heritage, while Josef seeks a new path and falls in love with Lina, a Chinese woman recovering from the death of her mother in the Nanjing Massacre. A tale of love and loss directed by Mary Birnbaum and conducted by Long Yu, 'Great Performances - Émigré: A Musical Drama with the NY Phil' is set to music by film and concert composer Aaron Zigman with lyrics by Grammy-winning librettist Mark Campbell and additional lyrics by Brock Walsh. Co-commissioned by Maestro Long Yu, the Shanghai Symphony Orchestra and the New York Philharmonic, the 90-minute production was filmed on February 29 and March 1, 2024, at Lincoln Center's David Geffen Hall, home of the New York Philharmonic.

episodes.name: Land of Gold
episodes.summary: This installment explores the making of San Francisco Opera's 'Girls of the Golden West', which tells the turbulent story of the 1849 California Gold Rush. With the opera's title referencing Puccini's 1910 romantic opera 'The Girl of the Golden West', Pulitzer Prize-winning composer John Adams and famed director Peter Sellars' opera tells a harsher and more complex story through the letters of writer Louise Clappe who lived in a miners' settlement in 1850. Spotlighting the behind-the-scenes action during the opera's rehearsal process, the documentary highlights the creative process as actors and creative team grapple with the historical significance of the material and bringing it to the stage. Two stories are told: One on stage in the present day, and one in the past through the opera. Soprano Julia Bullock stars in the opera as Louise Clappe with mezzo-soprano J'Nai Bridges as Josefa Segovia, two women among the many men caught up in the quest for wealth in the lawless mountains. The talent includes: Jon Else - Documentary director // Peter Sellars - Director, 'Girls of the Golden West' // John Adams - Music // Julia Bullock - Soprano, as Louise Clappe in 'Girls of the Golden West' // J'Nai Bridges - Mezzo-soprano, as Josefa Segovia in 'Girls of the Golden West' // Ryan McKinny - Bass-baritone, as Clarence King in 'Girls of the Golden West' // Paul Appleby - Tenor, as Joe Cannon in 'Girls of the Golden West' // Elliot Madore - Baritone, as Ramone in 'Girls of the Golden West' // Lorena Feijoo - Dancer, as Lola Montez in 'Girls of the Golden West'.

episodes.name: Patsy Cline: Walkin' After Midnight
episodes.summary: Country music legend Patsy Cline was a trailblazer in her genre, paving the way for artists who followed in her footsteps. This fall, Great Performances presents Patsy Cline: Walkin' After Midnight, a star-studded concert filmed at the historic Ryman Auditorium, Patsy's home stage in Nashville, to celebrate her life, legacy and music. The concert features artists from numerous genres like country, pop, rock, gospel, bluegrass and more including Wynonna, Ashley McBryde, Grace Potter, Beverly D'Angelo, Crystal Gayle, Pat Benatar and Neil Giraldo, Mickey Guyton, Kristin Chenoweth, Rita Wilson, Natalie Grant, Kellie Pickler, Pam Tillis, Tigerlily Gold, Reyna Roberts, Tami Neilson, Tiera Kennedy, Mandy Barnett, Annie Bosko, The Isaacs and Home Free. The program also features archival interviews and commentary from fellow artists and those who knew Patsy including her husband, Charlie Dick, and friends like Loretta Lynn, Dottie West, Roy Clark and Owen Bradley.

Message in a Bottle
episodes.summary: Great Performances presents "Message In A Bottle", featuring the hits of 17-time Grammy-winning artist Sting with choreography by five-time Olivier Award nominee Kate Prince. The dance-theater production from London's Sadler's Wells Theatre tells the story of a family forced to leave their homeland and embark on a perilous journey to freedom. With musical arrangements by Alex Lacamoire (Broadway's "Hamilton," "Dear Evan Hansen"), and a mix of dance styles performed by Kate Prince's ZooNation dance company, Great Performances: "Message In A Bottle" relays a quest for humanity and hope. Recorded in August 2022, the show features Sting's chart-topping hits including "Every Breath You Take," "Roxanne," "Walking On The Moon" and more.

With performances by multi-Grammy Award winner and jazz musician Herbie Hancock, dancer and choreographer Lucinda Childs, and five-time Grammy winner H.E.R., the program includes the prelude to Bach's Partita in E, a work titled FOG by former LA Phil music director Esa-Pekka Salonen, Debussy's La Mer, and more.

tt39365196.title: The Great American Road Rally: Celebrity Edition

episodes.name: Carlos Vives y La Provincia
episodes.summary: Celebrated Colombian superstar Carlos Vives, an 18-time Latin Grammy and multiple Grammy winner, performs with his 11-piece band La Provincia, showcasing songs from El Último Disco alongside a career-spanning collection of beloved hits.

episodes.name: Ryan Bingham and the Texas Gentlemen
ACL 12th Annual Hall of Fame Honors Brandi Carlile
episodes.summary: Bonnie Raitt performs a tribute to Brandi Carlile as she is inducted into the ACL Hall of Fame.

episodes.name: Finneas
episodes.summary: Singer, songwriter and producer FINNEAS takes center stage with songs from his solo outing For Cryin' Out Loud. The ten-time Grammy-winning hitmaker dazzles with highlights and new gems detailing his sonic journey in a revelatory hour.

episodes.name: The Marias
episodes.summary: The Marías make their ACL debut with songs from their acclaimed Submarine in a spellbinding hour. The bilingual group blends English and Spanish lyrics anchored by smoke velvet vocals, hypnotic guitar and lush jazz percussion.

episodes.name: ACL 11th Annual Hall of Fame Honors My Morning Jacket
episodes.summary: ACL inducts rock legends My Morning Jacket into the 11th Annual ACL Hall of Fame. Special guest Cameron Crowe honors the fan-favorite Kentucky band, and MMJ takes the stage with classics and new highlights from their latest LP Is.

episodes.name: Charlie Crockett/Waxahatchee
episodes.summary: A pair of Grammy-nominated acts take the ACL stage: Country maverick Charley Crockett thrills with tunes from his "Lonesome Drifter," and breakout singer-songwriter Waxahatchee sparkles with gems from her acclaimed "Tiger's Blood."

episodes.name: Samara Joy
episodes.summary: NAACP Image Award winner and 5x Grammy-winning jazz vocalist Samara Joy shines with gorgeous vocals and exciting arrangements in a dazzling hour. She performs songs from her breakthrough Linger Awhile and her latest studio album Portrait.

episodes.name: Austin City Limits Celebrates Antone's & The Blues
episodes.summary: ACL salutes the 50th Anniversary of iconic Austin blues club Antone's and the series' own history of showcasing blues in a supercharged hour featuring an all-star line-up.

episodes.name: Kelsea Ballerini / CAM
episodes.summary: Acclaimed genre-bending country acts Kelsea Ballerini and Cam deliver radiant ACL debuts: Chart-topper Ballerini dazzles with hits and highlights from her LP "Patterns"; Grammy-winning Cam showcases her new collection "All Things Light."

episodes.name: Role Model/MJ Lenderman & the Wind
episodes.summary: A pair of next-generation singer-songwriters make ACL debuts: chart-topper Role Model performs hits from Kansas Anymore, while Asheville, NC indie-rock ace MJ Lenderman and The Wind light up the stage with songs from Manning Fireworks.

episodes.name: Jon Batiste
episodes.summary: Seven-time Grammy and Academy Award winner Jon Batiste returns for an electrifying hour. The New Orleans native and vibrant ambassador of jazz, blues, and soul lights up the stage with an ecstatic performance of gems from "Big Money."

episodes.name: Reneé Rapp / Thee Sacred Souls
episodes.summary: Fan-favorites make magnetic ACL debuts: Pop star Reneé Rapp delivers chart-toppers and kiss-off anthems from her LP Bite Me and acclaimed San Diego modern soul trio Thee Sacred Souls captivate with highlights from Got A Story To Tell.

episodes.name: Marcus King Band / Wyatt Flores
episodes.summary: Electrifying acts light up the ACL stage: South Carolina's Marcus King Band rocks fan-favorites and new tracks from 'Darling Blue,' while Red Dirt country singer-songwriter Wyatt Flores shines with songs from 'Welcome to the Plains.'

episodes.name: Queens of the Stone Age
episodes.summary: Rock titans QOTSA take the ACL stage anew for Alive in the Catacombs, a project conceived in the ancient tombs beneath Paris. Josh Homme and Co. deliver a master class reimagining their iconic catalog in an immersive, innovative hour.

episodes.name: Leon Thomas
episodes.summary: Six-time 2026 Grammy nominee Leon Thomas delivers a magnetic hour, showcasing songs from his Album of the Year-nominated MUTT and new EP PHOLKS. Dubbed "R&B's hottest rock star," the Best New Artist contender commands the ACL stage.

episodes.name: A Rolling Stone
episodes.summary: Mr. Brown receives a surprise that brings up his sinful past. Reginald and Jeremy are at odds with the court system.

episodes.name: Right is Right
episodes.summary: Extended Logline Mr. Brown endorses a local politician, which causes major problems for him and the rest of the facility. Jeremy takes matters into his own hands to protect the facility against protesters.

episodes.name: Snowmaggedon
episodes.summary: A serious snowstorm throws the facility a curve ball. Tension rises as the facility awaits a miracle to save Leah and Reginald, who are trapped without electricity.

episodes.name: 1988 San Francisco 49ers
episodes.summary: A world championship was at stake, and the San Francisco 49ers were in a panic. Trailing 16-13 late in Super Bowl XXIII, the offense was 92 yards away from a championship. It was a moment for legends. Bit by bit, Hall of Fame quarterback Joe Montana marched the 49ers the length of the field. His 10-yard scoring strike to John Taylor with 34 ticks left on the clock lifted the Niners to a third Super Bowl title.

episodes.name: 2005 Pittsburgh Steelers
episodes.summary: Re-live the story of the 2005 Steelers through the eyes of Bill Cowher, Jerome Bettis and Joey Porter. Narrated by Tom Selleck.

episodes.name: 2003 New England Patriots
episodes.summary: A documentary look at the 2003 New England Patriots, winners of Superbowl XXXVIII. The Patriots' 2003 season is examined through the views of free agent safety Rodney Harrison, veteran linebacker Willie McGinest, and offensive coordinator Charlie Weis; they provide behind-the-scenes looks at how the team was assembled, the effect of the sudden release of popular veteran safety Lawyer Milloy, and the team's record-setting streak of victories ending in a victory over the Carolina Panthers in what was widely considered the most exciting Superbowl ever.

episodes.name: 1966 Green Bay Packers
episodes.summary: This episodes chronicles the first team to win a Super Bowl, the 1966 Green Bay Packers, led by legendary head coach Vince Lombardi and quarterback Bart Starr. The Green Bay Packers were rated as the 6th greatest Super Bowl winning team by a Blue Ribbon panel of experts.

episodes.name: Back to School
episodes.summary: Twelve celebrities report for their first day of class, tackling a logic challenge, a nostalgic quiz on grade-school subjects, and interactive zoology and geography tests as they work their way towards the high-stakes final exam.

episodes.name: Airhead-to-Head
episodes.summary: The tests get trickier as the all-star students face a mind-boggling lightbulb game, race to answer questions before a balloon bursts, and team up in a spelling bee as they work toward the high-stakes final exam.

episodes.name: Duel of Fools
episodes.summary: After a deceptive challenge, the class receives its first rankings; the all-star students take on an intense chess-themed trivia game and a school picture day challenge as they work toward the high-stakes final exam.

episodes.name: Feud for Thought
episodes.summary: With only nine contestants remaining, tensions rise and rivalries start to form as the celebrities push themselves to their limits, tackling everything from general knowledge trivia to a game of life-sized human labyrinth.

episodes.name: The Midterms
episodes.summary: The dreaded midterms are the last chance for the celebrities to avoid being in the bottom half of the class. But will a mystery guest outshine them all?

episodes.name: Study Buddy Day
episodes.summary: Jack pairs the contestants into teams to give them a boost.

episodes.name: The Science Fair
episodes.summary: Bonds are tested as the remaining five celebrities battle science, and each other, with explosive results.

episodes.name: Family-Teacher Conferences
episodes.summary: It's the most embarrassing day of the school year. The celebrities' family members come to witness their loved ones' intellectual demise. Can they save them from themselves?

episodes.name: The Finals!
episodes.summary: In the final episode that nobody wanted to reach, the last two celebrities go head-to-head, each one desperate to avoid being crowned 'The Nation's Dumbest'.

Student of the Jeer/Bean Dreams

episodes.name: Have I Got 2025 News for You
Bootleg Ford Fixing and Road Trip!
episodes.summary: The Supercharged Bootlegging '40 Ford Fordor is back. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich death proof their questionably assembled '40 Ford and then hit the road to multiple junkyards in the hunt for a new project vehicle. After a lengthy search the guys fall in love with a barn find '50s truck that's too good to be true.

episodes.name: Muscle Truck 4-Link Fabrication!
episodes.summary: The '73 Chevy step-side "Muscle Truck" has a storied history. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and guest host Dave Chappelle fabricate another chapter in the truck's saga with the addition of a beefy 4-link suspension and coilovers to hopefully get it to finally sit right. Chappelle brings his own fabricated Mustang II along to compare to the truck on an autocross.

episodes.name: 1000+hp Pro Street Nova!
episodes.summary: The "Tunnel Cram" supercharged big-block Chevy engine gets a new home. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich add 1,000+ hp to David's Pro Street 1969 Chevy Nova. In an attempt to make a true street/strip car, the guys add the engine, transmission, and fully build out this roller before taking it to the track to run some impressive times out of the gate.

episodes.name: Crusher Camaro on Power Tour West!
episodes.summary: From the first Hot Rod Power Tour in '95 to the first Power Tour West, the 1967 Crusher Camaro keeps going. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich return the Camaro made famous in the pages of Hot Rod to its original stylings when it was saved from the jaws of the crusher. After a makeover, the guys hit the road to Vegas and back for Hot Rod's first ever Power Tour West.

episodes.name: The Dragoneer Begins!
episodes.summary: For years Freiburger has had an idea to build a super-sleeper drag race car from a Jeep Wagoneer. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich enlist the fabrication skills of Dave Chappelle to start building the Dragoneer. This LS-powered 1970 Jeep Wagoneer needs a lot of work, but it's on its way to becoming a surprisingly quick street/strip sleeper.

episodes.name: Hemi Power for the Mopar Muscle Truck!
episodes.summary: The MMT finally gets its Gen III Hemi. This time on Roadkill Garage, Dulcich and Freiburger enlist help from Chris Birdsong to finally finish the engine transplant into the 1974 Dodge D100 known as the Mopar Muscle Truck. After the installation of the new engine and a six-speed manual transmission, the guys hit the dyno to see what massive horsepower and torque numbers the truck now makes.

episodes.name: Harvesting an International Pickup!
episodes.summary: It's a barn find rescue of an unusually interesting pickup. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich pull a 1966 (or is it a 1965?) International Harvester truck from a garage where's it's sat for decades. They found the truck and fell in love with it on a Roadkill Garage, but now will they be able to get it running and back on the road?

episodes.name: Transforming the Hemi Belvedere!
episodes.summary: Pulling a car from a junkyard is just the start of a long journey. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich forge on with making David's 1969 Plymouth Belvedere an actual drivable car. The Belvedere has a 426 Hemi, four-speed manual transmission, and a Dana 60 rear end, but it still needs an exhaust system, full interior upgrades, disc brake conversion, and more.

episodes.name: Muscle Truck Showdown!
episodes.summary: The 1973 big-block 454, four-speed El Camino SS known as the El Cochino is back. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich head to Hot Rod Ranch to make the El Cochino a bit less of a pig. The car sits too high, has terrible wheel hop, runs poorly, and looks terrible. However, a new suspension, a Holley Sniper 2 EFI, and a four-hour paint job totally transform it into a desirable ride.

episodes.name: Complete El Camino Makeover!
episodes.summary: The 1973 big-block 454, four-speed El Camino SS known as the El Cochino is back. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich head to Hot Rod Ranch to make the El Cochino a bit less of a pig. The car sits too high, has terrible wheel hop, runs poorly, and looks terrible. However, a new suspension, a Holley Sniper 2 EFI, and a four-hour paint job totally transform it into a desirable ride.

episodes.name: Satellite Cop Car Makeover!
episodes.summary: What do you do when muscle cars get too expensive? Get a 1971 Plymouth Satellite four-door and make it cool. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich fall in love with their 318ci '71 Satellite, which years ago they would have only ever ridden in if they were sporting cuffs, by making it into a cop car clone. It looks great, but wait until you see it handle against a new cop car.

episodes.name: Fresh Pontiac Power in the T-37!
episodes.summary: There's no better way to break in a new dyno than bringing new life to an old favorite. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich refresh their junkyard-rescued 1971 Pontiac T-37 by removing the tired Pontiac 400ci V-8 and replacing it with fresh Pontiac power that delivers some horsepower and torque surprises when it runs on the shop's new dynamometer.

episodes.name: Dragoneer Forever!
episodes.summary: A distant dream turns to reality. This time on Roadkill Garage, Freiburger and Dulcich pull out all the stops, bringing in Dave Chappelle and Lucky Costa to fully build the Dragoneer, a 1970 Jeep Wagoneer set up as a sleeper drag car. From the suspension to the supercharger, they tackle every aspect of this build to end with a 408ci LS making 750 hp to the tires that pulls wheelies at the strip.
